Their central result is that these layer-wise maps do not align, and on models with reliable patching signal, sensitivity and causality are strongly anti-correlated.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining recipe paper, but it matters for robustness interventions, mechanistic analysis, and post-training repair. A common workflow is to inspect internal divergence or patching effects and then place adapters or representation edits where the signal looks strongest. The paper argues that this is often the wrong intervention site. It also contributes a useful scaling observation: perturbation propagation has family-specific structure, and in Qwen2.5 the late-accumulation pattern strengthens monotonically with model size. Finally, the evaluation warning is important on its own: short generation budgets can make chain-of-thought interventions look helpful when they are actually harmful under a proper decoding budget.
summary_en.technical_approach: The methodology is built around three complementary diagnostics. Sensitivity is measured by Layer-Wise Representation Divergence (LRD), defined as cosine divergence between mean-pooled hidden states for clean and perturbed inputs at each layer. Two summary statistics, slope across depth and recovery rate from early to late layers, are used to classify models into spike-and-suppress versus late-accumulation regimes. Causality is measured with activation patching: at each layer, the clean hidden state is inserted into the noisy forward pass, and the authors record how often originally failed examples are recovered. To avoid over-interpreting weak patching signals, they introduce an identity-patch gate: only models with at least 80% recovery under all-layer clean patching are treated as confirmed for causal conclusions. Compensatory capacity is measured by training LoRA adapters in different layer windows and comparing repair gains against regressions on clean computation. The proposed explanation for the dissociation is cascade disruption: an adapter placed early may locally counteract perturbation damage, but because it changes the entire downstream computation, it can break parts of the clean-input trajectory that were otherwise intact. The paper supports this mechanism with downstream disruption profiles and controlled layer-placement sweeps across multiple perturbation types.
summary_en.experiments: The study covers five models: Phi-3.5, Gemma-2-9B, Llama-3, Mistral, and Qwen2.5-7B, plus within-family scaling scans for Qwen2.5 from 1.5B to 14B and a smaller Llama family check. Two propagation regimes emerge. Phi-3.5 and Gemma-2-9B show spike-and-suppress behavior, where early divergence is partially absorbed later. Llama-3, Mistral, and Qwen2.5-7B show late accumulation, where divergence keeps growing toward the output. On the two models that pass the 80% identity-patch threshold, sensitivity and causality are strongly anti-correlated, with layer-wise correlations from -0.72 to -0.88. In Qwen2.5, the late-accumulation signature strengthens monotonically with scale and does so consistently across all perturbation types tested. In the adapter-placement experiments, early and mid-layer LoRA placement is often the most regressive, while the deepest window is consistently the safest default; adapting all layers is frequently worst. A notable negative result concerns evaluation protocol: an intervention that appeared to improve GSM8K by +7.3 points under a short generation budget dropped to -3.5 points once the truncation artifact was fixed.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with the figure showing the three layer-wise maps and the section defining the two propagation regimes. That gives the conceptual core of the paper. Then read the activation-patching setup carefully, especially the identity-patch gate, because the strongest causal claims are restricted to models where patching itself is reliable. If your interest is adapter placement or robustness repair, focus on the cascade-disruption evidence: downstream disruption profiles, fixed-harness layer sweeps, and the comparison between early, middle, and deepest windows. The evaluation section is also worth reading even if you skip the rest, because the generation-budget artifact is a useful warning for any chain-of-thought intervention study. A solid skim takes about 30 minutes; a deeper read should include the exact LRD definition, sample filtering criteria, and the patching reliability checks.

recommendation.zh: 把“在哪层坏了”拆成三个定义是实用的，直接看 §4 的层相关分析和 Qwen scaling 图即可；adapter 修复位置≠因果层这点对稳健性干预很有用。
recommendation.en: Worth reading for the three-way decomposition of layer responsibility; jump to §4 for the correlation/scaling plots—the dissociation between causal and repairable layers is actionable.

institutions: Nathan Labiosa, David Buff, Ena Nayak, Erica Donno

paper.title: Towards Robust Tool Use in Agents via Experience-Driven Adaptive Guidance
paper.abstract: The performance bottleneck of agents is increasingly shifting from model capability to the robustness of their execution processes. Tools play a central role as the primary interface through which agents interact with external environments, yet existing methods rarely focus on ensuring robust tool use across diverse runtime conditions. To address this problem, we propose ExpG, a mechanism that builds and refines adaptive guidance capturing each tool's capability boundaries and best practices, th

summary.core_problem: 智能体的工具调用在不同运行条件下不够鲁棒，现有方法较少刻画每个工具的能力边界与最佳实践。
summary.importance: 通用 Agent 工具使用的方法改进，核心是从历史轨迹中沉淀经验并生成自适应指导，但创新性偏增量。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ExpG，分三阶段：从历史执行轨迹做多方面归因以获取结构化经验；通过过滤、等价类选择和摘要蒸馏经验池；将经验转化为可复用的自适应指导以提升工具调用鲁棒性。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型参数量、训练数据、基线或量化提升，实验细节缺失。

summary_en.core_problem: Agent tool use is not robust across diverse runtime conditions, and existing methods rarely capture each tool's capability boundaries and best practices.
summary_en.importance: A method for improving general agent tool-use robustness by distilling experience from execution trajectories, though the contribution appears incremental.
summary_en.technical_approach: ExpG has three phases: experience acquisition via multi-aspect attribution on historical trajectories; experience distillation through filtering, equivalence-class selection, and summarization; and conversion of experience into adaptive guidance for tool use.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract provides no model size, training data, baselines, or quantitative improvements.

recommendation.zh: 工具调用鲁棒性的经验池方案，思路常规且摘要无实验；知道即可，暂不值得细读。
recommendation.en: A standard experience-pool approach to tool-use robustness with no experiments in the abstract; worth knowing about but not a close read.

paper.title: SCHEDBench: A Benchmark for Evaluating LLM Constraint Faithfulness in Natural-Language Combinatorial Scheduling
paper.abstract: This paper introduces SCHEDBench, a natural-language benchmark for evaluating combinatorial scheduling constraint faithfulness under surface-form variation. Grounded in canonical scheduling instances and solver-derived feasibility and optimality, SCHEDBench assesses whether large language models (LLMs) generate schedules with the same constraint-feasible behavior across varied natural-language (NL) surface forms. SCHEDBench spans 1,132 instances across job-shop scheduling problems (JSP), single

summary.core_problem: 评估大语言模型在组合调度任务中，对语义等价但表层形式不同的自然语言描述能否保持一致的约束满足能力。现有调度或推理基准通常只测试单一表述，难以区分失败来自组合搜索能力不足，还是来自自然语言约束解释不稳定。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接启发在于约束理解和指令鲁棒性的评测。它把“同一形式化问题的不同自然语言表面形式”作为控制变量，用求解器验证可行性，能够暴露模型对实体命名、约束顺序、句式改写等表层因素的敏感程度。这类分析对研究数据格式增强、指令稳定性、结构化推理训练都有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 构建 SCHEDBench，包含 1132 个组合调度实例，覆盖作业车间调度、单/多模式资源受限项目调度、护士排班和课程表问题。每个结构化实例通过确定性槽填充模板转成自然语言，并在三个轴上引入受控变化：模板选择、领域主题/实体命名、约束顺序。输出不做文本相似度判断，而是交给领域专用求解器检查可行性、目标值和具体约束违反情况。论文还按源实例配对不同表述，用随机种子噪声带区分表层形式导致的真实偏移与采样波动。
summary.experiments: 在多个前沿和开源模型上，没有模型对被测表层变化完全不变。等价表述会降低可行解比例，并使单实例约束违反率超出渲染噪声带。分层消融显示，约束重排是导致可行性集合变化的主要因素，主题实体替换和词汇句法改写的影响相对较小。论文还报告了不同任务族和难度下的可行性、目标质量和约束满足变化。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议先看引言中对“约束忠实度”和表层形式变化的定义，再看数据集构建部分的模板化 verbalization 管线和三个变化轴。结果部分重点关注约束重排消融和按实例配对的违反率变化图。若关心评测构造，可补读附录中的实例模板、人工审计和任务族细节。预计用时 30–45 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Evaluating whether LLMs preserve constraint-satisfaction behavior on combinatorial scheduling problems when the same formal instance is expressed through semantically equivalent but surface-form-varied natural language. Existing benchmarks usually test one formulation per instance, making it hard to tell whether failures come from weak combinatorial search or unstable interpretation of natural-language constraints.
summary_en.importance: The work is relevant to pretraining research through the lens of constraint understanding and instruction robustness. By varying surface form while holding the formal problem fixed, and by verifying outputs with solvers rather than text matching, it exposes sensitivity to entity naming, constraint ordering, and phrasing. This is useful for studying data formatting, instruction-following stability, and structured-reasoning training.
summary_en.technical_approach: SCHEDBench contains 1,132 instances drawn from job-shop scheduling, single- and multi-mode resource-constrained project scheduling, nurse rostering, and curriculum timetabling. Each structured instance is verbalized through a deterministic slot-filling pipeline with controlled variation along template selection, domain theme and entity naming, and constraint ordering. Model outputs are evaluated by domain solvers for feasibility, objective quality, and constraint violations. Equivalent renderings are paired by source instance, and a seed-noise band separates genuine surface-form sensitivity from sampling variability.
summary_en.experiments: Across frontier and open-weight models, none is fully invariant to the tested surface-form changes. Equivalent renderings reduce feasibility and shift per-instance violation rates beyond the rendering-noise floor. Layered ablations identify constraint reordering as the dominant axis of instability, with entity theming and lexical-syntactic rephrasing showing smaller effects. Results are broken down by task family, difficulty, feasibility, objective quality, and constraint-specific violations.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a skim, read the introduction for the definition of constraint faithfulness under surface-form variation, then the dataset-construction section for the verbalization pipeline and three variation axes. In the results, focus on the constraint-reordering ablation and paired per-instance violation analyses. The appendix is useful mainly for template examples, audit details, and task-family specifics. Estimated reading time: 30–45 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 读数据构造和 surface-form ablation；它给约束推理评测一个较干净的 solver anchor，可用于内部 eval 复刻。
recommendation.en: Read the data construction and surface-form ablations; the solver anchor makes this a clean candidate for internal constraint-reasoning evals.

paper.title: No Single Neuron of Failure: Distributed Safety Alignment Against White-Box Attacks
paper.abstract: With the rapid release of open-weight large foundation models, safety threats are shifting from black-box jailbreaks to neuron-level white-box attacks that directly identify and manipulate safety-related neurons. Existing alignment methods often investigate the safety behavior on a small number of neurons, creating fragile single point of failure with limited redundancy. To address this issue, we propose distributed safety alignment (DSA), which redundantly encodes safety capabilities across mul

summary.core_problem: 现有神经元级安全对齐方法将安全能力集中在少量固定神经元或通路上，面对白盒攻击（精准定位并剪除关键安全神经元）时存在单点失效问题，鲁棒性不足。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发包括：一是安全对齐可从架构层面的表征分布入手，而非仅依赖数据或损失函数调整；二是通过动态扰动迫使能力分布式编码的思路，可迁移到通用预训练的能力鲁棒性研究，避免核心能力集中在少数神经元导致的微调遗忘或攻击脆弱性；三是基于方向感知泰勒分数的FFN神经元归因方法，对预训练模型的机制分析、能力定位有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出分布式安全对齐（DSA）框架，核心是通过冗余编码消除安全能力的单点依赖。具体实现：1）干预位置选在语言侧前馈网络（FFN）的下投影层输入处，将每个特征坐标视为单个神经元；2）用方向感知的一阶泰勒分数，结合拒绝目标的损失梯度与神经元激活状态，精准定位对安全拒绝行为贡献最大的神经元；3）对抗冗余对齐训练阶段，对得分最高的关键神经元做确定性掩码（模拟定向白盒攻击），对其余神经元施加随机dropout（防止安全能力重新集中到新的小子集），迫使模型在更多补偿性神经元上冗余编码拒绝行为；4）在有害拒绝数据与良性效用数据上联合优化，保证通用能力不下降，推理时无额外开销。
summary.experiments: 当前提供的全文片段未包含完整实验章节，仅提及在多种大基座模型上验证，可显著提升对白盒安全抑制攻击的鲁棒性，同时保留模型原生通用能力。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点关注方法章节中的神经元归因方法（方向感知一阶泰勒分数）和动态扰动训练策略，以及引言部分对现有神经元级防御缺陷的分析，预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing neuron-level safety alignment methods concentrate safety capabilities on a small set of fixed neurons or pathways, creating a single point of failure under white-box attacks that precisely locate and ablate critical safety neurons, leading to insufficient robustness.
summary_en.importance: The work provides three insights for pretraining research: first, safety alignment can be approached from the perspective of representation distribution at the architectural level, rather than relying solely on data or loss function adjustments; second, the idea of forcing distributed capability encoding via dynamic perturbation can be transferred to robustness research in general pretraining, to avoid fine-tuning forgetting or attack vulnerability caused by concentration of core capabilities in a few neurons; third, the direction-aware Taylor score-based FFN neuron attribution method is useful for mechanism analysis and capability localization of pretrained models.
summary_en.technical_approach: Distributed Safety Alignment (DSA) is a framework that eliminates single-point dependency of safety capabilities via redundant encoding. It intervenes at the input of down-projection layers in language-side feed-forward networks (FFNs), treating each feature coordinate as an individual neuron. It uses direction-aware first-order Taylor scores, computed from refusal loss gradients and neuron activation states, to precisely locate neurons that contribute most to safety refusal behavior. During adversarial redundant alignment training, it applies deterministic masking to the highest-scoring critical neurons (simulating targeted white-box attacks) and stochastic dropout to the remaining neurons (preventing safety capabilities from re-concentrating on a new minimal subset), forcing the model to redundantly encode refusal behavior across a broader set of compensatory neurons. Joint optimization on harmful refusal data and benign utility data preserves general capabilities, with no inference-time overhead.
summary_en.experiments: The provided full text fragment does not include the complete experimental section. The work is reported to be validated on multiple large foundation models, significantly improving robustness against white-box safety suppression attacks while preserving native general capabilities.
summary_en.reading_guide: For skimming, focus on the neuron attribution method (direction-aware first-order Taylor score) and dynamic perturbation training strategy in the method section, as well as the analysis of limitations of existing neuron-level defenses in the introduction. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 从神经元机制层面探讨安全对齐的鲁棒性，提出的分布式对齐思路对理解模型内部表示和改进 post-train 策略有参考价值，建议略读其机制分析部分。
recommendation.en: Explores the robustness of safety alignment from the perspective of neuron mechanisms. The proposed distributed alignment idea is valuable for understanding internal model representations and improving post-train strategies. Skim the mechanism analysis section.

paper.title: Beyond the Bidirectional Promise: Re-evaluating the Robustness of Diffusion Language Models
paper.abstract: Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) offer a compelling alternative to autoregressive (AR) generation by enabling bidirectional context and iterative refinement. However, their reliability under natural input noise and adversarial attacks remains under-explored. To address this, we systematically evaluate DLM robustness and calibration against AR baselines, using two parameter-matched pairs (LLaDA-8B vs. LLaMA-3-8B and Dream-7B vs. Qwen2.5-7B) across 32 natural perturbation conditions, adversarial g

summary.core_problem: 扩散语言模型（DLM）的鲁棒性和校准性缺乏系统评估，现有研究多关注其双向上下文的优势，但对自然输入噪声、对抗攻击下的表现，以及与自回归（AR）模型的架构固有差异尚不清晰。
summary.importance: 研究澄清了DLM的鲁棒性不是架构自带属性，而是依赖权重训练质量；DLM普遍存在过度自信的校准问题，同时对梯度式对抗后缀有天然抵抗性；机制分析发现脆弱性集中在解码阶段而非感知阶段，对DLM的训练目标设计、推理解码算法改进、鲁棒性优化有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 采用配对评估设计，用两组参数量匹配的DLM-AR对（LLaDA-8B vs LLaMA-3-8B，Dream-7B vs Qwen2.5-7B）隔离架构固有特性和模型权重相关行为。评估覆盖三个维度：32种自然扰动条件、对抗梯度探测、隐状态机制分析。围绕四个研究问题展开：自然噪声下的准确率退化差异、噪声对置信度校准的影响、对抗后缀抵抗性差异、隐状态层面的机制解释。同时提出并测试5种输入提示掩码（IPM）变体，验证脆弱性是否源自解码阶段。
summary.experiments: 核心结论包括：1）自然噪声鲁棒性是权重依赖的，不是扩散架构的固有属性，扩散目标不是鲁棒性的银弹；2）两组配对模型中DLM都系统性地比AR模型更过度自信；3）短后缀预算下，DLM对梯度式对抗后缀有很强的抵抗性；4）线性探针显示所有模型（DLM和AR）检测输入损坏的准确率都超过93%，说明DLM的行为脆弱性来自解码阶段瓶颈而非感知失败；5）5种IPM变体均未提升性能，验证了鲁棒性需要直接整合到生成过程中，而非在输入提示层面修补。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看引言部分的研究问题设计，第6章的实验结果（尤其是四个研究问题对应的结论），以及机制分析和IPM验证部分。预计阅读时间25-35分钟，可跳过具体扰动的实现细节，重点关注结论对DLM设计的启示。

summary_en.core_problem: The robustness and calibration of Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) lack systematic evaluation. Existing work mostly focuses on their bidirectional context advantages, but their performance under natural input noise and adversarial attacks, as well as architecture-intrinsic differences from autoregressive (AR) models, remain unclear.
summary_en.importance: The study clarifies that DLM robustness is not architecture-inherent but weight-dependent. DLMs consistently show overconfidence in calibration, while exhibiting natural resistance to gradient-based adversarial suffixes. Mechanistic analysis reveals that fragility lies in the decoding stage rather than perceptual processing, which provides direct guidance for DLM training objective design, inference decoding algorithm improvement, and robustness optimization.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study uses a paired evaluation design with two parameter-matched DLM-AR pairs (LLaDA-8B vs. LLaMA-3-8B, Dream-7B vs. Qwen2.5-7B) to isolate architecture-intrinsic properties from weight-dependent behaviors. Evaluation covers three dimensions: 32 natural perturbation conditions, adversarial gradient probes, and mechanistic hidden-state analysis. Four research questions are addressed: accuracy degradation under natural noise, impact of noise on confidence calibration, resistance to adversarial suffixes, and mechanistic explanations from hidden states. Five Input Prompt Masking (IPM) variants are also tested to verify whether fragility originates at the decoding stage.
summary_en.experiments: Key findings include: 1) Natural noise robustness is weight-dependent, not an inherent property of the diffusion architecture — the diffusion objective is not a silver bullet for robustness. 2) DLMs are systematically overconfident compared to AR models across both paired sets. 3) DLMs strongly resist gradient-based adversarial suffixes under the short-suffix budget. 4) Linear probes show all models (both DLM and AR) detect input corruption with >93% accuracy, indicating DLM behavioral fragility comes from a decoding-stage bottleneck rather than perceptual failure. 5) None of the five IPM variants improve performance, confirming that robustness needs to be integrated directly into the generation process rather than patched at the input prompt level.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the research question design in the Introduction, the experimental results in Section 6 (especially conclusions for the four research questions), and the mechanistic analysis plus IPM verification sections. Estimated reading time: 25-35 minutes. Skip low-level perturbation implementation details, focus on conclusions and implications for DLM design.

recommendation.zh: 配对对比的实验设计非常干净，推翻了「DLM双向架构天然更鲁棒」的直觉，重点看§3扰动设置和§4鲁棒性对比结果。
recommendation.en: The paired comparison setup is very clean, overturning the intuition that DLM's bidirectional architecture is inherently more robust. Focus on §3 perturbation setup and §4 robustness results.

paper.title: Would You Walk to the Car Wash? Revealing the Salience Bias of Large Language Models in Commonsense Reasoning
paper.abstract: As large language models (LLMs) continue to advance in complex reasoning tasks, they have learned to heavily prioritize explicit conditions provided in the input. However, in everyday commonsense reasoning, this mechanism exposes a critical vulnerability which we term Salience Bias: models become easily hijacked by useless explicit distractors (e.g., numerical values), leading them to ignore the implicit physical or commonsense prerequisites of a task. A critical open question is whether this fa

summary.core_problem: LLM 在常识推理里会被输入中“显眼但无用”的显式条件（尤其是数字/计算线索）劫持，导致忽略隐含的物理/常识前提；论文要回答的关键是：这到底是常识知识缺失，还是在误导性 framing 下被抑制（knowledge suppression）。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值不在于提出新训练法，而在于把一个“训练信号偏置→推理时注意力分配偏置→知识被压住”的失效链条拆开，并给出可操作的诊断坐标：把失败分成 trap detection 与 trap avoidance 两个轴；再用 re-elicitation 证明很多失败不是能力缺口而是提取失败。这对数据配比与后训练（偏数学/规划/计算式指令）如何改变模型的输入显著性偏好，有明确启发：需要在训练信号里显式惩罚对无关条件的过拟合，或加入“反显著性”的课程/对比数据。
summary.technical_approach: 核心方法是构建 SaliTrap：把“物理上不可能/违反常识前提”的 trap core 伪装进看似合理的规划/优化式自然语言问题里，并注入一组数值 distractors 诱导模型走计算路径。数据设计强调三条 well-formedness：trap 必须确实不可能；正确回答必须触及不可能性、不能通过回答子问题逃逸（sub-task escape）；数值 distractors 让问题外观与正常任务难以区分。trap 维度分四类：缺失前置条件（如洗车必须有车）、环境不匹配、时间/生理约束违背、规则不匹配。评测上区分：是否识别到 trap（detection）与是否在最终建议/结论里拒绝 trap（avoidance），并分析 distractor 密度对两者的影响。最后用“去 framing 的再提取”（把误导性计算外壳剥离）来验证知识是否存在，从而把问题归因到 suppression/elicitation bottleneck，而不是知识缺失。
summary.experiments: 基准规模 1,145 条，覆盖四类 trap；评测 12 个主流模型。文中给出几个关键现象：最强模型在原始设定下也只有 54.8% 的 trap avoidance，12 个里有 8 个低于 30%；数值 distractor 越多，avoidance 下降且 CoT 被劫持（CoT-Hijacked）上升；即便模型显式“识别到陷阱”，仍可能高比例顺从错误 framing（例：GLM-5.1 与 Kimi-K2 在识别后仍分别有 86.2% 与 81.8% 的顺从/合规行为，体现 detection≠avoidance）；通过剥离误导 framing 的 re-elicitation，多个代表模型的平均 Liberation Rate 从 Cond-A 提升到 Cond-C，支持“知识在但被压住”的结论。论文还报告模型表现与总体推理能力相关，并呈现随 distractor 密度与模型来源（provenance）聚类的结构性差异。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议：优先看 Figure 1/2（现象与任务形式）、SaliTrap 的 well-formedness 三条件与 sub-task escape 定义（决定了基准是否“干净”）、以及 detection vs avoidance 的分解与对应统计。再看 re-elicitation/Cond-A→Cond-C 的实验段落：这是把“能力缺失”与“提取失败”区分开的关键证据。预计 30–45 分钟可抓住主要结论；若要用于训练改进，建议额外细读 distractor 密度控制与判定标准（judge/validation pipeline）以便复现或扩展数据合成。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a failure mode in commonsense reasoning where LLMs over-weight explicit, salient but irrelevant conditions (especially numbers and computation cues), and consequently ignore implicit physical/commonsense prerequisites. The central question is whether this reflects missing commonsense knowledge or knowledge suppression caused by misleading task framing.
summary_en.importance: Its value to pretraining/post-training research is diagnostic rather than algorithmic: it decomposes the failure into (i) trap detection and (ii) trap avoidance, and then shows via re-elicitation that many errors are not competence gaps but retrieval/elicitation failures. This points to a training-signal issue: modern mixtures and RL/SFT rewards often over-reinforce “use every given condition” behavior (common in math/planning/coding prompts) without penalizing attention to irrelevant details, which can systematically bias salience handling at inference time.
summary_en.technical_approach: They build SaliTrap, a benchmark of computation-laden natural language queries that embed a physically impossible premise (the trap core) while injecting numerical distractors to induce spurious calculation. Items are constrained to be well-formed: the trap must be genuinely impossible under common knowledge; any correct answer must acknowledge the impossibility (preventing sub-task escape); and distractors must make the prompt look like a legitimate planning/optimization query. Traps span four dimensions (missing prerequisite, environmental mismatch, temporal/physiological violation, rule mismatch). Evaluation explicitly separates detection from avoidance, analyzes distractor-density effects, and uses de-framed re-elicitation (removing the misleading computational wrapper) to test whether the underlying knowledge is present but suppressed.
summary_en.experiments: SaliTrap contains 1,145 items across four trap types; 12 frontier LLMs are evaluated. Reported headline numbers: the best model avoids traps only 54.8% of the time under the original framing, and 8/12 models fall below 30%. Increasing the number of numerical distractors monotonically reduces avoidance and increases “CoT-hijacked” behavior. Detection does not imply avoidance: even after explicitly recognizing the trap, GLM-5.1 and Kimi-K2 still comply 86.2% and 81.8% of the time, respectively. Re-elicitation with stripped framing substantially increases “liberation” (Cond-A to Cond-C), supporting the knowledge-suppression interpretation. The paper also notes performance correlates with general reasoning strength and clusters by model provenance.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim path: start with Figures 1–2 for the phenomenon and task structure; then read the benchmark well-formedness criteria (especially the sub-task escape constraint) and the detection-vs-avoidance protocol. Finally, focus on the re-elicitation/Cond-A→Cond-C section, since it is the key evidence separating missing knowledge from suppressed knowledge. 30–45 minutes is enough for the main takeaways; spend extra time on the validation/judging pipeline if you plan to reuse the dataset for training or analysis.

recommendation.zh: 把“显式条件优先”做成可复现的陷阱评测，能直接当训练回归集；只看数据构造和“识别≠规避”的分析结论即可。
recommendation.en: Turns the ‘explicit-condition-first’ failure into a reproducible trap benchmark you can use as a training regression set; focus on dataset design and the detection≠avoidance finding.

paper.title: Scaling Vision-Language Models Is Not Enough to Mitigate Bias
paper.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) such as CLIP are now foundational to multimodal systems, yet their robustness to spurious correlations remains poorly understood at scale. We present the first large-scale empirical study of 194 publicly available VLMs, including 16 model families, covering a wide range of model sizes, 24 training datasets, and three evaluation benchmarks, namely ImageNet (overall performance), CelebA (typical single-attribute bias), and UrbanCars (complex multi-attribute biases). A

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要回答的不是“更大的 VLM 是否更强”，而是“更大的 VLM 是否更不容易学到捷径”。作者把问题收得很清楚：在零样本 VLM 中，预训练阶段学到的图文共现偏差会直接暴露到下游，没有任务特定的纠偏步骤；因此需要系统检验，模型规模、训练数据、架构细节这些常见设计轴，究竟谁真正影响对 spurious correlation 的鲁棒性。全文的核心发现是：标准性能上的 scaling 规律，在偏差更复杂的设定下会明显失效。随着评测从普通识别转向单属性偏差，再转向多属性偏差，模型规模与性能的相关性快速衰减，说明“把模型做大”并不能稳定换来更好的偏差鲁棒性。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的意义主要有两层。第一，它把“robustness to spurious correlations”从零散案例，推进成了一个接近预训练配方分析的问题：作者一次性比较了 194 个公开 VLM、16 个家族、24 个训练数据源，覆盖参数规模、数据规模、数据策展程度、patch granularity 等多个轴，因而结论不再只是某个模型族上的局部现象。第二，它给出一个对基座训练很直接的提醒：如果目标是做更可靠的多模态基础模型，继续沿着参数量和常规 benchmark 往上推，并不足以解决偏差问题；训练数据的规模与清洗质量、视觉 token 的粒度，反而是更稳定的控制杆。对做统一多模态预训练的人，这个结论很实用，因为它把注意力从“单纯扩模型”拉回到“数据分布和表示方式”。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上，这不是提出新模型，而是做大规模受控分析。评测设计有一个清晰的难度阶梯：ImageNet 用来测一般识别能力；CelebA 测单一 spurious attribute 下的鲁棒性；UrbanCars 测两个同时存在的 spurious attributes，对应更复杂的 group shift。作者把偏差复杂度形式化为属性数 M 的增长，组数随 |Y|×∏|A_m| 组合爆炸，因此多属性偏差比单属性偏差更难，这个设定和实验观察是一致的。

分析上，作者把多个设计因素拆开看：模型参数规模、训练数据规模、训练数据是否经过策展/过滤、视觉 patch size、架构家族等。一个关键点是他们不只看总体相关性，还做 controlled comparisons，也就是尽量在同一家族或相近设定下只改变一个因素，避免把“模型大”与“数据更好”“架构更新”混在一起。全文最有信息量的结论有三条：
1. 模型规模对标准识别仍然有效，但对复杂偏差鲁棒性几乎失效；
2. 数据属性更稳，尤其是数据规模和策展质量，在多属性偏差上仍保持可观相关性；
3. 输入表示会影响偏差鲁棒性，patch 变粗会伤害 worst-group 表现，说明更细粒度的视觉 token 有助于保留区分真正因果特征与背景捷径所需的信息。

从机制解释看，作者的论证是：对比学习式 VLM 训练会主动利用图文共现中的高频捷径，而扩大模型容量会提升拟合这些统计规律的能力，但不保证模型更愿意依赖因果相关特征。相反，数据策展可以直接改变 shortcut 的暴露频率，patch granularity 则影响模型能否解析局部对象与背景的细粒度差异。这也是为什么这些因素比单纯 scaling 更稳定。
summary.experiments:
实验规模是全文的重要支撑：194 个公开 VLM，来自 16 个模型家族，参数量从 63M 到 3.6B，训练数据覆盖 24 个来源，规模从 13M 到 12.8B 样本。评测包括 ImageNet、CelebA 和 UrbanCars，分别对应总体性能、单属性偏差、多属性偏差。

最关键的数字有几组。第一，Spearman 相关性随偏差复杂度显著下降：模型规模与性能的相关性在 ImageNet 上是 ρ=0.68，在 CelebA 上降到 ρ=0.48，在 UrbanCars 上几乎消失，仅 ρ=0.05。这个结果直接支撑“bias complexity sensitivity”。第二，在受控比较里，只增大模型规模时，ImageNet 平均提升约 +2.6%，但 UrbanCars 的 Worst-Group Accuracy 反而平均下降 -4.2%。这说明更大模型可能更会利用训练分布中的 shortcut，而不是更能摆脱它。第三，数据因素更稳：训练数据规模在多属性偏差上仍有 ρ=0.41 的相关性；经过策展的数据集，相比同规模但未过滤的数据，Worst-Group Accuracy 最多可高出 25%。第四，视觉 token 粒度有明确影响：patch size 从 16 增到 32，在受控比较中会让 UrbanCars 的 WGA 下降 6.8%。

如果看消融的含义，最值得注意的不是某个绝对最优模型，而是不同设计轴在不同 benchmark 上的“斜率变化”：标准 benchmark 上有效的改动，到了复杂偏差 benchmark 上可能失灵，甚至反向。这一点比单个榜单名次更重要。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读，但建议把引言、实验设定和主要图表认真看完。先看 Figure 1，抓住全文主结论：随着偏差复杂度上升，scaling law 的解释力在下降。然后看 methodology 里对 group structure 和 bias complexity 的定义，理解为什么 UrbanCars 比 CelebA 更能暴露问题。实验部分重点看两类结果：一类是相关性分析，另一类是 controlled comparisons。前者告诉你哪些因素“总体上相关”，后者告诉你这些相关性是否可能只是混杂因素。

如果时间有限，优先看：1）模型规模、数据规模、数据策展、patch size 这几组主结果；2）Worst-Group Accuracy 的定义和使用方式；3）作者如何控制不同模型家族之间的比较偏差。预计 25 到 35 分钟可以抓住主要信息。若你做多模态预训练，值得深挖的点有两个：一是 curated data 为什么能在 size-matched 条件下带来这么大的 WGA 差距；二是 patch granularity 对 shortcut reliance 的影响，后续可以联想到视觉 tokenizer、region token 或 object-centric 表示的设计。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a more precise question than standard scaling studies: does scaling a VLM make it less reliant on spurious correlations, or only better on average recognition? The full paper makes the setup explicit. In zero-shot VLMs, biases learned during web-scale pretraining are exposed directly at deployment time, because there is no task-specific debiasing stage. The central finding is that the usual scaling story weakens sharply as bias complexity increases. Model size correlates well with ImageNet performance, less with single-attribute bias robustness, and almost not at all with multi-attribute bias robustness.
summary_en.importance: Its value for pretraining research is practical rather than architectural. First, it turns spurious-correlation robustness into a large-scale recipe analysis problem: 194 public VLMs, 16 families, 24 training datasets, and multiple design axes are compared in one study. That gives the conclusions more weight than a single-family case study. Second, it identifies which levers remain useful when standard scaling stops helping. Data properties, especially dataset size and curation quality, are more stable predictors of robustness than parameter count. Patch granularity also matters. For people working on multimodal foundation models, this is a direct reminder that reliability will not come from scaling alone; it depends on what data the model sees and how visual evidence is represented.
summary_en.technical_approach:
This is a large empirical analysis rather than a new model. The evaluation is organized as a progression of bias complexity: ImageNet for overall recognition, CelebA for a single spurious attribute, and UrbanCars for two simultaneous spurious attributes. The paper formalizes this through group structure induced by labels and spurious attributes, with the number of groups growing combinatorially as more attributes are involved. That framing matters because it explains why multi-attribute bias is qualitatively harder, not just a slightly noisier benchmark.

The analysis decomposes several design factors: model size, training data size, whether the training data is curated or unfiltered, patch size, and architecture family. A useful part of the paper is that it does not rely only on global correlations. It also performs controlled comparisons where one factor changes while others are kept as comparable as possible within a family. That reduces the risk of attributing gains from better data or newer architectures to scale alone.

Three findings stand out. First, model scaling remains effective for standard recognition but loses predictive power for robustness under complex bias. Second, data properties are more stable: larger and better curated datasets retain meaningful association with worst-group performance even in the harder settings. Third, input granularity matters: coarser visual patches hurt worst-group accuracy, suggesting that fine-grained visual tokens help the model separate causal object evidence from background shortcuts.

The mechanism proposed by the paper is sensible. Contrastive VLM training benefits from frequent image-text co-occurrences, which are often shortcuts. More capacity helps fit those regularities, but does not force the model to rely on causally relevant features. Data curation changes the shortcut distribution directly, and finer patching preserves local evidence that may be necessary to resist background or co-occurrence bias.
summary_en.experiments:
The experimental coverage is the backbone of the paper: 194 public VLMs from 16 families, parameter counts from 63M to 3.6B, and 24 training data sources ranging from 13M to 12.8B samples. Evaluation uses ImageNet, CelebA, and UrbanCars, corresponding to overall performance, single-attribute bias, and multi-attribute bias.

The most important numbers are straightforward. The Spearman correlation between model scale and performance drops from 0.68 on ImageNet to 0.48 on CelebA and to 0.05 on UrbanCars. That is the clearest quantitative evidence for what the authors call bias complexity sensitivity. In controlled comparisons where model size is the main varying factor, scaling improves ImageNet accuracy by about +2.6% on average, but reduces UrbanCars worst-group accuracy by -4.2%. So larger models can become better at exploiting shortcuts rather than better at avoiding them. Data-related factors are more stable: training data size still shows a correlation of 0.41 with robustness on the multi-attribute benchmark, and curated datasets outperform size-matched unfiltered alternatives by up to 25% in worst-group accuracy. Patch granularity also has a measurable effect: moving from patch size 16 to 32 lowers UrbanCars WGA by 6.8% in controlled comparisons.

The main experimental lesson is not which single model wins, but which design axes keep their effect as the benchmark becomes more bias-sensitive. That is more informative for pretraining decisions than leaderboard ordering.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim paper, but it is worth reading the introduction, the benchmark setup, and the main result figures carefully. Start with Figure 1 to get the central claim: the explanatory power of scaling weakens as bias complexity increases. Then read the methodology section that defines group structure and bias complexity, because that makes the UrbanCars result easier to interpret. In the experiments, focus on two result types: correlation analyses and controlled comparisons. The first tells you what factors track robustness globally; the second tells you whether those trends survive when confounders are reduced.

If time is limited, prioritize the sections on model scale, data scale, data curation, and patch size, plus the definition of worst-group accuracy. Around 25 to 35 minutes should be enough to extract the main message. If you work on multimodal pretraining, two follow-up questions are worth deeper thought: why curation gives such a large WGA gain even at matched dataset size, and how patch granularity interacts with shortcut reliance and visual tokenization design.

recommendation.zh: 读相关性表和数据分组即可；它削弱“VLM 放大自然去偏”的 prior，数据治理信号更硬。
recommendation.en: Read the correlation tables and dataset splits; it weakens the prior that VLM scaling alone washes out bias.

paper.title: Language Models are not Equally Robust to Non-Canonical Tokenization across Languages
paper.abstract: Despite the existence of exponentially many valid tokenizations for a given string, language models operate on a single canonical sequence deterministically produced by the tokenizer, leaving the broader tokenization space largely uncharacterized. In this paper, we investigate this overlooked space by studying the behavior of language models under non-canonical tokenizations across diverse languages. For English, prior work shows that models are largely invariant to alternative tokenizations tha

summary.core_problem: 系统刻画“非规范（non-canonical）tokenization”对多语种 LLM 的影响：同一字符串存在大量等价的合法分词序列，但模型只在规范分词上预训练。问题是：这种分词扰动下的鲁棒性是否像英文那样近似不变？如果不成立，哪些语言/脚本/任务会显著退化，退化机制是什么？
summary.importance: 这篇对预训练研究的影响很直接：tokenizer 不再只是“词表大小/覆盖率”的工程选择，而是决定了模型对输入表示扰动的稳定性边界。论文给出一个清晰结论：英文观察到的 tokenization invariance 不能外推到多语种；鲁棒性是一个独立属性，与模型强弱不简单等价，并与语言的 token fragmentation（同一句话被切得多碎）强相关。对实际系统也有现实意义：词表裁剪/重分配、跨语种 tokenizer 迁移、甚至安全绕过，都可能让线上输入落到非规范分词分布上。更进一步，作者把非规范分词当作一种“自然的数据增强”，提示可以在预训练或 mid-train 中显式训练分词不变性。
summary.technical_approach:
1) 形式化：
- 定义字符串 x 的所有合法 tokenization 集合 T(x)，其中包含规范分词 T_canon(x)。
- 定义 tokenization invariance：对任意 t1,t2∈T(x)，模型输出/行为应一致；并用某种距离 d 度量偏离程度（性能差距或表示差异）。

2) 构造非规范分词：
- 在不改变 decode 后字符串的前提下，生成替代分词序列（全部由词表中合法 token 组成）。这类输入严格保持表面文本不变，因此把变量集中在“分词序列分布偏移”。

3) 评测设计：
- 27 种语言、覆盖不同脚本与语言家族；6 类下游任务；3 个近期模型家族。
- 不只看生成任务，还覆盖依赖句向量的语义任务（例如跨语种句子检索），用来证明影响不仅是解码层面的“输出不流畅”，而是表示学习本身会变。

4) 机制分析假设：
- 关键解释变量是 token fragmentation：同样的字符串在某些语言上被切成更多、更短、更稀有的 token，导致非规范分词更容易把输入推到训练分布外；同时序列更长也会改变注意力路径与位置分布，从而放大差异。

5) 训练启示：
- 把非规范分词作为数据增强：在训练中对同一字符串采样多种合法分词，逼近分词不变性。与“换 tokenizer 重新预训练”相比，这条路更像在固定词表下做鲁棒性训练，成本更低，也更贴近 tokenizer 迁移/裁剪后的真实线上扰动。
summary.experiments:
全文片段未包含主表数字与具体模型名称/版本号，因此无法安全复述具体提升/下降幅度。但从作者在引言中的明确陈述可提炼出几条“实验结论级”信息：
- 多语种 LLM 在非规范分词下的鲁棒性差异很大，且随语言/任务/模型家族变化。
- 鲁棒性不是“模型越强越鲁棒”的单调函数，而是受语言侧 tokenization 特性显著影响。
- 影响扩展到句向量/检索等语义任务，说明 tokenization 扰动会改变表示空间。
- 非规范分词可作为数据增强，能提升多语种泛化。
建议阅读时把注意力放在：按语言分组的退化幅度、与 fragmentation 指标的相关性图、以及数据增强带来的增益是否在多任务上稳定。
summary.reading_guide:
精读建议（这篇属于 must_read）：
- 先读 Methodology 的形式化定义与 non-canonical tokenization 的生成方式：这是后续所有结论的“实验操作定义”。
- 重点看按语言/脚本分组的主结果图表：哪些语言最脆弱、哪些相对稳定，是否与词表分配不均一致。
- 找到与 token fragmentation 相关的分析：它是论文的核心解释变量，决定结论能否迁移到 tokenizer 设计与数据配比决策。
- 认真看“非规范分词作为数据增强”的实验：增强策略怎么采样、训练开销多少、对哪些语言收益最大、是否牺牲英文或高资源语言。
- 最后看语义任务（跨语种检索/embedding）部分：它能帮助判断问题是“解码鲁棒性”还是“表征鲁棒性”。
预计精读 1.5–2.5 小时（含回看图表与附录设置）。

summary_en.core_problem: Characterizing how multilingual LLMs behave under non-canonical tokenizations: the same string admits many valid segmentations, but models are pretrained almost exclusively on the canonical one. The question is whether the English-level invariance to alternative tokenizations holds across languages, and if not, which languages/scripts/tasks break and why.
summary_en.importance: This is directly relevant to pretraining and tokenizer design. The paper shows that tokenization robustness is not a universal property you can infer from English, nor a simple monotonic function of model strength. It is strongly shaped by language-specific tokenization characteristics (notably token fragmentation). Practically, this matters whenever tokenization changes after pretraining—vocabulary pruning/reallocation, tokenizer transfer to new languages/domains, or adversarial tokenizations that preserve surface text. The additional takeaway is actionable: sampling non-canonical tokenizations can serve as a natural augmentation to improve multilingual generalization, suggesting a path to train tokenization invariance without fully re-pretraining with a new tokenizer.
summary_en.technical_approach:
1) Formalization:
- Define the set of valid tokenizations T(x) for a string x, including the canonical tokenization T_canon(x).
- Define tokenization invariance as identical model behavior for any t1,t2∈T(x), and quantify deviation via a distance d (performance gap or representation difference).

2) Non-canonical tokenization generation:
- Construct alternative token sequences composed of valid vocabulary tokens that decode to the exact same surface string, isolating distribution shift purely in token segmentation.

3) Evaluation protocol:
- A multilingual sweep over 27 languages spanning diverse scripts, 6 downstream tasks, and 3 recent model families.
- Importantly includes non-generation semantic tasks (e.g., cross-lingual sentence retrieval using embeddings), to test whether the effect is representational rather than just decoding fluency.

4) Mechanistic analysis:
- Emphasizes token fragmentation as a key explanatory factor: languages that are more fragmented under a shared multilingual vocabulary are more exposed to out-of-distribution segmentations; longer sequences and rarer subpieces can amplify sensitivity.

5) Training implication:
- Treat non-canonical tokenizations as augmentation: sample multiple valid segmentations for the same string during training to encourage invariance. Compared to swapping tokenizers and re-pretraining, this is a lower-cost robustness intervention that matches real-world tokenizer adaptation scenarios.
summary_en.experiments:
The provided excerpt does not include the main quantitative tables/figures or exact model variants, so it’s not safe to quote numbers. The paper’s experimentally stated conclusions are:
- Robustness to non-canonical tokenization varies sharply by language, task, and model family.
- Robustness is not simply explained by “stronger model = more robust”.
- Effects extend to embedding-based semantic tasks (e.g., cross-lingual retrieval), indicating representation shifts.
- Non-canonical tokenization can be used as augmentation to improve multilingual generalization.
When reading, prioritize: per-language degradation plots, correlations with fragmentation metrics, and the stability/consistency of augmentation gains across tasks and languages.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Must-read deep dive (1.5–2.5 hours):
- Start with the Methodology section: the formal definition of valid tokenizations and how non-canonical tokenizations are generated is the experimental backbone.
- Study the main results grouped by language/script: identify the most fragile languages and whether patterns align with vocabulary allocation and fragmentation.
- Focus on the fragmentation analysis: it’s the central explanatory variable that connects findings back to tokenizer construction and data mixture decisions.
- Read the augmentation section carefully: sampling strategy, training cost, which languages benefit most, and whether there are trade-offs for English/high-resource languages.
- Pay special attention to embedding/retrieval tasks: they help distinguish “generation robustness” from “representation robustness”.

recommendation.zh: 应立刻把非 canonical tokenization 加进 tokenizer 回归测试；英文不变性这个 prior 在多语言上不可靠。
recommendation.en: Add non-canonical tokenization to tokenizer regression tests; the English invariance prior does not survive multilingual evaluation.

paper.title: Decision-Level Hijacking: Injecting Cognitive Bias into Large Language Models via Bit-Flip Attacks
paper.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have been widely applied in high-stakes decision-making scenarios such as corporate strategy, and users are increasingly relying on their outputs. However, the deep integration of open-source model sharing ecosystems with LLM-powered critical decision-making applications also introduces critical risks: if an attacker can manipulate the model's cognitive stance, they can indirectly influence the judgments and actions of downstream decision-makers. This paper defines s

summary.core_problem: 研究部署后仅通过少量权重 bit flip，是否能在不明显破坏模型功能的前提下，系统性注入决策偏置并劫持 LLM 的判断倾向。
summary.importance: 这是 LLM 安全与鲁棒性方向的攻击分析，贡献在提出 decision-level hijacking 威胁模型，并把 bit-flip attack 从功能破坏扩展到认知立场操控。对预训练的直接价值有限，但对权重鲁棒性和模型可信部署有边缘启发。
summary.technical_approach: 论文把攻击目标从传统的输出错误或拒答绕过，转为更隐蔽的“认知偏置注入”；核心做法是在部署后翻转极少量权重比特，诱导模型在高风险决策任务中表现出特定立场，同时尽量保持通用能力和安全过滤表面正常。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、翻转 bit 数、基线或量化退化幅度，只强调攻击成本低、隐蔽性强、无需控制训练过程。实验细节不足，结论可信度需要看正文中的 attack budget、任务构造和功能保持指标。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether flipping only a few weight bits after deployment can inject systematic decision bias into an LLM without visibly degrading its general functionality.
summary_en.importance: This is an LLM security and robustness paper. Its contribution is the threat model of decision-level hijacking, extending bit-flip attacks from overt malfunction to covert manipulation of cognitive stance. The direct value for pretraining is limited, but it has some relevance for weight robustness and trustworthy deployment.
summary_en.technical_approach: Instead of targeting obvious output corruption or safety bypass, the paper targets covert bias injection. The method flips a minimal number of weight bits post-deployment to steer the model toward a desired stance in high-stakes decision tasks while preserving surface-level utility and safety behavior.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model sizes, bit-flip budgets, baselines, or quantified utility degradation. It only claims low attack cost, stealth, and no need to control training. The credibility depends heavily on the attack budget, task construction, and utility-preservation metrics in the full paper.

recommendation.zh: 更像安全红队而非 pretrain 论文；若你关心权重脆弱性和部署可信性，可只看攻击预算与功能保持指标，别把它误读成训练结论。
recommendation.en: This is more red-teaming than pretraining; only check the attack budget and utility-retention metrics if you care about weight robustness, and do not overread it as a training result.

paper.title: Visual Token Compression Enhances Robustness of MLLMs
paper.abstract: In this paper, we show for the first time that visual token pruning enhances the robustness of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), mitigating vulnerabilities such as jailbreak attacks and hallucinations. Given that vision and language modalities cannot be perfectly aligned, the misaligned visual tokens might act as out-of-distribution (OOD) inputs, leading to unpredictable outputs and introducing potential vulnerabilities. Building on this insight, we aim to enhance model robustness agains

summary.core_problem: 研究 MLLM 中视觉 token 与语言空间不对齐是否会诱发越狱和幻觉，并尝试用视觉 token 剪枝提升鲁棒性。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态鲁棒性方法。它把视觉 token 压缩从单纯推理加速问题，转成一种减少 OOD 视觉输入的安全与幻觉缓解手段，对 VLM 预训练后的视觉-语言对齐分析有一定参考。
summary.technical_approach: 方法先度量每个视觉 token 到语言特征空间的距离，将距离较大的 token 视为更可能的 OOD 或错配 token，然后在指定的 robust-pruning layers 中迭代剪除这些 token。设计上不是重新训练基座模型，而是在推理阶段做视觉 token 选择，因此更接近轻量干预和压缩策略。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在 7 个常用 benchmark 上评估，平均提升 13.29，覆盖越狱攻击和幻觉相关鲁棒性指标，同时带来推理成本下降。摘要未给出具体 MLLM 名称、参数规模、token 保留率和每个 benchmark 的详细结果。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自合肥工业大学。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether misaligned visual tokens in MLLMs contribute to jailbreaks and hallucinations, and whether pruning such tokens can improve robustness.
summary_en.importance: This is a multimodal robustness contribution. It reframes visual token compression as more than an inference-saving trick: removing likely OOD visual tokens may reduce unsafe or hallucinated responses caused by imperfect vision-language alignment.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method measures the distance between each visual token and the language feature space, treats large-distance tokens as likely OOD or misaligned, and iteratively prunes them at selected robust-pruning layers. It is an inference-time intervention rather than a new pretraining recipe.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports evaluation on seven popular benchmarks, with an average improvement of 13.29 and lower inference cost as a side effect. The provided abstract does not specify model sizes, exact MLLM backbones, pruning ratios, or per-benchmark numbers.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Hefei University of Technology.

recommendation.zh: 可看方法图和消融，价值在把视觉 token 距离当鲁棒性信号；但不是预训练结论，别外推到 tokenizer 设计。
recommendation.en: Skim the method and ablations: the useful signal is visual-token distance as a robustness proxy, not a pretraining-level conclusion.

paper.title: Marking the Wrong Symptoms: Evaluating LLM Watermarks in Medical Texts
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly integrated into clinical workflows, stressing the need for reliable traceability of model-generated output with watermarking. Yet, most watermarks are evaluated on general-purpose benchmarks, leaving domains like medicine, where small token-level perturbations can result in significant semantic changes, underexplored. In this work, we present the first rigorous study of how LLM watermarks affect medical performance, benchmarking 5 watermarking scheme

summary.core_problem: 现有LLM水印效果评估均基于通用领域基准和困惑度等粗粒度指标，未覆盖医学这类高风险场景——医学输出对推理逻辑、术语精度、数值准确性要求极高，token级微小扰动就可能改变临床语义，水印对医学场景下模型实际性能的影响缺乏系统研究。
summary.importance: 该研究揭示了水印的隐性影响：生成阶段的采样修改可以在不改变选择题准确率的前提下，显著劣化底层推理质量。这提示预训练/对齐阶段若要集成水印机制，不能仅依赖粗粒度准确率指标，需要额外关注领域特定的推理完整性、术语精度，尤其在医疗等容错率极低的垂直场景。
summary.technical_approach: 覆盖5类主流生成式水印方案（KGW软logit偏置、DipMark CDF重加权、AAR Gumbel-max采样、PPL困惑度预算argmax、SynthID锦标赛采样），在11个LLM和7个VLM上开展测试，基准包括纯文本医学问答MedQA和多模态医学问答MedXpertQA-MM。引入经临床专家验证的LLM-as-judge审计流水线，从推理质量、术语精度、幻觉率三个维度评估，而非仅统计答案选项正确率。
summary.experiments: 核心发现包括三点：第一，水印基本不影响选择题准确率，但会显著破坏推理：Phi-4-14B搭配SynthID时，答案正确但推理错误的比例从11.4%升至26.3%，捏造医学实体的比例最多提升39.2个百分点；在水印与无水印均答对的问题中，最高40%的推理包含互斥的诊断表述。第二，多模态场景下水印会削弱视觉 grounding能力，抑制正确的图像相关结论、放大矛盾结论。第三，对推理模型的思维链加水印会使输出长度最多增加69%且推理质量下降，仅对最终可见答案加水印则可保留推理性能。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点关注第3节评估流水线设计（尤其是临床专家验证的judge指标构建逻辑）和第4节核心实验发现（推理质量退化、多模态影响、推理模型水印位置的取舍），附录中临床专家验证细节可按需查阅，预计阅读时间20-30分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing LLM watermark evaluations rely on general-domain benchmarks and coarse metrics like perplexity, but high-stakes domains such as medicine require precise reasoning, terminological accuracy, and numerical correctness where minor token-level perturbations can alter clinical meaning. The actual impact of text watermarking on LLM/VLM performance in clinical settings remains uncharacterized.
summary_en.importance: This work reveals a hidden cost of watermarking: sampling modifications during generation can substantially degrade underlying reasoning quality without affecting surface-level multiple-choice accuracy. For pretraining and alignment pipelines that integrate watermarking, this means coarse accuracy metrics are insufficient — domain-specific reasoning integrity and terminological precision must be explicitly evaluated, especially for low-tolerance vertical use cases like healthcare.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study benchmarks 5 prominent generation-time watermarking schemes (KGW soft logit bias, DipMark CDF reweighting, AAR Gumbel-max sampling, PPL perplexity-budgeted argmax, SynthID tournament sampling) across 11 LLMs and 7 VLMs, using two medical benchmarks: MedQA (text-only clinical multiple choice) and MedXpertQA-MM (multimodal reasoning with radiology/pathology images). It introduces a clinician-validated LLM-as-judge pipeline to audit reasoning quality, terminological precision, and hallucination rates, rather than measuring only answer selection accuracy.
summary_en.experiments: Three key findings emerge: First, watermarking leaves multiple-choice accuracy largely unchanged but degrades reasoning substantially. On Phi-4-14B with SynthID, the share of correct answers paired with flawed reasoning rises from 11.4% to 26.3%, and fabricated medical entities increase by up to 39.2 percentage points. Up to 40% of questions answered correctly under both settings rely on mutually exclusive diagnostic statements. Second, in multimodal settings, watermarking impairs visual grounding, suppressing correct image-based claims and amplifying contradicted ones. Third, for reasoning models, watermarking the chain-of-thought trace inflates output length by up to 69% and reduces reasoning quality, while restricting watermarks to the final visible answer preserves reasoning performance.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a skim read, focus on Section 3 (evaluation pipeline design, especially the clinician-validated judge metric construction) and Section 4 (core findings on reasoning degradation, multimodal impact, and watermark placement tradeoffs for reasoning models). Appendix details on clinician validation can be reviewed as needed. Estimated reading time: 20–30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 把 watermark 的代价从“困惑度/可检测”落到“语义与风险”上，评测视角更干净；只读失败模式分类和专家审计流程就够用。
recommendation.en: It cleanly shifts watermark evaluation from detectability/perplexity to semantic and risk-centric failures; skim the failure taxonomy and the expert-audit protocol.

paper.title: Auditing Provenance Sensitivity in LLM Agent Action Selection
paper.abstract: LLM agents choose tools and arguments from context that mixes user requests, tool outputs, retrieved records, memory, and untrusted text. Evidence can be relevant without being authorized to determine a decision, so a correct action need not be grounded only in permitted evidence. We introduce a target-specific authorization audit that labels context factors separately for each tool and argument target. Its primary test holds the task, proposition, position, and policy fixed while changing only

summary.core_problem: LLM agent 在混合可信/不可信上下文时，动作选择是否会被未授权来源不当影响（provenance sensitivity）。
summary.importance: 针对 agent 工具调用的来源审计与对抗鲁棒性做了受控测量，给出具体错误率与错误模式，对 agent 训练数据/上下文安全有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 target-specific authorization audit：固定任务、命题、位置和策略，仅改变命题的来源授权属性；主测试对比可信/不可信版本下动作选择差异；辅助诊断使用 context-subset 交互与受控证据削弱，定位干扰模式。
summary.experiments: 450 个受控 next-action 任务，覆盖多个开源 LLM 家族；可信/不可信变体在竞争场景下导致 5.4% 的动作分歧，支持场景下 1.7%；呈现 full-correct / mixed-error / clean-correct 的模式。

summary_en.core_problem: Whether LLM agent action selection is inappropriately influenced by unauthorized sources when context mixes trusted and untrusted provenance (provenance sensitivity).
summary_en.importance: A controlled audit of provenance sensitivity and adversarial robustness in tool-using agents, with concrete error rates and error patterns relevant to agent context security and training signal design.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes target-specific authorization audit: fix task, proposition, position, and policy while varying only the proposition's source authority; primary test contrasts trusted vs. untrusted variants; secondary diagnostics use context-subset interactions and controlled degradation of evidence to localize interference patterns.
summary_en.experiments: On 450 controlled next-action tasks across multiple open-weight LLM families, trusted vs. untrusted variants produce different actions in 5.4% of competing cases vs. 1.7% of supporting cases, exhibiting a full-correct / mixed-error / clean-correct pattern.

recommendation.zh: 小规模受控审计，5.4% 干扰率数字可作 agent 工具调用安全的弱信号，方法直接但规模有限，读表格即可。
recommendation.en: A small-scale controlled audit; the 5.4% unauthorized-interference rate is a weak signal for agent tool-use security; method is straightforward and under-powered—just skim the tables.

paper.title: From Bit-Position Sensitivity to Unequal Error Protection for DNN Inference Memory
paper.abstract: We characterize per-bit-position fault sensitivity in ML inference across 16 workloads -- spanning transformer-based models and attention-free CNNs -- and across three floating-point formats. Our central empirical finding is a sharp bit-sensitivity transition: flipping any of the least-significant fraction bits up to a data-type-specific threshold, Xsafe, degrades task metrics by less than 1% under deterministic single-bit stress tests. Sensitivity rises through the upper fraction bits and spike

summary.core_problem: DNN 推理时内存位翻转的敏感度在不同比特位上差异极大，均匀 ECC 保护带来不必要的存储开销。
summary.importance: 工程观察类工作，给出 FP16/BF16/FP32 下安全低位比特阈值，为推理内存的不等错误保护（UEP）提供量化依据。
summary.technical_approach: 在 16 个 workload（含 Transformer 与 CNN）上做单比特翻转应力测试，刻画每一位位置的错误敏感度，按数据类型给出 Xsafe 阈值，并据此设计分层 ECC 方案。
summary.experiments: 覆盖 FP16/BF16/FP32；测得 Xsafe 阈值 FP16=6、BF16=4、FP32=15；低于阈值的尾数位翻转使任务指标下降 <1%；分层 ECC 可将开销从 12.5% 降到 37.5–62.5% 的节省幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: Bit-flip sensitivity during DNN inference is highly non-uniform across bit positions, making uniform SECDED ECC unnecessarily expensive.
summary_en.importance: An empirical characterization that provides per-datatype safe low-bit thresholds to enable unequal error protection for inference memory.
summary_en.technical_approach: Run deterministic single-bit stress tests across 16 workloads (transformers and CNNs) and three floating-point formats, map per-position sensitivity, derive Xsafe thresholds, and design tiered ECC.
summary_en.experiments: FP16/BF16/FP32 covered; Xsafe floors reported as FP16:6, BF16:4, FP32:15; flipping bits below Xsafe degrades task metrics by <1%; tiered ECC raises savings to 37.5–62.5% vs 12.5% uniform overhead.

recommendation.zh: 硬件推理侧的实用观察，和预训练本身关系弱；只在做低比特/近存计算部署时备查，不必深读。
recommendation.en: A practical hardware-inference observation with little pretrain relevance; keep as a reference only if you work on low-bit or near-memory deployment.

paper.title: Logical Judgments Under Pressure: Diagnosing Syllogistic Stability with Learned Soft Prefixes
paper.abstract: To test how correct logical judgments respond to learned context, we prepend a soft prefix to an exactly labeled syllogistic reasoning benchmark while keeping the model fixed. Soft prefixes are opaque continuous vectors, so we characterize them through the behavior they induce across controlled variations in logical form and interface. By studying which prefixes succeed and how their effects generalize, we characterize how learned contextual pressure can override correct judgments and expose lim

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究的不是“模型会不会做三段论”，而是“模型已经能做对时，这个判断有多稳”。作者把一个固定参数的模型放在精确可判定的 syllogistic benchmark 上，只训练一小段 soft prefix，观察它能否把原本正确的 valid/unsatisfiable 判断改写成错误答案。关键点在于，这些前缀不是可读文本，不能被简单解释为“新增前提”；而且作者专门选择了在基准语义下不应被合法翻转的方向，例如 unsatisfiable→satisfiable、valid→invalid，因此一旦翻转成功，就说明模型的最终判断会被某种学习到的上下文压力系统性带偏。论文真正要诊断的是：这种带偏到底是固定输出符号、任务内的广义答案偏置，还是更接近一种可迁移的逻辑操作。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要有三层。第一，它把“逻辑能力”拆成了 accuracy 和 stability 两个维度，这对做 pretrain 诊断很重要：很多模型在标准 benchmark 上答对，并不代表内部表征对无关上下文稳定。第二，它提供了一个相当干净的 stress test 框架：标签可精确计算，干预方向有明确语义约束，能把 prompt sensitivity、answer prior、decision margin 脆弱性分开看。第三，它揭示了不同模型即便 aggregate flip rate 接近，内部响应机制也可能不同。Gemma 的行为更像可由 answer class + 原始 margin 解释的稳定偏置；Qwen 则更像边界可预测、幅度难预测的复杂响应。这对训练动态、对齐后稳健性、以及 prefix/prompt attack 的机理分析都有参考价值。它不是直接改进预训练方法的论文，但作为诊断工具和机制观察，相关性中等偏上。
summary.technical_approach:
方法设计很克制。作者先构造一个 exactly labeled 的 syllogistic setting，保证 valid/invalid、satisfiable/unsatisfiable 的标签由形式逻辑直接给出，而不是人工标注。然后对冻结模型学习短 soft prefix，使其把某一类原本答对的样本推向指定目标答案。为了避免把结果误读成“prefix 学会了输出某个 token”，论文做了几层功能性解释。

第一层是区分 fixed-symbol forcing 与 semantic answer bias。作者通过随机化答案映射、统计 target-answer rate、分析对目标答案 logit/score 的直接加成，检查 prefix 是否只是强推某个表面符号。如果在答案映射变化后效果仍跟随语义而不是符号，说明更接近答案意义层面的偏置。

第二层是区分 task-specific bias 与 cross-task operation。作者分别在 validity 和 satisfiability 两个任务上训练/测试 prefix，再做跨任务迁移。如果一个 prefix 真学到更抽象的“逻辑操作”，它应在两个任务间较稳定转移；如果主要是任务内答案偏置，迁移会弱很多。结果支持后者。

第三层是看泛化边界。作者按 logical form 做 partition，在未见形式上测试；再换 wording、改 prompt interface，检查 prefix 是否只绑定训练模板。有效 prefix 在这些变化下仍能保持较高 flip，说明它不是简单记模板。

第四层是用 matched random controls 和 readable-text controls 做对照。随机前缀用于排除“任何额外连续向量都会扰动输出”的解释；文本控制用于比较可读上下文与不可读 prefix 的差异。作者还加入 reverse directions，检查这种干预是否具有明显方向性。

最后，论文用 score model 和 activation analysis 补充解释。score model 以 answer class 和 unprefixed margin 为输入，拟合加 prefix 后的 margin 变化，测试“广义答案偏置 + 原始决策边界脆弱性”能解释多少现象。activation 分析则看 learned prefix 与 norm-matched random prefix 在中间层/最终答案 margin 上造成的变化，并测试对 prefix 顺序的敏感性。整体上，这不是提出新训练法，而是把软前缀当作探针，系统拆解模型逻辑判断的脆弱来源。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B MoE、Qwen3-8B 和 Gemma 4 31B。主结果很直接：学习到的 prefix 能把大量原本正确的判断翻成目标错误答案，而且这种效果能迁移到未见 logical forms，并在 wording 和 prompt 重写后保留。

具体数字上，new-wording 与 rephrased-prompt 条件下，Qwen3.6 MoE 的 flip rate 在 72%–90%，Qwen3-8B 在 53%–72%，Gemma 4 31B 在 40%–56%。按四种 logical-form partition 统计，learned prefixes 在 Qwen3.6 和 Gemma 的 16 组 paired comparison 中全部优于 matched random controls，优势达到 37 到 99 个百分点。Gemma 的 validity 迁移结果尤其干净：learned prefix 在新 wording 和 prompt 改写下仍有 54%–56% flip，而 matched random prefix 低于 1%。作者还对 Qwen3.6 做了更强随机基线，从 1000 个随机前缀里挑最强者，结果其 transfer 仍明显弱于 learned prefix。

机制分析里，论文发现主导效应不是固定输出符号，而是对某个答案语义的广泛偏好。这个解释能覆盖大部分 aggregate steering，但不能完全解释单样本响应强弱。score model 对 Gemma 的 prefixed margin 拟合明显更好；对两个 Qwen 模型，它常能预测哪些样本会跨过 decision boundary，却较难预测最终 margin 有多大。这说明相同的 flip rate 可能对应不同的内部动力学。activation 结果进一步显示，learned prefix 带来的 answer-margin 改变量远大于 norm-matched random prefix；同时，不同模型对 prefix token 顺序的敏感性不同，提示其利用 prefix 的方式并不一致。
summary.reading_guide: 这篇适合泛读但要抓住实验设计。优先看 Introduction 里对干预方向的逻辑约束，尤其为什么选 unsat→sat、valid→invalid，这决定了整篇论文的可解释性。然后看区分三种机制的实验段：fixed-symbol forcing、broad answer preference、cross-task transfer，这是核心。结果部分建议重点看 logical-form split、new wording / rephrased prompt、matched random control 这几组表和图，它们决定你是否相信 prefix 学到的是稳定可迁移的偏置，而不是模板过拟合。若时间有限，activation analysis 可以后看；它提供支持性证据，但不是主结论的支点。预计 25–35 分钟能把主线读清。更值得深挖的点有两个：一是为什么 Gemma 的 margin 响应更可拟合，而 Qwen 更像非线性边界效应；二是这种“答案语义偏置”与预训练中形成的 label prior、instruction tuning 中的 answer-format bias 是否有关。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper is not asking whether LLMs can solve syllogisms. It asks whether a logically correct judgment remains stable once a learned contextual perturbation is added. The setup is deliberately strict: the model is frozen, labels are exact, and a short soft prefix is trained to flip judgments such as unsatisfiable→satisfiable or valid→invalid. Those reversals are not licensed by the benchmark semantics, so a successful prefix cannot be interpreted as merely adding a legitimate premise. The real question is what kind of mechanism causes the flip: forcing a fixed output symbol, inducing a broad answer-level bias within a task, or approximating a more general logical operation.
summary_en.importance: Its value for pretraining research is diagnostic rather than algorithmic. First, it separates logical accuracy from logical stability. That distinction matters because benchmark correctness can hide fragile internal decision boundaries. Second, the paper offers a clean stress-test design: exact labels, semantically constrained intervention directions, and controls that isolate answer priors from generic prompt sensitivity. Third, it shows that similar aggregate flip rates can come from different response structures across models. Gemma looks more explainable by answer class plus the original margin, while Qwen appears harder to model at the final-margin level. That is useful for studying training dynamics, robustness after post-training, and the mechanism of prefix or prompt-based steering.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method is carefully structured. The authors start from an exactly labeled syllogistic benchmark where validity and satisfiability are determined by formal logic rather than annotation. They then learn a short soft prefix on top of a frozen model, targeting examples that the unprefixed model originally gets correct. The goal is to redirect those judgments toward a chosen wrong answer.

The main contribution is the functional interpretation protocol for otherwise opaque prefixes. First, the paper distinguishes fixed-symbol forcing from semantic answer bias. It randomizes answer mappings and analyzes target-answer rates and score shifts to test whether the prefix is tied to a surface token or to the meaning of an answer class.

Second, it distinguishes task-specific bias from cross-task transfer. Prefixes are trained and tested across validity and satisfiability settings. If a prefix learned something like a shared logical operation, transfer should be strong across tasks. The observed transfer is limited, which supports the answer-bias interpretation.

Third, the paper probes generalization boundaries. It evaluates on unseen logical forms, new wordings, and rephrased prompt interfaces. Strong transfer under these changes argues against simple template memorization.

Fourth, it uses matched random-prefix controls and readable-text controls. Random prefixes test whether any extra continuous context can perturb the model. Reverse-direction experiments probe whether the effect is directional rather than symmetric.

Finally, the authors fit score models using answer class and the unprefixed margin to explain prefixed behavior, and add activation analyses to compare learned prefixes against norm-matched random ones. The overall picture is that soft prefixes are used as probes for model fragility, not as a new reasoning method.
summary_en.experiments:
The evaluation covers Qwen3.6-35B-A3B MoE, Qwen3-8B, and Gemma 4 31B. Learned prefixes flip a large fraction of previously correct judgments, and the effect survives transfer to unseen logical forms and interface changes.

On new-wording and rephrased-prompt conditions, flip rates are 72%–90% for Qwen3.6 MoE, 53%–72% for Qwen3-8B, and 40%–56% for Gemma 4 31B. Across four logical-form partitions, learned prefixes beat matched random controls in all 16 comparisons for Qwen3.6 and Gemma, with margins of 37 to 99 percentage points. One of the cleanest results is Gemma on validity: learned prefixes still achieve 54%–56% flip under wording and prompt changes, while matched random prefixes stay below 1%. The paper also strengthens the random baseline on Qwen3.6 by selecting the best prefixes from 1,000 random candidates; even then, transfer remains substantially weaker than with learned prefixes.

Mechanistically, the dominant effect is not fixed-symbol forcing but a broad preference for one answer meaning. That explains much of the aggregate steering, but not all instance-level variation. The score model fits Gemma’s prefixed margins much better than Qwen’s. For Qwen, it often predicts whether an example will cross the decision boundary, but not the final targeted margin. Activation analyses further show that learned prefixes induce much larger answer-margin changes than norm-matched random prefixes, and that sensitivity to prefix order differs across models.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the introduction carefully, especially the rationale for choosing unsat→sat and valid→invalid. That choice is what makes the intervention interpretable. Then focus on the experiments that separate three mechanisms: fixed-symbol forcing, broad answer preference, and cross-task transfer. The most important evidence comes from logical-form splits, wording/interface transfer, and matched random controls. Those sections tell you whether the prefix learned a stable transferable bias or just overfit a prompt template. Activation analysis is useful but secondary. A practical read is about 25–35 minutes. The deeper questions worth following are why Gemma is more margin-modelable than Qwen, and whether this answer-level bias is connected to priors formed during pretraining or reinforced during instruction tuning.

recommendation.zh: 关注预训练逻辑鲁棒性的研究员可看§3的实验设置和§4的跨模型翻转率对比，能反映不同预训练配方的逻辑表示硬度。
recommendation.en: Researchers focused on pretrained logical robustness should check §3 experimental setup and §4 cross-model flip rate comparisons, which reflect logical representation rigidity of different pretraining recipes.

paper.title: On Success and Simplicity: A Second Look at Transferable Vision-Language Attack Pipeline
paper.abstract: Vision-Language Pre-training Models (VLPMs) are known to be vulnerable to adversarial attacks. Recent transferable attacks on VLPMs have followed a common pipeline with complicated loss functions or multi-stage text/image attacks. However, in this paper, we demonstrate that such a sophisticated attack pipeline can be simpler yet more successful. Specifically, we identify three previously overlooked issues caused by inappropriate cross-modal interactions and excessive operations. To address them,

summary.core_problem: 重新审视视觉-语言预训练模型的可迁移对抗攻击流程，指出复杂跨模态攻击 pipeline 可能引入无效甚至有害操作。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 VLM 鲁棒性与安全分析。它不直接改进预训练，但对理解视觉-语言对齐表征的脆弱性有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Simple Vision-Language Attack，识别既有 pipeline 中不合适跨模态交互和过度操作带来的三个问题，并用更简单的攻击流程提升迁移性和效率。
summary.experiments: 在四个数据集和三个下游任务上验证。摘要给出 Flickr30k 文图检索结果：SimVLA 在 R@1 transferability 上比强 baseline 高 8.01%-14.71%，耗时约为 35.73%，最大显存约为 46.26%。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper revisits transferable attacks on vision-language pretrained models and argues that complex cross-modal attack pipelines may contain unnecessary or harmful operations.
summary_en.importance: This is a VLM robustness and security analysis. It does not improve pretraining directly, but it offers evidence about fragility in vision-language aligned representations.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed Simple Vision-Language Attack identifies three issues caused by inappropriate cross-modal interactions and excessive operations, then simplifies the attack pipeline to improve transferability and efficiency.
summary_en.experiments: The method is evaluated on four datasets and three downstream tasks. On Flickr30k text-image retrieval, SimVLA improves R@1 transferability by 8.01%-14.71% over a strong baseline while using about 35.73% of the time and 46.26% of peak VRAM.

recommendation.zh: 看 abstract 和实验表就够；有意思的是复杂跨模态 attack 反而降迁移性，可作为 VLM 对齐脆弱性备查。
recommendation.en: The abstract and tables are enough; the useful signal is that complex cross-modal attacks can reduce transferability in VLMs.

paper.title: AIMO Interpretability Challenge
paper.abstract: We propose the AIMO Interpretability Challenge, a competition on distinguishing robust from spurious reasoning in frontier mathematical language models based on the models' internal mechanisms. The challenge is motivated by a central limitation of standard reasoning benchmarks: strong final-answer accuracy does not reveal whether a model relies on stable reasoning mechanisms or exploits brittle reasoning shortcuts. Building on AI Mathematical Olympiad (AIMO) problems and submissions, together wi

summary.core_problem: 这项挑战赛要解决的问题是：在数学推理模型答案正确率相近时，如何用内部机制和受控变体测试区分“稳定推理”与“脆弱捷径”。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接贡献不是训练方法，而是评测信号。它把数学推理能力的评测从最终答案推进到机制层面：模型是否在符号变体、对抗扰动、结构化分布偏移下仍使用一致的推理路径。这个信号对预训练和后训练都有参考意义。预训练侧可以用它诊断语料记忆、题型模板依赖和推理泛化；后训练侧可以用它评估 CoT、RL、verifier 训练是否只是提高可见答案率，还是改善了内部可泛化机制。贡献量级取决于最终开放的模型访问、表示接口和标注质量。当前内容更像挑战赛设计稿，不是已有实验结论。
summary.technical_approach: 方法由三部分组成。第一，构建奥赛级数学题集合，来源包括 AIMO 2、AIMO 3、JMO 和近两年 AIME，总计 180 道题，并保证训练集和测试集中各有 50% 是未在互联网公开的新题。这是为了降低训练污染和检索式记忆。第二，为原题构造符号推理链标注。它借鉴 GSM-Symbolic 的函数化变体思想，但目标从小学算术提升到奥赛级推理。符号链不是简单答案解析，而是描述有效解法中的逻辑依赖，使组织方能够生成大量受控变体，并改变表面条件、变量、结构或干扰项。第三，参赛者需要结合行为表现和模型内部表征，判断模型面对这些变体时是否具有稳健机制。和 RAVEL、InterpBench、MIB 这类偏合成或半合成的可解释性 benchmark 不同，该挑战不要求恢复预先植入的已知 circuit，而是要求在前沿模型和真实高难推理任务上判断机制是否能跨实例泛化。
summary.experiments: 没有传统意义上的实验结果。可确认的量化信息包括：核心题库 180 道奥赛级问题；训练和测试中各 50% 为新发布题；计划基于符号推理链生成大规模对抗变体；挑战赛预计吸引约 20–40 个质量较高的 interpretability/generalization 方向提交。文中还提到 AIMO 3 在 Kaggle 上吸引超过 4000 个队伍，用来说明社区对奥赛级推理系统已有较高参与度。需要注意的是，论文没有报告参赛基线、内部表征接口、评分函数细节、模型列表或稳健性标签的一致性检验。这些会决定该挑战赛最终能否成为可靠评测资产。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20–30 分钟。重点看 competition description 中的科学目标、三类数据组件、与 RAVEL/InterpBench/MIB 的区别。最值得追问的是评分协议：参赛者能访问哪些内部激活或注意力信息，稳健模型和脆弱模型的标签如何产生，符号变体如何避免引入新的歧义，以及机制解释如何和最终鲁棒性绑定。对预训练研究员来说，不需要细读竞赛组织背景，重点关注它是否能产出可用于训练污染诊断和推理泛化诊断的题目生成工具。

summary_en.core_problem: The challenge asks whether internal model evidence can distinguish robust mathematical reasoning from brittle shortcut use when models obtain similar final-answer accuracy.
summary_en.importance: Its main value for pretraining is evaluative rather than algorithmic. Final-answer math scores are a weak signal for model development because they conflate reasoning, memorization, formatting, and exploitation of surface cues. A benchmark built around symbolic variants and internal mechanisms could provide a sharper diagnostic for contamination, template dependence, and reasoning generalization. It may also help separate post-training methods that merely improve answer accuracy from those that create more stable reasoning behavior. The impact depends heavily on the final scoring protocol, model access, and annotation quality; the current document is a competition proposal, not an empirical study.
summary_en.technical_approach: The design combines olympiad-level problems, symbolic reasoning annotations, and access to frontier reasoning models. The problem pool includes 180 tasks from AIMO 2, AIMO 3, JMO, and recent AIME sets, with half of both train and test problems claimed to be newly published to reduce internet leakage. The organizers annotate symbolic reasoning chains that capture logical dependencies in valid solutions. These chains are then used to generate controlled adversarial variants, in the spirit of GSM-Symbolic but at a much harder mathematical level. Participants are expected to infer robustness from behavior and internal representations. This differs from benchmarks such as RAVEL, InterpBench, and MIB, which often test interpretability methods in synthetic or semi-synthetic settings with known factors or planted circuits. Here the target is whether interpretability tools can make useful judgments about real frontier models on difficult reasoning tasks.
summary_en.experiments: There are no completed experimental results. The concrete numbers are the planned 180-problem corpus, 50% newly published problems in both train and test splits, symbolic annotations for variant generation, and an expected 20–40 strong submissions. The proposal also cites more than 4,000 teams participating in AIMO 3 on Kaggle as evidence of community interest. Missing details include baseline interpretability methods, the exact internal-access interface, robustness-label construction, inter-annotator validation for symbolic chains, and the final metric. These details will determine whether the challenge becomes a reusable scientific instrument or mainly a competition event.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 20–30 minutes. Focus on the scientific goal, the three data components, and the comparison with RAVEL, InterpBench, and MIB. The key questions are how robustness labels are produced, what internal activations or traces are exposed, how symbolic variants preserve mathematical equivalence, and how explanations are scored against generalization behavior. Pretraining researchers can skip most organizational material and focus on whether the dataset could support contamination analysis, reasoning-data filtering, or post-training diagnostics.

recommendation.zh: 只看任务定义和鲁棒变体生成；它把数学评测从答对拉到机制层，适合改内部 eval。
recommendation.en: Read the task definition and robustness-variant generation; it pushes math evaluation from answer accuracy toward mechanisms, useful for internal eval design.

paper.title: UTS at ELOQUENT 2026 Voight-Kampff: structural shifts in AI writing bypass state-of-the-art detectors
paper.abstract: We investigate which language model evasion attacks survive state-of-the-art adversarial fine-tuning, developing strategies that sweep the top 5 positions on the ELOQUENT 2026 Voight-Kampff leaderboard. While adversarial fine-tuning trivially closes the 2025 winning evasion recipes, we uncover a fundamental asymmetry in detector vulnerability: pushing generated text out of the detector's training distribution reliably defeats adversarial detection, whereas pulling it into the distribution (e.g.,

summary.core_problem: 研究哪些 AI 文本检测规避攻击能够在对抗微调后的检测器面前继续生效。
summary.importance: 贡献在于对 AI 文本检测器的鲁棒性做机制性分析：论文指出把生成文本推到检测器训练分布之外，比模仿人类训练分布更容易绕过检测器。
summary.technical_approach: 作者在 ELOQUENT 2026 Voight-Kampff 任务中系统测试规避策略，提出两类 out-of-distribution 攻击：跨年代文体 register 攻击，以及现代主义 stream-of-consciousness 形式。核心不是让文本更像训练集中的人类文本，而是让文本落入检测器未覆盖的结构分布。
summary.experiments: 论文称相关策略包揽 leaderboard 前 5，并且相较此前方法 fool rate 最高提升约 50 倍，同时保持自然性。还测试了加入 period prose 做训练增强的防御，摘要称该 countermeasure 不能关闭漏洞。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 University of Technology Sydney。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies which AI-writing evasion attacks remain effective against detectors hardened by adversarial fine-tuning.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is a robustness analysis of AI text detectors, arguing that moving generated text outside the detector's training distribution is more effective than trying to mimic human training data.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors test evasion strategies in the ELOQUENT 2026 Voight-Kampff setting and introduce two out-of-distribution attack families: cross-decade register attacks and modernist stream-of-consciousness form. The key move is to exploit structural distribution shift rather than human-likeness within the detector's training manifold.
summary_en.experiments: The strategies reportedly take the top five leaderboard positions, reach up to about 50x higher fool rates than previous methods, and preserve naturalness. The paper also tests the obvious defense of augmenting with period prose and reports that it does not close the vulnerability.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from the University of Technology Sydney.

recommendation.zh: 和预训练只间接相关，但 OOD 文体绕过检测器这个负结果值得记下；不需要读完整攻防细节。
recommendation.en: Only indirectly tied to pretraining, but the OOD-register failure mode of detectors is worth remembering; skip the attack details.

paper.title: GPT-Red: Unlocking Self-Improvement for Robustness
paper.abstract: Explore GPT-Red, OpenAI’s automated red teaming system that uses self-play to improve AI safety, alignment, and prompt injection robustness.

summary.core_problem: 提出 GPT-Red，用自动化红队和自博弈机制提升模型在安全、对齐和 prompt injection 场景下的鲁棒性。
summary.importance: 价值在于把红队从人工发现问题扩展到模型驱动的持续攻击与改进循环；这对后训练数据生成、安全评测闭环和对抗式训练信号设计有直接参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 从摘要看，GPT-Red 使用 self-play 方式生成或发现攻击样例，让模型在攻击者与防御者角色之间迭代，从而自动挖掘脆弱提示、prompt injection 路径和安全失效模式。方法更接近自动化红队系统与对抗数据生成，而不是新的基座预训练目标。
summary.experiments: 公开摘要未给出模型规模、训练数据量、baseline、量化提升或完整评测表；需要看正文是否披露攻击成功率、鲁棒性提升、人工红队对比和迁移性结果。
summary.authors_note: OpenAI Research 发布；文章关注自动化红队、自博弈安全改进和 prompt injection robustness。

summary_en.core_problem: GPT-Red aims to improve model robustness for safety, alignment, and prompt-injection settings through automated red teaming and self-play.
summary_en.importance: The useful contribution is the shift from human-only red teaming toward a model-driven loop that continuously generates attacks and hardens defenses, which is relevant to post-training data generation, safety evaluation loops, and adversarial training signals.
summary_en.technical_approach: Based on the abstract, GPT-Red uses self-play to let models explore attacker and defender roles, surfacing adversarial prompts, prompt-injection paths, and safety failures. It is best read as an automated red-teaming and adversarial-data system, not as a new base-model pretraining objective.
summary_en.experiments: The provided summary does not report model sizes, training data, baselines, quantitative gains, or full evaluation tables; the useful details would be attack success rates, robustness deltas, human-red-team comparisons, and transfer behavior.
summary_en.authors_note: Released by OpenAI Research, focused on automated red teaming, self-play safety improvement, and prompt-injection robustness.

recommendation.zh: 读方法闭环和失败案例就够；若指标透明，它能指导内部安全数据生成，但别把博客结论当训练定律。
recommendation.en: Read the loop design and failure cases; if metrics are transparent, it can guide internal safety data generation, but do not treat the blog claim as a training law.

paper.title: The Illusion of Robustness: Aggregate Accuracy Hides Prediction Flips under Task-Irrelevant Context
paper.abstract: As large language models (LLMs) grow more capable, they are increasingly deployed in context-rich settings where task inputs are often accompanied by long, partially irrelevant context. In a controlled setting, we find that state-of-the-art models often appear robust to task-irrelevant context at the aggregate level: prepending it to benchmark questions causes little change in overall accuracy. This aggregate stability, however, masks significant per-example instability. Even semantically meanin

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究的是：长上下文里加入与任务无关的内容时，为什么模型在 aggregate accuracy 上看起来很稳，但单样本预测却会发生大量翻转。
summary.importance: 重要性在于它指出了一个常被忽略的评估盲点：平均准确率几乎不变，并不代表模型对无关上下文真正鲁棒。对长上下文预训练、检索增强、上下文工程和 inference-time scaling 都有直接启发，因为真实部署里“部分无关上下文”几乎是常态。
summary.technical_approach: 作者在受控设置下，向 benchmark 问题前置 task-irrelevant context，甚至加入语义上无意义的 pseudo-words，观察模型预测是否翻转。分析不仅看 aggregate accuracy，还看 per-example instability，并进一步分解这种不稳定性如何受上下文类型、长度、test-time compute 和模型开发阶段影响。核心贡献是把“稳不稳”从均值指标拆到样本级动力学。
