summary.experiments: 摘要显示：最先进模型在总体准确率上对无关上下文似乎很稳，但少量样本会发生显著双向翻转——有些被干扰变差，有些反而变好，因此均值被抵消。这个现象跨多种模型和数据集都存在，而且受影响样本高度模型特异；即便是随机字符拼成的 pseudo-words 也能触发变化。摘要未给出具体模型名单和翻转比例，但从设计上看，实验相对干净，适合作为长上下文鲁棒性分析的基线论文。
summary.authors_note: 作者包括 Diyi Yang 与 Sanmi Koyejo，分别在语言模型行为分析、社会与交互 NLP、可靠性与机器学习理论方向有持续代表性工作。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks why models can appear robust in aggregate accuracy when task-irrelevant context is added, while still exhibiting substantial prediction flips at the per-example level.
summary_en.importance: Its value is in exposing an evaluation blind spot: stable average accuracy does not imply true robustness to irrelevant context. This matters for long-context pretraining, retrieval-augmented systems, context engineering, and inference-time scaling, because partially irrelevant context is the norm in deployment.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors prepend task-irrelevant context to benchmark questions in controlled settings, including semantically meaningless pseudo-words, and measure prediction flips. They go beyond aggregate accuracy to analyze per-example instability, and study how the effect varies with context type, context length, test-time compute, and model development stage. The main contribution is a cleaner robustness lens at the sample level.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports that state-of-the-art models often look robust in overall accuracy, yet a nontrivial subset of examples flips in both directions—some get worse, some improve—so the average masks instability. The effect holds across models and datasets, and the affected examples are largely model-specific. Even random pseudo-word context can trigger changes. Exact model names and flip rates are not given in the abstract, but the setup appears clean and useful as a baseline analysis for long-context robustness.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors include Diyi Yang and Sanmi Koyejo, both known for sustained work on language model behavior, reliability, and broader ML analysis.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不改方法，但会改你看 long-context robustness 的指标习惯；只看 aggregate accuracy 已经不够，建议重点读 prediction flip 分析和 compute 交互部分。
recommendation.en: It does not propose a new method, but it should change how you read long-context robustness: aggregate accuracy is not enough—focus on the prediction-flip analysis and its interaction with test-time compute.

paper.title: Reliability Scaling Laws for Quantized Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Quantization is a powerful strategy to build capable and resource-efficient large language models (LLMs) by reducing the bitwidth of the parameters. While quantized LLMs achieve state-of-the-art performance on unperturbed inputs using standard predictive metrics, their performance on perturbed inputs, measured using reliability metrics, remains underexplored, despite its importance for reliable deployment. To address this gap, we first conduct a comprehensive reliability evaluation of quantized

summary.core_problem: 量化 LLM 在标准评测集上表现良好，但在面对包含微小扰动（如拼写错误、语法错误）的输入时，其可靠性（不确定性估计、校准度和鲁棒性）如何变化，以及如何选择最佳量化位宽以平衡效率和可靠性。
summary.importance: 揭示了 LLM 量化中的一个重要盲区：准确率随模型总比特数单调增加，但可靠性却呈现非单调趋势。这为实际部署中选择量化策略提供了新的视角，指出单纯追求高精度或大模型并非总是最佳选择。
summary.technical_approach: 构建了一个包含三个维度的可靠性评估框架：预测不确定性、校准度（不确定性估计的准确性）以及对 15 种保持语义的输入扰动（字符级和词级）的鲁棒性。在 1B 到 70B 参数规模的模型上，系统评估了 6 种主流的量化方法（2、3、4、8 bit）。
summary.experiments: 发现 4-bit 量化在不同任务、模型架构和量化方法中，提供了可靠性与效率的最佳折中。中等规模的 4-bit 模型在可靠性指标上甚至优于更大规模的低比特模型或更小规模的高比特模型。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注图 1 中准确率与可靠性随总比特数变化的趋势对比。泛读即可，了解 4-bit 量化在可靠性上的优势结论。

summary_en.core_problem: While quantized LLMs perform well on standard benchmarks, how does their reliability (uncertainty estimation, calibration, and robustness) change when facing inputs with minor perturbations (e.g., typos, grammatical errors), and how to choose the optimal quantization bit-width to balance efficiency and reliability.
summary_en.importance: Reveals a critical blind spot in LLM quantization: accuracy increases monotonically with the total number of model bits, but reliability exhibits a non-monotonic trend. This provides a new perspective for selecting quantization strategies in practical deployment, indicating that simply pursuing high precision or large models is not always the best choice.
summary_en.technical_approach: Constructs a reliability evaluation framework comprising three dimensions: predictive uncertainty, calibration (accuracy of uncertainty estimates), and robustness to 15 types of semantically-preserving input perturbations (character-level and word-level). Systematically evaluates 6 mainstream quantization methods (2, 3, 4, 8 bits) on models ranging from 1B to 70B parameters.
summary_en.experiments: Finds that 4-bit quantization offers the best trade-off between reliability and efficiency across different tasks, model architectures, and quantization methods. Moderately-sized 4-bit models even outperform larger low-bit models or smaller high-bit models in reliability metrics.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the trend comparison between accuracy and reliability with respect to the total number of bits in Figure 1. Skim to understand the conclusion regarding the advantages of 4-bit quantization in reliability.

recommendation.zh: 只看 reliability-vs-bitwidth/scale 的图；它不改预训练 recipe，但会影响模型发布时的量化验收标准。
recommendation.en: Skim the reliability-versus-bitwidth/scale plots; it will not change pretraining recipes, but it can change release-time quantization acceptance tests.

paper.title: Association Restoration Test: Revealing Restorable Shortcuts after Unlearning
paper.abstract: Association unlearning aims to disable learned label-attribute shortcuts while preserving task performance. Existing evaluations mainly measure output-level robustness or probe whether shortcut attributes remain readable in frozen features, but neither test determines whether a retained association remains functionally usable by the original classifier. We propose the Association Restoration Test (ART), a post-hoc diagnostic for functional shortcut restorability. ART estimates class-conditional

summary.core_problem: 现有unlearning/shortcut缓解方法的评测只看输出鲁棒性或探测frozen特征，无法判断shortcut关联是否仍可被原分类器功能性恢复
summary.importance: 提出一个功能性诊断指标ART，揭示“已经unlearned”的shortcut在表征里其实还可被放大复原——这和LLM unlearning/安全对齐中“删除是否真的删除”是同一类问题
summary.technical_approach: Association Restoration Test (ART)：估计类别条件下的关联方向，在特征中放大残差分量，再用原始分类头评估是否仍能利用该shortcut。属于probe式机制诊断方法
summary.experiments: 在Waterbirds、CelebA、SpuCoDogs和一个ISIC时间戳artifact扩展上验证，证明输出指标、特征probe、ART三者刻画不同维度，很多方法在输出/特征层面看起来去掉了shortcut，但ART显示仍可功能性恢复

summary_en.core_problem: Existing unlearning and shortcut-mitigation evaluations measure either output robustness or linear probes on frozen features, neither of which tells whether a retained association remains functionally usable by the original classifier
summary_en.importance: Introduces the Association Restoration Test (ART), a post-hoc diagnostic showing that supposedly removed shortcuts can often be functionally restored by amplifying residual directions — directly relevant to the broader 'is unlearning real' question in LLM unlearning and safety alignment
summary_en.technical_approach: ART estimates class-conditional association directions, amplifies residual components in features, and re-evaluates through the original classifier head to test functional restorability of shortcuts
summary_en.experiments: On Waterbirds, CelebA, SpuCoDogs, and an ISIC timestamp-artifact extension, output metrics, representation probes, and ART characterize distinct facets: many methods appear to remove shortcuts at the output / probe level while ART shows they remain functionally restorable

recommendation.zh: 小域（Waterbirds/CelebA视觉spurious correlation）上的诊断方法，但“unlearn后能否被方向放大恢复”的思路可直接迁移到LLM unlearning评测，看方法即可，不读实验
recommendation.en: Small-scale vision spurious-correlation setting, but the 'amplify residual direction to test restorability' idea transfers to LLM unlearning evaluation; read the method, skip the per-dataset tables.

paper.title: Multi-Channel Spread-Spectrum Code Watermarking
paper.abstract: Attributing code to the large language model that produced it is essential for provenance, licensing, and misuse accountability, yet no deployed watermark meets this need. Generation-time schemes require access to the producing model and cannot be applied to third-party code, while post-hoc schemes work on any code but carry at most 4 bits of payload, far too few to distinguish the many deployed model configurations. We present multi-channel spread-spectrum watermarking, the first post-hoc, trai

summary.core_problem: 为第三方代码提供无需访问生成模型的 LLM 代码来源水印，并支持足够大的模型配置标识容量。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是代码水印与安全 provenance 方法。它针对生成时水印需要模型访问权、既有事后水印载荷很小的问题，提出 24-bit 载荷的训练无关方案，并给出鲁棒性论证。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 multi-channel spread-spectrum code watermarking，将比特编码到变量命名习惯和八组语义等价的代码模式中。密钥控制的伪随机置换把代码位置映射到码字比特，使每个比特获得多个独立投票；多数投票处理分散扰动，外层 Reed-Solomon 码处理集中攻击。
summary.experiments: 摘要强调 24-bit payload、post-hoc、training-free 和形式化鲁棒性保证；未提供具体代码语料、语言覆盖、攻击设置、误检率或漏检率数值。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies post-hoc attribution of LLM-generated code without requiring access to the model that produced it.
summary_en.importance: It contributes a code watermarking method for provenance and accountability. The key target is the gap between generation-time watermarks, which require model access, and prior post-hoc methods, which carry too little payload to identify many deployed configurations.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method encodes bits through variable naming conventions and eight pairs of semantically equivalent code patterns. A keyed pseudo-random permutation maps watermarkable sites to codeword bits, giving each bit multiple independent votes. Majority voting handles distributed corruption, while an outer Reed-Solomon code recovers identifiers under more concentrated attacks.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports a 24-bit payload, training-free post-hoc deployment, and formal robustness guarantees. It does not provide the concrete datasets, programming languages, attack suite, or detection error rates in the supplied text.

recommendation.zh: 和预训练关系很远，但 24-bit 事后代码水印挑战了“载荷只能很小”的默认印象，可作为 provenance 备查。
recommendation.en: Far from pretraining, but the 24-bit post-hoc code watermark challenges the usual low-payload assumption; keep it as provenance literature.

paper.title: Search-based Testing of Vision Language Models for In-Car Scene Understanding
paper.abstract: In the automotive domain, in-car scene understanding (ISU) enables the detection of safety-critical events, such as driver distraction, and supports drivers or passengers by analyzing the in-car scene and adapting the environment (e.g., ambient lighting). The industry is increasingly exploring vision-language models (VLMs) to interpret camera-recorded in-car scenes and extract information for downstream reasoning tasks. However, VLMs may generate incomplete, erroneous, or misleading scene descri

summary.core_problem: 如何在真实数据昂贵的车内场景下，对 VLM 驱动的车内场景理解系统进行系统化、可扩展的可靠性测试。
summary.importance: 属于面向安全关键场景的 VLM 测试/评测方法；对“VLM 可靠性评估、合成场景生成用于测试”有参考，但偏垂直领域，难直接反馈到通用预训练配方。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ISU-Test：用渲染生成车内场景，并把测试用例生成表述为搜索/优化问题，通过系统性修改场景参数探索失败模式与覆盖更广的 corner cases。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体 VLM/ISU 系统、搜索空间规模、发现的失败类型统计或与随机采样的对比增益；主要是方法框架描述。

summary_en.core_problem: How to systematically and scalably test VLM-based in-car scene understanding systems when real in-vehicle data is costly.
summary_en.importance: An evaluation/testing methodology for VLM reliability using synthetic rendering; informative for robustness evaluation, but domain-specific and only weakly connected to general pretraining recipes.
summary_en.technical_approach: ISU-Test combines rendering-based scene generation with search-based testing, framing test generation as an optimization problem over scene parameters to explore diverse corner cases and failure modes.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify target VLMs, search budget, failure statistics, or gains over random sampling; mostly a framework description.

recommendation.zh: 把“渲染+搜索”当作 VLM 可靠性评测脚手架的思路可借鉴；只看问题建模与参数化搜索，别深挖车内细节。
recommendation.en: The render+search framing is a reusable VLM reliability testing scaffold; skim the optimization setup and parameterization, ignore in-car specifics.

paper.title: PRA-RAG: Provably Robust Aggregation in Retrieval-Augmented Generation against Retrieval Corruption
paper.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) enhances Large Language Models (LLMs) by incorporating external knowledge, effectively mitigating their inherent knowledge limitations. However, RAG remains vulnerable to poisoning attacks that manipulate retrieved texts to mislead model outputs. Existing defense mechanisms often lack theoretical robustness guarantees and perform unreliably when the LLM has limited knowledge of the retrieved content. In this work, we propose PRA-RAG, a provably robust retriev

summary.core_problem: 解决 RAG 在检索文本被投毒或污染时，生成结果容易被误导且现有防御缺少理论鲁棒保证的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 RAG 鲁棒性方法与理论分析。它不属于预训练研究，但对“外部知识作为推理时训练信号/上下文信号”的可靠性有边际参考，尤其适合关注检索污染、上下文攻击和检索聚合稳定性的研究者。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 PRA-RAG，通过采样多个 retrieved text 组合，并利用 embedding 空间的几何结构识别鲁棒子集，再从该子集形成稳定的聚合表示。论文给出被污染检索内容最大影响的理论上界，并定义 RAG 鲁棒性的定量度量。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在多个 benchmark 和 RAG 架构上实验，验证对 retrieval corruption 或 poisoning attack 的防御效果。摘要未给出具体模型、检索器、攻击强度、污染比例、性能数字和与现有防御的详细差距。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses RAG vulnerability to poisoned or corrupted retrieved texts, where generated answers can be misled and existing defenses lack theoretical robustness guarantees.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a robustness method and theoretical analysis for RAG. It is not a pretraining paper, but it is marginally relevant to researchers thinking about external knowledge as an inference-time signal and the reliability of retrieved context under contamination.
summary_en.technical_approach: PRA-RAG samples multiple combinations of retrieved texts and uses geometric structure in embedding space to identify a robust subset. It then derives a stable aggregated representation from that subset. The paper provides bounds on the maximum impact of poisoned retrieved content and defines a quantitative robustness measure for RAG.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract states that the method is tested across multiple benchmarks and RAG architectures against retrieval corruption or poisoning. It does not provide the specific models, retrievers, attack strengths, poisoning ratios, numeric gains, or detailed comparisons with prior defenses.

recommendation.zh: 可扫理论界限和污染比例实验；若只靠 embedding 几何聚合，强对抗检索下结论要打折。
recommendation.en: Skim the robustness bound and poisoning-ratio experiments; embedding-geometry aggregation may not survive strong adaptive retrieval attacks.

paper.title: Can OCR-VLMs Read Devanagari? A Stress-Test Benchmark and Post-Correction Study
paper.abstract: OCR systems, ranging from classical engines to specialised OCR vision-language models (OCR-VLMs) and frontier multimodal LLMs, report strong results on English and Chinese document benchmarks, yet their behaviour on Indic scripts is largely uncharacterised. We benchmark ten systems on Devanagari (Hindi): classical EasyOCR; open VLMs (Qwen2.5-VL-3B, Qwen3-VL-8B, olmOCR-7B); specialised OCR-VLMs (DeepSeek-OCR, Unlimited-OCR); and frontier closed models (Gemini 2.5 Flash, Claude Opus 4.7, GPT-5.5,

summary.core_problem: 评估 OCR-VLM 和前沿多模态模型在 Devanagari/Hindi 文档 OCR 上的鲁棒性，尤其是在退化扫描条件下的表现。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 VLM/OCR 评测资产和失效分析。它提醒多模态预训练不能只看英文和中文文档 OCR，高分干净合成集可能掩盖脚本和退化条件下的失败模式。
summary.technical_approach: 作者测试十个系统，包括 EasyOCR、Qwen2.5-VL-3B、Qwen3-VL-8B、olmOCR-7B、DeepSeek-OCR、Unlimited-OCR，以及 Gemini 2.5 Flash、Claude Opus 4.7、GPT-5.5、Mistral OCR。评测覆盖四种合成退化条件和 300 张真实印刷扫描，并分析后处理纠错。
summary.experiments: 在干净渲染文本上，十个系统 chrF++ 都在 91 到 98 之间，区分度很低；退化条件下专用 OCR-VLM 更脆弱。DeepSeek-OCR 的 median 最好，但会出现少数灾难性重复，输出长度最高达到参考文本的 71 倍，导致 corpus mean 严重恶化。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates OCR-VLMs and frontier multimodal models on Devanagari/Hindi OCR, with emphasis on robustness under degraded document conditions.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a VLM/OCR evaluation and failure analysis. It shows that document OCR capability cannot be inferred from English/Chinese or clean synthetic benchmarks alone.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study benchmarks ten systems: EasyOCR, Qwen2.5-VL-3B, Qwen3-VL-8B, olmOCR-7B, DeepSeek-OCR, Unlimited-OCR, Gemini 2.5 Flash, Claude Opus 4.7, GPT-5.5, and Mistral OCR. It uses four synthetic degradation settings, 300 real printed scans, and a post-correction analysis.
summary_en.experiments: On clean rendered text, all ten systems cluster between chrF++ 91 and 98, so the setting barely separates models. Under degradation, specialized OCR-VLMs are fragile; DeepSeek-OCR has the best median but rare catastrophic repetition failures up to 71 times the reference length, damaging the corpus mean.

recommendation.zh: 值得看 abstract 里的失效案例；对 VLM 预训练的信号是脚本覆盖和退化鲁棒性，比干净 OCR 分数更该进 eval。
recommendation.en: Read the failure cases in the abstract; the useful VLM-pretraining signal is script coverage and degradation robustness, not clean OCR scores.

paper.title: At the Edge of Understanding: Sparse Autoencoders Trace The Limits of Transformer Generalization
paper.abstract: Pre-trained transformers have demonstrated remarkable generalization abilities, at times extending beyond the scope of their training data. Yet, real-world deployments often face unexpected or adversarial data that diverges from training data distributions. Without explicit mechanisms for handling such shifts, model reliability and safety degrade, urging more disciplined study of out-of-distribution (OOD) settings for transformers. By systematic experiments, we present a mechanistic framework fo

summary.core_problem: 如何利用稀疏自编码器（SAE）从机制层面理解和量化 Transformer 模型在面对分布外（OOD）输入（如拼写错误、越狱提示）时的泛化边界和内部表征变化？
summary.importance: 为理解 LLM 的鲁棒性和安全性提供了一个基于内部表征的微观视角。通过 SAE 将 OOD 概念具象化为内部激活特征的变化，不仅能解释模型为何在异常输入下失效，还能利用这些内部信号进行数据筛选和模型微调，对提升模型在真实复杂环境下的可靠性有直接启发。
summary.technical_approach: 将 SAE 作为“显微镜”观察 LLM 内部残差流的激活状态。核心发现是，当 LLM 遇到 OOD 输入时，其内部会激活更多虚假（spurious）概念，导致重建误差增加或所需激活的特征数量增加。作者通过在 TinyStories 数据集上引入字符级拼写错误构建受控的 OOD 环境，并在 Llama 3.1 8B 上测试真实的越狱提示，验证了 SAE 能够有效标记这些 OOD 事件，并进一步利用这些 SAE 衍生的指标指导微调和防御越狱攻击。
summary.experiments: 在 GPT-2（25M，字符级分词）和 Llama 3.1 8B 上进行了实验。在受控的拼写错误实验中，SAE 能够清晰地捕捉到 OOD 输入导致的内部特征激活异常。在 Llama 3.1 8B 上，微小的提示分布偏移会导致基准测试性能下降，而利用 SAE 信号筛选数据进行微调可以改善性能。此外，SAE 能够将成功的越狱尝试标记为 OOD 异常，通过对齐这些敏感方向，可以增强模型对越狱攻击的防御能力。
summary.reading_guide: 建议重点关注 Methods 部分关于如何利用 SAE 定义和量化内部 OOD 事件的逻辑，以及 Section 6 中利用 SAE 信号防御越狱攻击的实际应用案例。这展示了可解释性工具在安全防御上的潜力。预计阅读时间 20 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: How to use Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) to mechanistically understand and quantify the generalization limits and internal representation shifts of Transformer models when facing out-of-distribution (OOD) inputs like typos or jailbreak prompts?
summary_en.importance: Provides a microscopic perspective based on internal representations for understanding LLM robustness and safety. By materializing OOD concepts as changes in internal activation features via SAEs, it not only explains why models fail under anomalous inputs but also leverages these internal signals for data filtering and model fine-tuning, offering direct inspiration for improving model reliability in complex real-world environments.
summary_en.technical_approach: Repurposes SAEs as a 'microscope' to observe the activation states of the LLM's internal residual stream. The core finding is that when an LLM encounters OOD inputs, it infers more spurious concepts internally, leading to increased reconstruction error or a higher number of activated features. The authors construct a controlled OOD environment by introducing character-level typos on the TinyStories dataset and test real jailbreak prompts on Llama 3.1 8B, verifying that SAEs can effectively flag these OOD events. They further utilize these SAE-derived metrics to guide fine-tuning and defend against jailbreak attacks.
summary_en.experiments: Conducted on GPT-2 (25M, character-level tokenization) and Llama 3.1 8B. In controlled typo experiments, SAEs clearly capture internal feature activation anomalies caused by OOD inputs. On Llama 3.1 8B, minor prompt distribution shifts lead to performance drops on benchmarks, while fine-tuning with data filtered by SAE signals improves performance. Furthermore, SAEs can flag successful jailbreak attempts as OOD exceptions, and aligning these sensitive directions enhances the model's defense against such attacks.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the Methods section regarding the logic of defining and quantifying internal OOD events using SAEs, and Section 6 for the practical application of using SAE signals to defend against jailbreak attacks. This demonstrates the potential of interpretability tools in safety defense. Estimated reading time: 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: SAE做OOD检测的思路值得看方法节，但“谬误概念”定义偏模糊，提升幅度与具体模型未披露，先看SAE激活统计和§4/5的可视化再决定是否跟进。
recommendation.en: The SAE-based OOD-detection angle is worth a methods pass, but the “fallacious concept” notion is fuzzy and gains/model scale are not disclosed; skim the SAE activation stats and §4/5 visuals before committing.

paper.title: Confidence-Aware Tool Orchestration for Robust Video Understanding
paper.abstract: Video reasoning language models implicitly assume that every input frame is equally reliable. This leads to what we term the Blind Trust Problem: under realistic perturbations such as motion blur, glare, or occlusion, frontier video reasoning models can suffer 15-30%p accuracy drops on real-world embodied benchmarks, while remaining unaware that their visual evidence has been degraded. To address this challenge, we propose Robust-TO, an agentic video understanding framework that explicitly integ

summary.core_problem: 解决视频推理模型在模糊、遮挡、眩光等退化帧上仍盲目信任视觉证据，导致鲁棒性显著下降的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献更接近通用多工具agent式视频理解，而不是预训练本身。价值在于它把“证据可靠性”显式纳入工具编排，这对多模态agent和后续训练信号设计有一点启发，但离基座预训练较远。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Robust-TO框架：先为每帧计算reliability-relevance分数，选择可信帧；再把原问题拆成子查询分发给异构视觉工具；各工具返回统一格式的证据，包括预测结果、时间定位和校准后的可靠性分数；最后在推理阶段综合这些带置信度的证据。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在真实世界具身视频基准上，前沿视频推理模型在扰动下会掉15-30个百分点，Robust-TO用于缓解这一问题。但未给出具体模型规模、工具集合、基准名称和提升幅度，因此目前只能把它当作agent系统思路而非扎实的基座结论。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the tendency of video reasoning models to trust degraded frames—blurred, occluded, or glared—as if they were equally reliable, causing large robustness drops.
summary_en.importance: This is closer to a general tool-orchestrating agent for video understanding than to pretraining. Its main value is the explicit treatment of evidence reliability, which may modestly inform multimodal agent design or training-signal design, but it is far from core foundation-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: Robust-TO computes a reliability-relevance score per frame, selects trustworthy frames, decomposes the original query into sub-queries for heterogeneous visual tools, and aggregates tool outputs in a unified evidence format containing predictions, temporal grounding, and calibrated reliability scores.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims that frontier video reasoning models lose 15–30 percentage points on embodied benchmarks under perturbations, and that Robust-TO mitigates this. However, it does not provide model scale, tool inventory, benchmark names, or exact gains, so this currently reads more like an agent-system idea than a clean foundation-model result.

recommendation.zh: 有一点像把 uncertainty-aware routing 搬进多模态 agent；看问题设定即可，别把它误当成预训练方法论文。
recommendation.en: This is mildly interesting as uncertainty-aware routing for multimodal agents; read the setup, but do not mistake it for a pretraining paper.

paper.title: Ill-Posed by Design: Probing Evidence Use in VLMs
paper.abstract: Counterfactual analysis is widely used to study evidence use in vision-language models, but its diagnostic value is limited on well-posed tasks: when several cues independently support the same answer, removing one may not change the prediction. We propose monocular metric object-size estimation as an ill-posed diagnostic setting for evidence selection: because physical size cannot be determined from a single uncalibrated image, models must rely on imperfect cues category priors, target appearan

summary.core_problem: 这项工作把单目物体真实尺寸估计设计成一个 VLM 证据使用诊断任务，用来回答模型在视觉问答中到底依赖类别先验、目标像素、上下文、显著尺寸还是场景几何。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在评测方法，而不是模型训练。常规 VQA 或识别任务往往是良定问题，多个线索都能支持同一答案，遮掉一个线索后预测不变并不能说明模型没有用它。单目真实尺寸估计是欠定问题，单张未标定图像无法唯一确定物理尺度，因此模型必须在不完美证据之间做选择。这个设置更容易暴露 VLM 的视觉 grounding 是否真的进入了数值估计过程。结果显示，大模型规模并不自动带来几何线索使用能力，开源 VLM 在 in-the-wild split 上甚至落后于无图像输入的前沿文本 LLM，说明相当一部分性能来自类别和语言先验。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是构建 Metric VQA，并围绕六类证据通道做反事实干预。任务形式是给定一张 RGB 图像和自然语言尺寸问题，例如“这个微波炉多高”，要求模型输出厘米单位的单个浮点数。数据包含两个 split：Objectron 派生的 10,482 个查询，来自 3,494 帧、9 个日常类别、27 个 category-axis 查询模板，尺寸标签来自 3D bounding box；in-the-wild split 包含 70 张真实场景照片、331 个胶尺测量查询，覆盖杂乱背景、多物体、遮挡和复杂视角。评测时用确定性 regex 抽取第一个数值，无法解析记为 parse failure，并对大于 10^4 cm 的预测做截断以避免异常数值主导 MAE。反事实干预覆盖类别先验、目标像素、目标身份、局部上下文、图像中 apparent size、全局场景几何。这个设计的重点不是提高尺寸估计精度，而是通过干预前后预测漂移判断哪些证据是 load-bearing。工作还分析了监督 LoRA 微调，观察模型是否能通过任务训练获得新的几何使用能力。
summary.experiments: 实验评估了 12 个开源 VLM，参数规模从 3B 到 397B，并加入一个无图像输入的前沿文本 LLM 和人类参考。关键结论有三点。第一，在更接近真实场景的 in-the-wild split 上，即使是 Qwen3-VL-235B、InternVL3.5-241B、Qwen3.5-397B 这类大规模开源 VLM，也落后于只看文本问题的前沿 LLM。这说明模型在尺寸估计中大量依赖物体类别的常识分布。第二，干预签名呈现清晰分层：目标身份最稳定地影响预测；目标像素和局部上下文只被部分模型使用；apparent size 会改变预测，但方向不稳定，说明模型可能感知到图像尺度变化，却没有学到可靠的物理尺度映射；全局场景几何基本没有被有效使用。第三，LoRA 微调能提升任务表现，但提升主要来自放大基座模型已有的线索通道，例如目标身份、局部上下文或语言先验访问，而不是学会利用场景几何。这个结果对 VLM post-train 很有提示：任务分数上升不等于视觉几何机制改善。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 25–35 分钟。重点看 Benchmark and Setup，确认 Metric VQA 的标签来源、数值解析和两个 split 的差异；再看 counterfactual intervention 设计，尤其是六个证据通道如何被隔离。实验部分应重点看各模型在 Objectron 与 in-the-wild 上的差异、文本 LLM baseline 的位置、以及干预签名图。LoRA 分析值得单独看，因为它区分了“任务可学”和“学到新视觉机制”这两个容易混淆的问题。对预训练研究员来说，最有用的是这个评测范式：选择欠定任务，让模型无法只靠单一充分证据完成任务，从而更清楚地暴露训练数据和对齐阶段形成的先验。

summary_en.core_problem: The work uses monocular metric object-size estimation as a diagnostic setting for probing which evidence channels VLMs actually rely on: category priors, object pixels, object identity, local context, apparent image size, or global scene geometry.
summary_en.importance: The main value is in evaluation design rather than pretraining methodology. Standard VQA and recognition tasks are often well-posed: several cues can independently justify the same answer, so removing one cue may not change the prediction. Metric size estimation from a single uncalibrated image is underdetermined, forcing the model to fall back on imperfect cues. This makes counterfactual interventions more informative. The results are relevant for multimodal pretraining because they show that larger open-weight VLMs do not necessarily acquire usable geometric evidence selection, and that strong numeric answers can come from language and category priors rather than visual grounding.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors build Metric VQA, where each example contains an RGB image, a natural-language dimension query, and a ground-truth physical measurement in centimeters. The benchmark has 10,813 queries: 10,482 Objectron-derived queries from 3,494 frames across 9 everyday categories, using 3D bounding-box dimensions as labels, and 331 in-the-wild queries from 70 cluttered scenes with tape-measured ground truth. Model outputs are parsed with a deterministic regex that extracts the first numeric value; unparseable answers are counted as parse failures, and predictions above 10^4 cm are clipped for aggregate MAE. The key methodological contribution is a set of counterfactual interventions over six evidence channels: category priors, target pixels, target identity, local context, apparent image size, and global scene geometry. The paper also studies supervised LoRA fine-tuning to test whether task training makes the models learn new geometric cues or merely strengthens existing ones.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers 12 open-weight VLMs ranging from 3B to 397B parameters, plus a frontier text-only LLM without image access and a human reference. The strongest qualitative result is that on the in-the-wild split, even large open VLMs such as Qwen3-VL-235B, InternVL3.5-241B, and Qwen3.5-397B trail the text-only LLM. The intervention analysis shows a stratified pattern: target identity is consistently load-bearing; target pixels and local context are used only by some models; apparent image size shifts predictions but not in a directionally reliable way; global scene geometry is mostly unused. LoRA fine-tuning improves the task, but the gains come from enhancing evidence channels that the base model already partially uses, rather than from learning robust scene-geometry reasoning.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Read the benchmark construction and evaluation protocol first, especially the difference between Objectron and the in-the-wild split. Then focus on the counterfactual intervention definitions and the plots showing intervention signatures. The LoRA section is useful because it separates task learnability from the acquisition of new visual mechanisms. For pretraining-oriented readers, the main transferable idea is to use ill-posed tasks as diagnostic probes: they reduce cue redundancy and make evidence use easier to observe.

recommendation.zh: 把“证据使用”评测从 well-posed 拉到 ill-posed，反事实 probing 才有区分度；只看任务设计+证据通道分解，别把绝对分数当能力结论。
recommendation.en: Making the probe ill-posed is the real contribution—counterfactuals finally become discriminative; read the task design + evidence-channel decomposition, but don’t over-interpret raw scores as capability.

paper.title: A Multi-Domain Benchmark for Detecting AI-Generated Text-Rich Images from GPT-Image-2
paper.abstract: Text-rich images often contain privacy-sensitive, transactional, or decision-relevant information. As recent multimodal image generation models become increasingly capable of synthesizing realistic textual content and structured visual designs, detecting AI-generated text-rich images has become an important challenge for digital trust and content authenticity. Existing benchmarks, however, largely focus on object-centric images and provide limited coverage of scenarios where textual semantics an

summary.core_problem: 如何系统评测“文本密集型（text-rich）”图像的AI生成检测能力，尤其覆盖票据/表格/UI等以文字语义与版式为核心的场景。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是Benchmark：补齐现有生成图像检测评测偏“物体中心”而忽视“文字+布局”场景的空白；对多模态预训练/生成模型的内容可信与溯源评测有直接价值。
summary.technical_approach: 构建一个面向GPT-Image-2生成的多域数据集（6类：商业海报、信息图、学术海报、收据、表格、UI截图），并用该基准对5种代表性AI图像检测器做零样本评测；同时分析按类别的性能差异与后处理（如压缩/扰动）下的鲁棒性退化。
summary.experiments: 数据规模8602张、6个域；评测设置为zero-shot，对5个检测器报告总体与分域表现，并做后处理鲁棒性分析（摘要未给出具体模型名与数值提升幅度）。

summary_en.core_problem: How to benchmark detection of AI-generated text-rich images, where textual semantics and layout (receipts/tables/UI) dominate, rather than object-centric content.
summary_en.importance: Benchmark contribution: fills a gap in existing synthetic-image detection evaluations by targeting text-and-layout-heavy images; relevant to multimodal pretraining/generation trust and provenance evaluation.
summary_en.technical_approach: Build a multi-domain dataset of GPT-Image-2 generated images (6 categories) and evaluate five representative detectors in a zero-shot setting, including per-category breakdown and robustness under post-processing.
summary_en.experiments: 8,602 images across 6 domains; zero-shot evaluation of 5 detectors with overall/category-wise results and post-processing robustness analysis (no concrete detector names or numbers in the abstract).

recommendation.zh: 只把它当“评测资产补洞”：text-rich 场景确实缺基准，但只测 GPT-Image-2 且零样本，外推性存疑；看类别拆分与鲁棒性表就够。
recommendation.en: Treat it as a gap-filling eval asset for text-rich images; single-generator (GPT-Image-2) and zero-shot-only make generalization questionable—skim the per-category and robustness tables.

paper.title: Reinforcement learning towards broadly and persistently beneficial models
paper.abstract: Training targeting beneficial behavior in realistic scenarios produces broad improvements in alignment that generalize across domains and persist under adversarial pressure.

summary.core_problem: 这项工作问的是一个对 post-train 和 pretrain 接口都很关键的问题：对少量“有益行为特质”做强化学习，能否产生跨任务、跨领域、抗压力的对齐泛化，而不只是让模型学会通过训练集中的安全评测。它把问题从单个安全规则或单个 benchmark，推进到更抽象的行为特质层面，例如诚实、承认不确定性、可纠正性、元认知透明性、公平性、风险敏感性和对人类福祉的关切。
summary.importance: 贡献在于给出了一条与“emergent misalignment”相反方向的实验证据：窄域训练不一定只产生窄域效果，强化某些正向行为特质也可能带来广泛迁移。对预训练研究的影响主要在三点。第一，它提示模型内部可能存在较粗粒度的行为方向，RL 可以沿这些方向改变模型，而不只是拟合局部任务格式。第二，它说明 post-train 信号质量会反过来影响对基座能力与风险的判断，alignment eval 不能只看训练域内表现。第三，它为 future pretrain/posttrain co-design 提供了问题定义：预训练阶段是否能更早地塑造可纠正性、诚实表达不确定性、抗 reward hacking 等特质，而不是完全依赖后期 RL 修补。
summary.technical_approach: 方法不是简单做安全 SFT，而是在现实对话场景中构造用于测量和训练的 beneficial trait 数据。每个样本设计成带有压力、歧义或竞争激励的情境，测试模型是否能保持某种行为特质。领域覆盖健康、教育、科学、法律、工程、经济和商业等。训练时使用现实 post-training RL mixture：大部分仍是标准 RL 数据，只混入少量 beneficial trait 数据，并与从同一初始模型出发、使用相同 RL compute 的 baseline 比较。这个设计很重要，因为它避免把结果解释为“多给了一批安全数据”或“额外训练算力更大”。论文还做了更强的外推测试，例如训练时排除健康和科学样本，再看健康、医学、心理健康等评测是否仍有提升。持久性测试则通过 adversarial prompts 和 adversarial fine-tuning 观察模型是否更难被诱导到有害行为。
summary.experiments: 公开内容没有披露模型参数量、RL 算法细节、reward model 结构、数据条数或 token 规模。关键数字是：beneficial trait RL 模型在 53 个内部和外部 benchmark 中，有 44 个相对 compute-matched baseline 改善。这些评测覆盖 deception、honesty、reward hacking、latent safety risks、harmful agentic behavior、specification compliance、health 和 mental health。域内 held-out beneficial trait eval 上，模型在 truthfulness、corrigibility、metacognitive transparency 等特质上明显提升。更重要的是，独立评测也改善，且使用了不同任务、不同领域和不同打分方式。健康评测包括真实医学对话、医生编写 rubric、高置信医学错误；心理健康评测同时看不应提供的内容和有益支持。工作还报告，在对抗提示和对抗微调下，经过 beneficial trait RL 的模型更不容易转向有害行为。
summary.reading_guide: 需要精读，重点不是把它当作普通 alignment blog，而是看实验设计如何隔离“特质级 RL 是否能泛化”。优先看四处。第一，beneficial traits 的定义和样本构造方式，尤其是怎样把诚实、可纠正性、承认不确定性这类抽象属性落到具体对话。第二，训练 mixture 和 baseline 控制：同一起点、同等 RL compute、只改变少量 trait 数据，这是判断因果作用的关键。第三，53 个 benchmark 的分组结果，尤其是哪些类别提升、哪些没有提升；未提升项往往比平均趋势更能说明边界。第四，排除健康/科学后的迁移实验，以及 adversarial prompt/fine-tuning 下的持久性结果。需要追问的点包括：reward 是否引入 verbosity 或 refusal 偏差，trait 数据是否改变了 helpfulness/safety trade-off，持久性是否来自行为策略变稳还是来自更深层表示改变，以及这些 trait 是否可在 mid-training 或 continual pretraining 中提前注入。
summary.authors_note: OpenAI；公开内容未列出个人作者。背景上，这项工作延续了 OpenAI 对 emergent misalignment、reward hacking、deception、scheming 和高风险领域行为评测的研究线。

summary_en.core_problem: The work asks whether reinforcement learning on a small amount of data targeting beneficial behavioral traits can produce broad and persistent alignment generalization, rather than only teaching a model to pass the training distribution. The targeted traits include honesty, epistemic humility, metacognitive transparency, corrigibility, universal fairness, risk sensitivity, and concern for human welfare.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is empirical evidence for a positive counterpart to emergent misalignment. Narrow training on undesirable behaviors can generalize into broader misbehavior; this work studies whether RL on beneficial traits can also generalize broadly. For pretraining researchers, the important implication is that model behavior may contain relatively coarse directions that post-training can move, beyond local benchmark fitting. It also tightens the pretrain–posttrain interface: the quality and abstraction level of RL signals can change how base-model capabilities and risks are expressed, and some alignment-relevant traits may be candidates for earlier shaping during mid-training, continual pretraining, or data-mixture design.
summary_en.technical_approach: The approach builds a synthetic dataset of realistic conversations designed to test beneficial traits under ambiguity, pressure, or competing incentives. The scenarios span health, education, science, law, engineering, economics, business, and other applied settings. The model is trained with a realistic RL post-training mixture, where most of the data remains standard RL data and only a small fraction targets these beneficial traits. The comparison is compute-matched: models start from the same checkpoint and receive the same amount of RL compute. This design is important because it makes the trait data, rather than extra optimization or a different starting point, the main intervention. The work also tests stronger out-of-domain transfer by excluding health and science examples during training and then evaluating on health, medical, and mental-health tasks. Persistence is tested with adversarial prompts and adversarial fine-tuning.
summary_en.experiments: The public write-up does not disclose parameter counts, data size, token count, RL algorithm details, or reward-model architecture. The key reported number is that the beneficial-trait RL model improves over the compute-matched baseline on 44 out of 53 internal and external benchmarks. These benchmarks cover deception, honesty, reward hacking, latent safety risks, harmful agentic behavior, specification compliance, health, mental health, and related safety-relevant behaviors. On held-out in-distribution beneficial-trait evaluations, the model improves on traits such as truthfulness, corrigibility, and metacognitive transparency. The more informative result is transfer to independently constructed evaluations with different domains, tasks, and grading setups. Reported health evaluations include realistic medical conversations, physician-written rubrics, and high-confidence medical errors. Mental-health evaluations measure both disallowed content and beneficial support. The model is also reported to be harder to steer toward harmful behavior through adversarial prompting or fine-tuning.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read it closely as an experiment about trait-level RL generalization, not just as an alignment announcement. Focus first on how the beneficial traits are operationalized into conversation data. Then inspect the training mixture and the compute-matched baseline controls, because they determine whether the results can be attributed to the trait intervention. The benchmark breakdown across 53 evaluations is the central evidence; categories that do not improve are especially important for understanding the boundary of the effect. The health/science exclusion experiment is useful for judging domain transfer. The adversarial prompting and fine-tuning results are useful for judging persistence. Open questions to track are whether the reward signal induces verbosity or over-refusal, how helpfulness and safety trade off, whether persistence reflects a stable behavioral policy or a deeper representation shift, and whether similar traits can be shaped during mid-training or continual pretraining.
summary_en.authors_note: OpenAI; individual authors are not specified in the provided public content. The work sits in OpenAI's broader line of research on emergent misalignment, reward hacking, deception, scheming, and behavior under pressure in high-stakes settings.

recommendation.zh: OpenAI 的信号值得记录，但技术细节不足；重点看他们如何定义 persistent benefit 和 adversarial pressure。
recommendation.en: The OpenAI signal is worth logging, but details are thin; focus on how they define persistent benefit and adversarial pressure.

paper.title: ChLogic: Evaluating Robustness of Logical Reasoning in Chinese Expressions
paper.abstract: Large language models perform increasingly well on standardized logical reasoning benchmarks, but whether this ability remains robust beyond English is unclear. We introduce ChLogic, an English--Chinese aligned benchmark that tests whether models preserve logical reasoning performance when the same latent logical structure is expressed in English and diverse Chinese surface realizations. Built from formal logical templates, the benchmark contains three data sets: (i) the General aligned set, der

summary.core_problem: 评估大语言模型在同一逻辑结构被英语和多种中文表达承载时，推理能力是否稳定迁移。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多语言逻辑推理评测资产。它把形式逻辑模板、英中对齐表达和中文特有语言现象放在一起，能暴露标准英文逻辑 benchmark 掩盖的语言表层敏感性。
summary.technical_approach: 构建 ChLogic：用形式逻辑模板生成英中对齐样本，每个对齐题包含一个英文参考表达和五个中文实现；数据分为 General aligned、Difficult aligned 和 Chinese-only 三部分，其中中文单语部分覆盖 15 类中文特有现象。实验还测试了把中文回译成英文后的性能变化，用来判断模型是否依赖英文表达空间。
summary.experiments: 评测 Qwen3、Ministral 和 GLM 系列模型。结果显示英中之间存在稳定性能差距；在 General aligned 集上，把标准中文回译为英文常能提升表现，说明模型对逻辑结构的处理受表达语言影响。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether LLMs preserve logical reasoning ability when the same latent logical structure is expressed in English and in varied Chinese surface forms.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is an evaluation benchmark for multilingual logical robustness. By pairing formal logic templates with aligned English-Chinese expressions and Chinese-specific phenomena, it probes failures that English-centric reasoning benchmarks tend to hide.
summary_en.technical_approach: ChLogic is built from formal templates and contains three subsets: a General aligned set from 60 general propositions across nine template families, a Difficult aligned set from 40 difficult problems, and a Chinese-only set covering 15 language-specific phenomenon types. Each aligned instance has one English reference and five Chinese realizations. The study also uses back-translation into English as a diagnostic intervention.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark is evaluated on Qwen3, Ministral, and GLM models. The main finding is a persistent English-Chinese performance gap; back-translating standard Chinese into English often improves performance on the General aligned set.

recommendation.zh: 作为中文逻辑鲁棒性 eval 备查即可；看数据构造和回译实验，不需要细读模型排名。
recommendation.en: Keep it as a Chinese logical-robustness eval reference; read the data construction and back-translation diagnostic, not the leaderboard.

paper.title: KVEraser: Learning to Steer KV Cache for Efficient Localized Context Erasing
paper.abstract: Post-hoc context erasing over the KV cache is challenging because a local edit has a global consequence: once a span has been processed, its influence propagates into the cached states of all subsequent tokens. This issue arises naturally in long-context LLM applications, where stale retrieved facts, incorrect tool observations, retracted user preferences, or harmful prompt injections may be identified only after prefill. Exact erasing must then recompute all tokens after the deleted span, makin

summary.core_problem: 在不重算后缀token的前提下，实现对已prefill上下文中某一局部span的“精确/近似精确”删除，使其不再影响后续生成。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理侧新能力+训练方法：把“KV cache不可逆”这个长上下文系统痛点变成可学习的cache编辑问题；对RAG纠错、prompt注入清除、偏好撤回等场景是硬需求。
summary.technical_approach: 提出KVEraser：给定已处理上下文与待删除span，仅替换该区间的KV状态为学习到的steering states，同时复用其余cache不变；用两阶段训练获得可迁移的擦除机制：先做通用的span-neighbor预训练（学会在局部扰动下保持邻域一致性/可控影响），再做面向任务/分布的训练以提升实际擦除效果与泛化。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模与基线细节；核心对比应是“重算后缀”(exact recompute)与“直接剪掉/置零KV”等朴素cache编辑，指标应同时看擦除正确性与计算量随suffix长度的缩放（论文正文应有）。
summary.authors_note: Meta, Georgia Institute of Technology

summary_en.core_problem: Erase the influence of a localized span in an already-prefilled context without recomputing the entire suffix, by editing KV cache states directly.
summary_en.importance: Inference-time capability + training recipe: reframes KV-cache irreversibility as a learnable cache-editing problem, directly relevant to long-context systems (RAG corrections, prompt-injection removal, preference retraction).
summary_en.technical_approach: KVEraser replaces only the KV states within the erased interval with learned steering states while reusing the rest of the cache unchanged; a two-stage training pipeline (generic span-neighbor pretraining, then task/distribution-focused training) aims for transferability and robust erasing.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract omits model sizes and baselines; the key comparison should be against exact suffix recomputation and naive KV edits, measuring erasing fidelity and compute scaling with suffix length (expected in the paper).
summary_en.authors_note: Meta, Georgia Institute of Technology

recommendation.zh: 这是少见的“KV可编辑”方向：如果结果干净，会改变长上下文系统必须重算后缀的默认假设，建议优先复现其擦除保真度曲线。
recommendation.en: A rare 'editable KV-cache' paper—if the eval is clean, it breaks the default assumption that suffix recompute is unavoidable; prioritize reproducing the erasure-fidelity vs compute curves.

paper.title: Emergent retokenization symmetry in large language models: phenomenology and applications
paper.abstract: Tokenization introduces representational redundancy: under a fixed token vocabulary, every byte string admits many valid token encodings, or segmentations, that decode to the same surface string. However, given a prompt, most language model tokenizers break this representational symmetry by returning a canonical segmentation. Training only on canonical segmentations should influence inference behavior, and there is little reason to expect models to respect segmentation symmetry on downstream tas

summary.core_problem: 固定词表下，同一段字节串可以被分成多种等价token序列（不同分词但解码回同一字符串）。训练时通常只见到canonical分词，理论上模型不必对“分词等价类”保持不变性。论文要回答：这种retokenization symmetry是否会在预训练/后训练中自发涌现？涌现到什么程度？它在机制层面意味着什么，以及能否作为一种推理时干预带来可用的多样性与性能收益。
summary.importance:
对预训练与tokenizer研究的启发主要有三点：
1）把tokenization问题从“脆弱性/坏例子”推进到“对称性是否涌现、涌现速度如何”的可测量对象，能直接连接到训练动态与表示学习。
2）提出retokenization作为一种很干净的干预：不改字节串、不引入新token、不改变任务语义，只改变计算图的离散化粒度与token边界，从而更容易把‘语义变化’与‘表示变化’分离。
3）给出一个可用的推理技巧Retokenization Sampling：用输入表示的多样性替代输出采样噪声，定义pass@retok(k)来量化收益。这对“有限计算下的轨迹选择/推理多样性”也有连接价值。
summary.technical_approach:
核心设定：对同一字节串s，定义canonical编码E^0(s)与任意等价分词E^μ(s)。在不改变字符串的前提下，系统性采样多种E^μ(s)作为输入扰动。
方法分两类：
- 机制探针：比较不同分词下的hidden state变化、表示多样性与分词敏感性，刻画“近似不变性 + 残余敏感性”的共存。
- 行为评测：提出Retokenization Sampling。对同一prompt采样k种分词，各自做greedy decoding（强调不是靠temperature带来的随机性），用pass@retok(k)汇总成功率曲线，类比pass@k但多样性来源是输入表示。
论文还把这一现象放到训练过程里观察：在OLMo-2的预训练与后训练阶段，字节级理解（支撑分词对称性）是逐步学出来的，而不是天然具备。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖HumanEval、GSM8K、GSM8K Python、MMLU等，主要结论是：
- 等价分词通常不会“破坏任务”，模型往往仍能理解；但不同分词会带来非平凡的输出差异，说明对称性不完全。
- 用retokenization带来的输入多样性，可以在若干任务上形成类似pass@k的收益曲线（以pass@retok(k)度量），即使解码是greedy。
- 在OLMo-2的训练轨迹上，分词对称性/字节级理解呈渐进涌现。
（注：你提供的全文片段未包含各基准的具体提升数字、k取值与统计显著性细节；若要写到精确数值，需要补充结果表与实验设置段落。）
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（预计30-45分钟拿到主要信息）：
- 先看任务定义与符号：E^0(s)、E^μ(s)、以及为什么retokenization比paraphrase更“干净”。
- 重点看Retokenization Sampling与pass@retok(k)的定义与实验曲线：它到底提供了多少多样性，和常规输出采样相比有什么不同。
- 若关心机制，挑一两个hidden-state/representation分析图看“近似不变性”体现在哪些层、哪些token位置最敏感。
- 若关心训练动态，找OLMo-2在pretrain/post-train阶段的对比：对称性是在哪个阶段明显增强的，这会影响是否要在预训练中引入stochastic tokenization或其他正则。

summary_en.core_problem: Under a fixed vocabulary, the same byte string admits many equivalent token segmentations. Training typically uses only the canonical segmentation, so invariance to retokenization is not guaranteed. The paper asks whether an approximate “retokenization symmetry” nevertheless emerges during pretraining/post-training, how it coexists with residual segmentation sensitivity, and whether retokenization can be exploited at inference time to produce useful diversity without changing the surface string.
summary_en.importance:
Three concrete contributions for pretraining/tokenizer research:
1) It turns tokenization brittleness into a measurable symmetry–sensitivity tradeoff that can be tracked over training, tying tokenizer choices to representation learning dynamics.
2) Retokenization is a particularly clean intervention: bytes are unchanged, no new tokens are introduced, and task semantics are largely preserved—only the computational granularity and token boundaries change.
3) It introduces Retokenization Sampling and pass@retok(k), a practical inference-time knob where diversity comes from input representation rather than output randomness, connecting to views of reasoning as compute-bounded trajectory selection.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Setup: for a byte-level prompt s, define the canonical encoding E^0(s) and alternative valid segmentations E^μ(s) under the same vocabulary. Sample retokenizations as controlled input perturbations.
Two evaluation modes:
- Mechanistic probing: compare hidden states/representations across equivalent segmentations to quantify partial invariance and where sensitivity remains.
- Behavioral evaluation: Retokenization Sampling—sample k segmentations, run greedy decoding from each, and summarize success via pass@retok(k), analogous to pass@k but with diversity sourced from input segmentation.
The paper also tracks this phenomenon across training stages (notably OLMo-2 pretraining and post-training), arguing that byte-level understanding supporting symmetry is learned gradually.
summary_en.experiments:
Benchmarks include HumanEval, GSM8K, GSM8K Python, and MMLU. Reported qualitative findings:
- Equivalent segmentations usually preserve task identity (retokenization does not simply corrupt prompts), yet produce non-trivial output diversity, indicating symmetry is approximate.
- pass@retok(k) curves show that input-segmentation diversity can yield measurable gains even with greedy decoding.
- Along OLMo-2 training, retokenization robustness/byte-level understanding strengthens over time.
(Note: the provided excerpt does not include the numeric tables and exact k/variance details; those require the missing results sections.)
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (30–45 minutes):
- Read the formal definition of retokenization (E^0 vs E^μ) and the argument for why it is cleaner than paraphrasing.
- Focus on Retokenization Sampling and pass@retok(k): how diversity is generated, and how it compares to conventional output sampling.
- If you care about mechanisms, inspect one or two representation/hidden-state analyses to see where invariance holds and where it breaks.
- If you care about training dynamics, locate the OLMo-2 pretrain vs post-train comparisons to understand when symmetry emerges; this informs whether to add stochastic tokenization or other regularizers during pretraining.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不直接给新方法，但会改变你看 tokenizer artifact 的方式；先读 retokenization 设定和现象图，若你做 tokenizer/byte fallback，值得立刻加进内部 probe。
recommendation.en: It does not hand you a new method, but it should change how you think about tokenizer artifacts; read the retokenization setup and the main phenomenon plots, and add this probe if you work on tokenization or byte fallback.

paper.title: LLMs Contain Multitudes: How Deployment Context Reshapes Model-Level Preferences and Values
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly characterised in recent evaluation work as having stable, model-level preference and value systems. However, accompanying robustness checks are limited to incidental prompt perturbations such as syntax variation and option reordering. This leaves open whether the measured properties survive when the surrounding task context changes, as it does in most real deployments. We test this directly across two established pairwise paradigms: ranking country p

summary.core_problem: LLM 在“价值/偏好”评测中是否真的存在稳定的模型级偏好，还是会被部署任务语境（高层 framing）显著改写？
summary.importance: 指出当前价值/偏好评测的鲁棒性检查过于局限（只做轻微 prompt 扰动），而真实部署中的任务语境变化会带来更大分布移位；对“模型有稳定价值观”的常见叙事提出实证挑战。
summary.technical_approach: 在两类成对比较范式（国家偏好排序、效用判断）中，把“部署语境/任务 framing”作为唯一受控变量（如写 Reddit 帖/写新闻稿等），并与 prompt 改写、选项重排、temperature 等常见扰动对比，统计跨模型的大规模 pairwise 决策差异。
summary.experiments: 覆盖 5 个 LLM、总计 120 万+ pairwise decisions；结论是语境导致的偏好/效用变化幅度显著大于 prompt paraphrase 与温度控制；国家偏好任务在 15 国排序上出现大幅重排（摘要未给出完整数值细节）。

summary_en.core_problem: Are LLM “values/preferences” stable at the model level, or do they shift substantially with deployment context (high-level task framing)?
summary_en.importance: Shows that common robustness checks in value/preference evaluations (minor prompt perturbations) miss a larger source of variation: deployment framing; challenges the narrative of stable, model-level value systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: Uses two pairwise paradigms (country preference ranking, utility judgments) and treats deployment context as the controlled variable (e.g., writing a Reddit post vs a news article), comparing its effect size against paraphrasing, option reordering, and temperature changes.
summary_en.experiments: 5 LLMs, 1.2M+ pairwise decisions; finds context-induced variation far larger than paraphrase/temperature controls; large reorderings in 15-country rankings (full numeric details not in the abstract).

recommendation.zh: 把“价值观评测”当成稳定属性的前提被它直接打脸；只需看效应量对比（context vs paraphrase/temperature）来校准你对对齐评测的信心。
recommendation.en: It undercuts the “stable values” assumption with a simple but high-powered context ablation; just read the effect-size comparisons (context vs paraphrase/temperature) to recalibrate trust in alignment evals.

paper.title: Does AI Reviewer See the Full Picture? Attacking and Defending Multimodal Peer Review
paper.abstract: The integration of Large Language Models (LLMs) and Multimodal LLMs (MLLMs) into scientific peer-review workflows introduces novel and significant risks for adversarial manipulation, especially given the multimodal nature of scientific papers where figures, not just text, convey core evidence. This creates a significant gap: current robustness studies on AI peer-review are overwhelmingly text-only. Moreover, the problem is distinct from standard jailbreaking, as a peer-review attack seeks to ind

summary.core_problem: 解决 AI/MLLM 参与论文评审时，图文混合输入可被跨模态对抗操纵、而现有研究几乎只覆盖文本攻击的问题。
summary.importance: 这是评测与鲁棒性基准工作。对基座预训练本身不直接给 recipe，但对多模态模型的安全评测、跨模态脆弱性和 judge/model-as-reviewer 可靠性有现实参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 PaperGuard，包含三部分：多学科的 multimodal peer-review 数据集；统一的跨模态攻击套件，用于诱导特定评审失效，如抬高分数；以及相应防御机制与评测协议。重点不是通用 jailbreak，而是面向 peer-review 这种目标明确、领域约束强的 targeted failure。
summary.experiments: 摘要表明其在多模态 peer-review 场景下系统评估攻击与防御，但未给出具体模型、样本规模和数值结果。若实验设计扎实，价值主要在 benchmark/protocol，而不是方法本身。
summary.authors_note: The University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill、Arizona State University。Tianlong Chen 在高效训练、鲁棒性和模型系统方向较活跃。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the risk that LLM/MLLM-based peer review can be manipulated through cross-modal attacks, while existing robustness studies are largely text-only.
summary_en.importance: This is an evaluation and robustness benchmark paper. It does not directly change pretraining recipes, but it is relevant for multimodal safety evaluation, cross-modal brittleness, and the reliability of model-as-reviewer systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors introduce PaperGuard, built around three components: a multimodal peer-review dataset spanning scientific domains, a unified suite of cross-modal attacks designed to induce targeted review failures such as score inflation, and corresponding defenses plus evaluation protocols. The focus is not generic jailbreaking but domain-specific targeted failures in peer review.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract indicates a systematic evaluation of attacks and defenses in multimodal peer-review settings, but does not provide model names, dataset scale, or quantitative results. If the setup is solid, the main value lies in the benchmark and protocol rather than a new modeling method.
summary_en.authors_note: The University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill and Arizona State University. Tianlong Chen is active in efficient training, robustness, and model systems.

recommendation.zh: 和预训练关系不深，但如果你关心 multimodal judge 或 model-as-evaluator 的脆弱性，只看 benchmark 设计与攻击 taxonomy 就够了。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but if you care about multimodal judges or model-as-evaluator brittleness, the benchmark design and attack taxonomy are the only parts worth your time.

institutions: The University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill

paper.title: When Does Language Matter? Multilingual Instructions Reveal Step-wise Language Sensitivity in Vision-Language-Action Models
paper.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown strong performance in language-conditioned robotic manipulation, yet their robustness to linguistic variation remains poorly understood. In this work, we present the first systematic multilingual evaluation of VLA models by translating the LIBERO benchmark into ten languages, revealing severe performance degradation under non-English instructions, with success rates dropping by 30-50%. Through fine-grained analysis of task executions, we find that l

summary.core_problem: 系统分析视觉-语言-动作模型在多语言指令下何时失效，并定位语言敏感性是否集中在任务执行的特定步骤。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是评测与诊断：把 LIBERO 扩展到十种语言，并提出 step-wise 语言敏感性分析。对多模态统一预训练和 instruction robustness 有间接启发，但不是基座训练论文。
summary.technical_approach: 将 LIBERO benchmark 翻译为十种语言，做细粒度步骤级执行分析，发现语言影响在不同步骤上高度不均匀；据此提出一种 inference-time step-wise intervention，根据步骤的语言敏感性对表示进行对齐。
summary.experiments: 在 VLA 模型上，多语言指令会导致 30%-50% 的成功率下降。所提步骤级干预能显著缓解非英语指令下的性能退化。摘要未给出具体模型名称和提升绝对值，但诊断信号比较清楚。
summary.authors_note: 哈尔滨工业大学团队，工作更偏 VLA 评测与鲁棒性分析。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper systematically studies when vision-language-action models fail under multilingual instructions, and whether language sensitivity concentrates on specific execution steps.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is evaluation and diagnosis: LIBERO is translated into ten languages, and step-wise language sensitivity is analyzed. It has indirect value for multimodal pretraining and instruction robustness, but it is not a foundation-training paper.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors build a multilingual version of the LIBERO benchmark, perform fine-grained step-level execution analysis, and show that language effects are highly non-uniform across steps. Based on this, they propose an inference-time step-wise intervention that aligns representations according to step language sensitivity.
summary_en.experiments: On VLA models, non-English instructions reduce success rates by 30% to 50%. The proposed step-wise intervention substantially recovers performance under multilingual variation. The abstract does not list exact model names or absolute gains, but the diagnostic signal is clear.
summary_en.authors_note: The work is from Harbin Institute of Technology and is primarily about VLA evaluation and robustness analysis.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但“语言影响集中在少数关键步骤”这个诊断值得记住；做多模态统一训练时，可把它当 error attribution 的线索。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the finding that language sensitivity concentrates in a few critical steps is worth keeping in mind for multimodal error attribution.

paper.title: When Context Returns: Toward Robust Internalization in On-Policy Distillation
paper.abstract: Recent work has shown that on-policy distillation can internalize privileged context, such as system prompts or task hints, into a student model so that the context is no longer needed at inference time. Although this approach successfully improves the student's no-context performance, we identify an interesting and previously unstudied phenomenon: in many settings, reintroducing the original privileged context to the distilled student actually degrades its performance, even on instances it alre

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究的是 on-policy distillation 里一个很容易被忽略的问题：学生模型把特权上下文 internalize 之后，推理时去掉上下文确实能变强，但如果把原来的上下文重新加回来，性能反而常常下降。作者把这个现象叫 context-induced degradation。更准确地说，现有目标只优化“无上下文学生要模仿有上下文教师”，却没有约束学生在“有上下文视角”下的行为，因此 internalization 可能只是把一条路径训好了，而不是让上下文真正变成冗余信息。论文提出的核心要求是 context removability：如果知识真的被吸收到参数里，那么上下文重新出现时，模型行为不应被破坏。
summary.importance: 这项工作对预训练本身不是直接贡献，但对 pretrain 与 post-train 的接口很有启发，尤其是 context distillation、system prompt internalization、CoT 蒸馏和带 scaffold 的 on-policy 训练。它指出一个常见误区：把外部提示蒸馏进模型，不等于模型学会了“稳定地拥有这份能力”。如果训练目标只看 no-context 路径，模型可能学到一种脆弱的补偿机制，而不是形成真正可重入、可移除的内部表征。这个判断对后续做 reasoning distillation、tool-use scaffold distillation、甚至 RL 中的 privileged information training 都有参考价值。贡献量级属于训练目标层面的明确修正，方法很小，但问题定义很扎实。
summary.technical_approach:
作者先把问题形式化成两个 student view：q_x = gθ(y|x) 和 q_c = gθ(y|x,c)。标准 on-policy distillation with privileged context 只最小化无上下文学生 q_x 与有上下文教师 f(y|x,c) 之间的 KL，因此只保证 privileged fidelity，不保证 q_x 和 q_c 一致。

基于这个观察，论文提出 No-Context Anchoring, NCA。做法很简单：把学生在无上下文下的输出分布当作 stop-gradient anchor，再对学生有上下文视角的输出加一个 consistency KL，惩罚 q_c 偏离 q_x。直观上，这是在告诉模型：上下文可以帮助你学，但一旦你已经学会了，它重新出现时不该把你推到另一个行为模式里。

这个设计有几个值得注意的点。第一，anchor 选 no-context 而不是 context-conditioned teacher。原因是部署目标本来就是无上下文推理，作者希望把已经 internalized 的路径当成主路径，再把有上下文视角拉回这条路径，而不是反过来。第二，使用 stop-gradient 很关键，否则两个视角可能互相拖拽，削弱主目标。第三，它只增加一次额外 forward pass，训练代价相对温和。

论文还提出了一个概念区分：privileged fidelity 解决的是“学生无上下文时能否达到教师有上下文时的能力”，而 context removability 解决的是“上下文是否已经变成真正冗余的信息”。这两个目标并不等价。作者进一步用表示分析说明，NCA 不只是让输出更像，而是让有无上下文时的 hidden states 也更接近，说明它在一定程度上改变了内部表征，而不是只做表层校正。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖 12 个配置，跨不同领域和模型家族。核心结果有三条。第一，context-induced degradation 很常见，多数设置里重新加入上下文会让准确率下降，并且生成长度膨胀。作者把设置分成三类，其中 Regime A 占 7/12：学生无上下文已经做得不错，但一加上下文就被扰动，出现明显 accuracy drop 和 harm rate。第二，NCA 在 11/12 个设置里降低了这种 harm，并在多数设置里提升了 context-conditioned accuracy。第三，它基本消除了 response-length inflation，而且在不少设置里连 no-context performance 也一起改善，这一点很关键，因为 no-context 才是原始训练目标。

论文还定义了 Harm = P(q_c wrong | q_x correct)，这个指标比单纯 accuracy drop 更有信息量，因为它直接衡量“原本答对的样本被上下文重新弄错”的概率。机制分析部分显示，加入 NCA 后，有无上下文两条路径的表示更接近，支持作者关于 context removability 的论点。

从可读到的内容看，这篇论文的亮点不在大规模数字，而在问题诊断和指标设计。它把“蒸馏成功”拆成了两个不同维度，并证明只优化其中一个会留下明显缺口。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时先看 Introduction 和 Problem Formulation，把 privileged fidelity、context removability、harm 这几个概念吃透。然后直接看 Figure 1 和 Figure 2，理解 12 个设置里三种 regime 的分布，这会决定你是否认同作者的问题定义。方法部分重点看 NCA 的目标式，尤其是为什么用 no-context output 做 stop-gradient anchor。实验部分建议优先看 harm、accuracy、response length 三类结果，再看 mechanistic analysis，确认它不是单纯把输出校平。预计 30 分钟左右能抓住主线；如果你做 CoT distillation、system prompt internalization 或 privileged RL，值得再细看附录里的不同任务设置和失败案例。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a failure mode in on-policy distillation with privileged context. A student can learn to perform well without the context at inference time, yet when the original context is reintroduced, performance often gets worse rather than staying unchanged. The authors call this context-induced degradation. Their claim is that standard objectives only optimize one side of the problem: the no-context student should match the context-conditioned teacher. That does not guarantee that the student has truly internalized the privileged information in a stable way. For robust internalization, the context should become removable: adding it back should be behaviorally harmless.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper in the narrow sense, but it is highly relevant to the pretrain-posttrain interface. The result matters for context distillation, system-prompt internalization, chain-of-thought distillation, and any training setup where privileged information is available during learning but absent at deployment. The main lesson is subtle and important: good no-context performance does not imply that the model has formed a stable internal representation of the privileged signal. It may instead have learned a brittle compensation path. The contribution is a clean correction to the training objective, with a small method and a well-motivated problem definition.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper formalizes two student views: q_x = g_theta(y|x) and q_c = g_theta(y|x,c). Standard on-policy distillation with privileged context minimizes a KL from the teacher f(y|x,c) to the no-context student q_x. This enforces what the paper calls privileged fidelity, but it leaves q_c unconstrained.

To address this, the authors propose No-Context Anchoring (NCA). The no-context student output is treated as a stop-gradient anchor, and an additional consistency KL penalizes deviation of the context-conditioned student view q_c from q_x. The intuition is simple: if the privileged information has already been absorbed into the parameters, then reintroducing the context should not push the model into a different behavioral mode.

A few design choices matter. The anchor is the no-context student, not the teacher, because the deployment target is the no-context pathway. Stop-gradient is also important; otherwise the two views could co-adapt and weaken the primary objective. The method only requires one extra forward pass per step, so the overhead is modest.

Conceptually, the paper separates two goals that are often conflated. Privileged fidelity asks whether the no-context student can match the teacher with context. Context removability asks whether the context has become genuinely redundant. The paper argues, and empirically shows, that the first does not imply the second. Representation-level analysis further suggests that NCA changes internal states, not just final-token behavior.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments span 12 configurations across different domains and model families. Three findings stand out. First, context-induced degradation is common. In most settings, adding the original context back hurts accuracy and inflates response length. The authors identify three regimes, with Regime A covering 7 of 12 settings: the no-context student already performs well, but the context acts as a perturbation and causes both accuracy loss and high harm.

Second, NCA reduces this harm in 11 of 12 settings and improves context-conditioned accuracy in the majority of cases. Third, it largely removes response-length inflation and, in many settings, even improves no-context performance, which is the main training objective.

The paper also introduces a useful metric, Harm = P(q_c wrong | q_x correct), which is more diagnostic than raw accuracy drop because it directly measures how often context flips a previously correct prediction into an incorrect one. The mechanistic analysis shows that NCA makes hidden representations more similar between the context and no-context views, supporting the claim that it improves removability at the representation level as well.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with the introduction and problem formulation. The key concepts are privileged fidelity, context removability, and harm. Then look at Figure 1 and Figure 2 to understand how widespread the failure mode is and how the 12 settings fall into different regimes. In the method section, focus on the NCA objective and why the no-context output is used as a stop-gradient anchor. In the experiments, prioritize the tables or plots on harm, accuracy, and response length, then read the mechanistic analysis to see whether the effect is only output-level or also representational. A 30-minute skim should be enough for the main story. If you work on CoT distillation, system-prompt internalization, or privileged-information training, the appendix is worth reading for task-specific setups and edge cases.

recommendation.zh: 指出了蒸馏模型对 context 敏感的退化现象，提出的正则化 loss 对做 SFT/RL 蒸馏的同学有参考价值。
recommendation.en: Highlights context-induced degradation in distilled models; the proposed regularization loss is a useful reference for those working on SFT/RL distillation.

paper.title: Muon Learns More Robust and Transferable Features than Adam
paper.abstract: Muon has recently emerged as a state-of-the-art optimizer for pretraining Large Language Models (LLMs) and vision classifiers. Despite its efficiency advantage over Adam and SGD, the feature-learning advantage of Muon remains unclear. This paper investigates Muon's feature-learning advantage through the lens of robustness and transferability. First, by evaluating pretrained models on corrupted images and texts, we show that features learned by Muon are consistently more robust than those learned

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作想回答一个在优化器讨论里一直悬而未决的问题：Muon 相比 Adam 不只是更省步数或更稳，它是否真的学到了更鲁棒、也更可迁移的表征。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究员的价值不在于又多了一个优化器，而在于它试图把优化器差异从“训练 loss/吞吐”推进到“表征质量”。如果结论站得住，优化器选择就不只是工程配方问题，而会影响预训练特征的下游寿命、鲁棒性和迁移效率，属于训练 recipe 层面的有用信号。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上不是提出新优化器，而是对 Muon、Adam、SGD 做表征层面的对比分析。作者从两个角度测量：一是对图像和文本扰动数据的鲁棒性评估，二是用线性探针和全量微调测试迁移性。进一步，他们训练逐层 probe，观察不同层的 logit margin，主张 Muon 的优势体现在更大的层内分类间隔，这可能解释其更强的抗扰动和迁移表现。
summary.experiments: 摘要显示实验覆盖 transformer 和 CNN 两类架构，并同时在图像与文本上比较 Muon、Adam、SGD。评估包括 corrupted inputs 上的鲁棒性、从预训练参数出发的线性分类与全量微调迁移效果，以及 layer-wise probe 的 margin 分析。摘要没有给出具体模型规模、数据集名称和提升幅度，因此现阶段更像是一个值得核查 setup 干净度的分析论文，而不是可直接采纳的 recipe 结论。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a question that optimizer papers often leave unresolved: beyond speed or stability, does Muon actually learn more robust and more transferable features than Adam?
summary_en.importance: Its value for pretraining researchers is not that it introduces yet another optimizer, but that it pushes the comparison from training loss and throughput to representation quality. If the claim holds, optimizer choice affects downstream feature lifetime, robustness, and transfer, not just engineering efficiency.
summary_en.technical_approach: This is an analysis paper rather than a new optimizer proposal. It compares Muon, Adam, and SGD through two lenses: robustness under corrupted image/text inputs, and transferability via linear probing and full fine-tuning from pretrained checkpoints. The authors also train layer-wise probes and inspect logit margins, arguing that Muon yields larger margins across layers, which may explain both robustness and transfer gains.
summary_en.experiments: According to the abstract, experiments span both transformers and CNNs, and cover image as well as text settings. Evaluations include corruption robustness, downstream transfer from pretrained parameters with linear heads or full fine-tuning, and layer-wise margin analysis. The abstract does not provide model sizes, datasets, or effect sizes, so this currently reads as a useful but verification-heavy analysis rather than a recipe you would adopt immediately.

recommendation.zh: 如果你在评估 Muon 值不值得进预训练主配方，这篇该看；先盯鲁棒性和 layer-wise margin 那几张表，结论有意思，但没有大规模 LLM clean setup 前别急着改 prior。
recommendation.en: Read this if you're deciding whether Muon belongs in the core pretraining recipe; focus on the robustness and layer-wise margin evidence, but don't update your prior until you see a clean large-LLM setup.

paper.title: Reliable to Expressive: A Curriculum for Rubric-Following Safety Judges
paper.abstract: Safety judges are increasingly deployed to evaluate model outputs against evolving criteria, yet recent meta-evaluation work shows they remain brittle under prompt and rubric variation, with false negative-rate swings of up to 0.24 reported for stylistic perturbations alone. We argue that safety judgment is fundamentally a rubric-following problem: a robust judge must apply the given evaluation criteria consistently across rubric formulations rather than memorize one specific template. We propos

summary.core_problem: 如何解决 Safety Judge（安全评估模型）在面对 prompt 和 rubric（评分标准）变化时表现出的脆弱性（如假阴性率大幅波动）？
summary.importance: 将安全评估重新定义为 Rubric-following 问题，并提出了一种结合动态 Rubric 和课程学习的训练策略，显著提升了 Judge 模型的鲁棒性和泛化能力。
summary.technical_approach: 提出两点策略：1) 实例条件下的动态 Rubric 生成：从 prompt-response-label 三元组生成动态 Rubric，让模型暴露于多变的评估标准中；2) Reliable-to-expressive 课程学习：先用干净的固定 Rubric 数据进行监督训练，再逐步引入噪声更大的动态 Rubric 数据。
summary.experiments: 在一个 12B 参数的模型上进行实验，在单一的人工标注集上，使用三种不同的 Rubric prompt（HarmBench 风格、ShieldGemma 风格和特定领域 Rubric）进行评估，验证了方法的有效性。

summary_en.core_problem: How to address the brittleness of safety judges (e.g., significant swings in false-negative rates) when faced with variations in prompts and rubrics?
summary_en.importance: Redefines safety judgment as a rubric-following problem and proposes a training strategy combining dynamic rubrics and curriculum learning, significantly improving the robustness and generalization of judge models.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes two strategies: 1) Instance-conditioned dynamic rubrics: generating dynamic rubrics from prompt-response-label triples to expose the judge to variable evaluation criteria; 2) Reliable-to-expressive curriculum: starting with clean, fixed-rubric supervision and progressively introducing noisier dynamic-rubric data.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated a 12B parameter model on a single human-labeled set under three contrasting rubric prompts (HarmBench-style, ShieldGemma-style, and domain-specific), validating the effectiveness of the approach.

recommendation.zh: 将 Judge 模型的训练视为 Rubric-following 任务，通过动态 Rubric 数据合成和课程学习提升鲁棒性，对训练更可靠的 Reward Model / Judge 有工程参考价值。
recommendation.en: Treats Judge model training as a rubric-following task, improving robustness via dynamic rubric synthesis and curriculum learning. Offers engineering value for training more reliable Reward Models/Judges.

paper.title: How Many Counterfactuals Does It Take? Probing VLM Hallucinations Through Circuits and Causal Effects
paper.abstract: Visual Language Models (VLMs) are known to produce hallucinated predictions that are not grounded in visual evidence, yet existing approaches lack a principled understanding of how robust such predictions are under counterfactual perturbations. In this work, we study the sample complexity of counterfactual robustness for hallucinated outputs in VLMs. We define a causal influence metric based on log-probability differences between factual, counterfactual, and activation-patched runs, and use it t

summary.core_problem: 如何量化和理解视觉语言模型（VLMs）中幻觉预测在反事实扰动下的鲁棒性？
summary.importance: 提供了一种基于因果影响和电路发现的原则性方法，用于分析 VLM 幻觉的稳定性，并给出了检测不稳定性所需的反事实样本数量的经验界限。
summary.technical_approach: 定义了一个基于事实、反事实和激活修补运行之间对数概率差异的因果影响指标。利用电路发现技术（CD-T）识别负责幻觉预测的模型组件，并跟踪它们在反事实样本中的激活差异。使用浓度不等式和因果影响分布的方差估计，推导出可靠检测幻觉输出不稳定性所需的最小反事实样本数 $m$ 的经验界限。
summary.experiments: 未详细说明具体模型和数据集，但提出了理论界限和基于激活差异的分析方法。

summary_en.core_problem: How to quantify and understand the robustness of hallucinated predictions in Visual Language Models (VLMs) under counterfactual perturbations?
summary_en.importance: Provides a principled approach based on causal influence and circuit discovery to analyze the stability of VLM hallucinations, and derives empirical bounds on the number of counterfactual samples needed to detect instability.
summary_en.technical_approach: Defines a causal influence metric based on log-probability differences between factual, counterfactual, and activation-patched runs. Leverages circuit discovery techniques (CD-T) to identify model components responsible for hallucinations and tracks their activation differences across counterfactual samples. Derives empirical bounds on the minimum number of counterfactual samples $m$ required to reliably detect instability using concentration inequalities and variance estimates.
summary_en.experiments: Specific models and datasets are not detailed, but theoretical bounds and analysis methods based on activation differences are proposed.

recommendation.zh: 从因果推断和电路发现角度分析 VLM 幻觉机制，对理解多模态模型的内部表示有一定启发，建议关注其因果影响指标的设计。
recommendation.en: Analyzes VLM hallucination mechanisms from the perspective of causal inference and circuit discovery, providing insights into internal representations of multimodal models; the design of the causal influence metric is worth noting.

paper.title: Stability vs. Manipulability: Evaluating Robustness Under Post-Decision Interaction in LLM Judges
paper.abstract: LLM-as-judge evaluation is widely used in benchmarking pipelines, where model outputs are compared and ranked using automated evaluators. These pipelines typically assume that judgments are stable properties of fixed inputs. We show that this assumption does not hold under interaction. We study post-decision manipulability: the extent to which an evaluation outcome can be altered through subsequent conversation with the judge after an initial decision has been made. Across controlled experiments

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究的是 LLM-as-judge 一个此前很少被单独刻画的失效模式：判决已经给出之后，是否还能被后续对话系统性改写。作者把这个问题和常见的“稳定性”区分开来。稳定性指同一输入重复评测、或在中性重问下是否保持一致；而他们关心的“post-decision manipulability”指在候选答案完全不变的前提下，仅通过后续与 judge 的交互，就让原本的胜负判断翻转。核心问题不是 judge 会不会有随机波动，而是它是否缺乏对抗性鲁棒性，导致评测结果并不是固定属性，而是可被事后操纵的对话产物。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身没有直接方法贡献，但对后训练、对齐和评测基础设施有现实影响。现在很多模型迭代、偏好优化、reward model 校验、公开榜单比较，都依赖 LLM judge。如果 judge 在“重复评测时稳定”，却在“带目标的追问”下容易翻案，那么现有自动评测只测到了可重复性，没有测到抗操纵性。这个区分很重要，因为它会影响两类事情：一是 benchmark 排名是否稳，二是用 judge 作为训练信号时，信号是否容易被策略性利用。对做 RLHF、RLAIF、judge distillation、model grading 的人，这篇文章提供了一个更接近安全性和机制层面的评测视角。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上，作者设计了一套受控的 post-decision interaction protocol。实验从 MT-Bench 和 AlpacaEval 中抽取 response pair，先让 judge 给出 baseline 判决，然后在保持候选回答不变的情况下，施加不同类型的后续交互：重复评测、neutral reconsideration，以及带明确目标的 persuasive challenge。这里最关键的是因果隔离：被评测对象固定，只改变 judge 后续接收到的话语，从而把“判决翻转”归因到交互本身，而不是输入样本变化。

他们提出了几类 challenge，其中最重要的是 anti-baseline challenge：后续对话明确站在 baseline 反方向，要求 judge 重新考虑原先输的一方是否更好。为了避免只看到表面翻转，作者又做了 counterbalanced target audit，用对称设计区分“单纯重新思考带来的自然波动”和“被定向说服带来的额外偏移”。文中用 persuasion-induced reversibility 和 target-directed steering 两个量来拆分这两部分效应。结果显示，确实存在显著的可逆性，但净定向 steering 很弱，说明很多翻转不是稳定地朝某一目标被控制，而是 judge 在受挑战后进入高可塑状态。

机制分析部分也比较完整。作者检查了 judge 的自报置信度，发现高置信并不意味着抗翻转；很多后来被推翻的判决，初始置信度仍然很高，说明 calibration 失真。作者还比较了不同 persuasion framing，发现 authority framing 比 reasoning-based challenge 更有效，也就是说“以权威口吻要求重审”比“给出更扎实的论证”更容易改判。最后，他们分析翻案前后的 justification overlap，发现 judge 改判后常会生成与原先理由重叠很低的新解释，更像事后合理化，而不是显式承认先前推理哪里错了。

为了量化这种脆弱性，文中提出 Evaluation Robustness Score, ERS，用来衡量一个 judge 在后决策交互下的抗操纵能力。ERS 不是传统 accuracy 指标，而是把评测器本身当作被测对象，关注其在交互扰动下的稳定边界。
summary.experiments:
实验主要基于 MT-Bench 和 AlpacaEval 的成对比较。最醒目的结果是：在重复评测和中性重问条件下，judge 的判决总体稳定；但在 anti-baseline challenge 下，49% 的原始判决会翻转。这说明“稳定”与“鲁棒”不是一回事。

作者进一步做了 counterbalanced audit，得到 persuasion-induced reversibility P_S = 0.194，说明定向挑战确实会显著增加翻案概率；但 signed target-direction effect D_S^signed = -0.018，clipped D_S = 0，说明这种影响更多体现为把 judge 从原判中撬松，而不是可靠地把它推向某个指定方向。换句话说，judge 容易被动摇，但不一定能被精确操控。

更关键的是翻案质量。文中指出，在 targeted post-decision challenge 触发的 reversals 中，64% 是 harmful reversals，也就是改判后与人类偏好更不一致。这一点直接说明后续交互并没有在多数情况下纠正错误，反而更常破坏对齐。作者还展示了这种翻转会传导到 benchmark ranking，意味着榜单名次可能受 challenge protocol 影响，而不是只由模型输出质量决定。

机制实验里，authority framing 的效果强于 reasoning framing；而且即便 judge 在改判后自报置信下降，翻案仍会发生，说明它不是“更谨慎后修正错误”，而更像“在社会性提示下重写立场”。另外，justification overlap 低，支持 post hoc rationalization 的解释。文中还分析了 multi-step persuasion dynamics、inter-judge agreement 和 difficulty 对脆弱性的影响，整体结论是：难样本更容易被撬动，但这种脆弱性并不只存在于边界样本。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读，但建议把问题定义和实验设计看仔细。优先看 Introduction 里对 stability 与 robustness 的区分，这是全文最重要的概念切口。然后看 challenge protocol 的具体构造，尤其是 anti-baseline challenge 和 counterbalanced target audit，这决定了实验结论是否站得住。

结果部分重点看几张主表：一张比较 repeated / neutral / challenge 条件下 reversal rate；一张拆 persuasion-induced reversibility 与 target steering；再看 harmful reversal、human alignment 和 ranking impact 的结果。机制分析里，建议重点看 confidence calibration、authority vs reasoning framing、以及 justification overlap 这三块，它们解释了为什么 judge 会在“看起来很稳”的同时又“很容易被撬动”。

如果阅读时间有限，30 分钟左右可以抓住主结论；如果要判断它对训练管线的影响，建议再花时间想两个延伸问题：第一，能否把 ERS 纳入 judge 选择标准；第二，若用 LLM judge 产生偏好数据，训练出的 policy 会不会学会利用这种可操纵性。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper isolates a failure mode in LLM-as-judge systems that is different from ordinary prompt sensitivity or run-to-run variance: once a judgment has already been made, can later interaction overturn it while the evaluated candidate responses remain fixed? The authors call this post-decision manipulability. Their key point is that evaluation pipelines often check stability under repetition, but rarely test robustness against targeted conversational pressure after the decision. A judge may look reproducible in standard settings and still be highly reversible under adversarial follow-up.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining-method paper, but it matters for the infrastructure around model development. LLM judges are now used in benchmark ranking, preference data generation, reward modeling, and model iteration loops. If a judge is stable under neutral reevaluation yet vulnerable to post-hoc challenge, then current automated evaluation captures reproducibility but not resistance to manipulation. That distinction matters for both leaderboard credibility and training-signal quality.
