summary_en.core_problem: How to mitigate token-level shortcut reliance in pretrained text classifiers at deployment time—without access to the original training data and without shortcut annotations or prior knowledge—so that performance remains robust under shifts in spurious token–label correlations while preserving in-distribution accuracy.
summary_en.importance: Moderately relevant to foundation-model pretraining (it is primarily a deployment-time robustness/adaptation paper), but it offers useful ideas for continual/test-time adaptation and parameter-efficient updates: (1) turning gradient attribution into an actionable, unsupervised signal for adaptation; (2) showing shortcut reliance can be reduced via representation-level invariance to masking high-attribution tokens using a small LoRA module; (3) introducing an explicit shortcut-dependence metric (MSTPS) beyond task accuracy. The contribution is more of a practical adaptation framework + evaluation lens than a new pretraining/scaling recipe.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Shortcut Guardrail is a two-stage framework:
1) Shortcut token localization at test time: compute gradient-based saliency/attribution per input and treat top-attributed tokens as likely shortcut features. The paper claims these tokens align strongly with shortcut tokens in biased models (e.g., >90% recall in sentiment classification).
2) Unsupervised LoRA debiasing via Masked Contrastive Learning (MaskCL): train a lightweight LoRA adapter on unlabeled test batches. For each input, create augmented views by masking individual high-attribution tokens; optimize a contrastive/invariance objective that penalizes representation shift between the original and masked views. Intuition: if the model is overly dependent on a shortcut token, masking it causes large representation/prediction changes; enforcing invariance pushes the model to rely more on broader context/semantics.
A small labeled set is used only to calibrate the debiasing strength (Section 3.4), trading off robustness vs in-distribution retention.
They also propose MSTPS (Max Single-Token Prediction Sensitivity) to quantify reliance on single-token perturbations.
summary_en.experiments:
The provided full-text excerpt does not include the experimental section, so only explicitly stated results can be reported:
- Attribution-based shortcut localization: >90% shortcut-token recall in sentiment classification.
- Evaluated on sentiment classification, toxicity detection, and NLI.
- Reported outcomes: substantial gains under severe shortcut-distribution shifts while preserving in-distribution performance; reduced shortcut dependence measured by MSTPS.
Missing from the excerpt: exact datasets, model variants/sizes, LoRA configuration (rank/where inserted), adaptation compute, robustness gains in numbers, and key ablations. A numeric deep-dive requires the full experiments section.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (30–45 min):
- Read the motivation carefully: the empirical claim that top gradient-attributed tokens concentrate on shortcut tokens is the linchpin.
- Focus on the MaskCL formulation: how masking is done (which tokens/how many), what representations are contrasted, and how LoRA is applied/trained on unlabeled test data.
- Check the calibration step (Section 3.4): what hyperparameter is tuned with a small labeled set and how sensitive results are.
- If you have the full paper, verify ablations that test necessity of attribution (random tokens vs top-attribution) and whether MSTPS correlates with robustness improvements.

recommendation.zh: 把“梯度归因→可优化的部署期抑制目标”串起来挺干净，但泛化到真实分布漂移仍偏弱信号；只看方法段和MSTPS定义/消融。
recommendation.en: Clean idea turning gradient attribution into a deploy-time objective, but robustness claims feel like a weak signal beyond curated shifts; read the method + MSTPS definition/ablations only.

paper.title: One Token Away from Collapse: The Fragility of Instruction-Tuned Helpfulness

summary.core_problem: 论文要回答的是：指令微调（instruction tuning）带来的“helpfulness/有用性”到底有多稳健？作者发现只要在提示词里加入极其轻量的词法约束（例如禁用一个标点逗号，或禁用常见词“the”），指令模型会发生系统性的“响应坍塌”（constraint-induced response collapse）：不是换一种写法，而是直接变短、变浅、覆盖点变少，导致可用性显著下降。进一步要解释的是：这到底是能力不足（不会写无逗号长文）还是规划失败（能写但不打算写），以及这种脆弱性是否由指令微调本身诱发。
summary.importance: 对预训练/后训练研究的直接启发在于：指令微调可能把“任务能力”与“表面模板/写作习惯 token”强耦合，导致模型在面对看似无关的表面约束时进入一种低预算、低覆盖的生成策略。这对（1）对齐与SFT/RLHF数据构造（是否过度奖励某些格式与连接词）、（2）训练目标（是否隐式惩罚长答案或复杂结构）、（3）评测方法（独立打分 vs 成对偏好）都有实质影响。尤其重要的是：作者用 base 模型对照证明该现象不是“语言模型天然如此”，而是 post-training 诱发的系统性行为；并指出主流 LLM-as-judge 独立评分会严重低估这种退化，意味着很多对齐/鲁棒性结论可能建立在有偏评测上。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上分三条证据链把现象钉死并给出机制解释。
1）现象定义与约束设计：构造40个多类型提示（解释/建议/对比分析/技术细节各10），设计8类词法约束（标点禁用：逗号/冒号/分号；模式禁用：项目符号/编号/破折号；词级禁用：禁用“the”或禁用话语连接词如however/therefore等），以及2个组合约束（如逗号+冒号、逗号+bullet）。约束以自然语言附加在问题后，输出仍是自由文本（排除JSON等结构化输出失败的解释）。
2）“能力不足”vs“规划失败”的两段式恢复实验：先让模型自由生成高质量答案，再让模型在第二步把该答案改写以满足约束（two-pass rewrite）。如果模型只是“做不到”，改写会失败或大幅缩水；结果却显示长度可恢复到原始的59–96%，说明模型具备在约束下写长文的能力，坍塌来自第一步规划/策略选择。
3）机制探针与指令微调归因：对提示的中间层隐藏状态做线性探针，预测最终响应长度；在指令模型上，中层表示在生成前就强烈编码了“将要变短”的计划，R²达到0.51–0.93，且R²随不同模型/约束的坍塌严重程度同步变化。对同系列 base（未指令微调）模型做同样探针，所有层R²为负，表明这种可预测的“坍塌表征结构”是 instruction tuning 产生的。作者据此提出：指令微调把“遵循约束”与“降低输出预算/覆盖面”的策略绑定，导致遇到词法限制时触发模式切换。
summary.experiments:
模型覆盖：三组开源家族的 base vs instruct（Llama-3.1-8B / Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct；Qwen-2.5-7B / Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct；Mistral-7B / Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3），以及闭源 GPT-4o-mini。
核心结果（成对比较，judge为GPT-4o-mini与GPT-4o，共1920对）：在指令模型上，简单约束导致“comprehensiveness/覆盖度”下降14–48%，baseline（无约束）在77–100%的对比中获胜。具体例子：Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 禁用逗号时长度下降57%，覆盖度下降27%；Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct 同样约束覆盖度下降61%。闭源 GPT-4o-mini 也显著坍塌：覆盖度下降31%，baseline胜率99%，甚至比 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct（26%）更脆。
对照：base 模型在相同约束下效果小且不稳定，baseline胜率45–59%接近随机，有些约束甚至提升质量。
两段式恢复：在允许先自由生成再改写的设置下，长度可恢复到原始的59–96%，支持“规划失败”而非能力上限。
评测盲点：同一judge下，独立LLM-as-judge打分只检测到平均3.5%的质量下降，但成对比较显示23%的退化，约6.7×差距，说明独立打分对这种坍塌不敏感。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约25–35分钟）：
- 重点看引言里对“constraint-induced response collapse”的定义、以及为何排除结构化输出失败（Figure 1若文中有示例对比，优先看）。
- 实验设置部分要快速扫过：40 prompts 的类别分布、8类约束+2组合约束的设计，这决定了结论外推边界。
- 机制部分建议至少看两块：two-pass recovery（用来区分能力 vs 规划）和线性探针R²结果（用来证明坍塌在生成前已被编码，并且是指令微调诱发）。
- 评测部分（独立打分 vs 成对比较）值得特别关注：它直接影响你如何设计对齐/鲁棒性评测。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether instruction-tuned “helpfulness” is actually robust to trivial surface-form constraints. It shows that adding a simple lexical constraint to the prompt (e.g., “do not use commas” or banning a common word like “the”) can trigger a systematic response collapse in instruction-tuned LLMs: outputs become much shorter and less comprehensive rather than being a faithful rephrasing under the constraint. The work further investigates whether this is a true capability limitation or a planning/strategy failure, and whether instruction tuning itself is the causal source of the fragility.
summary_en.importance: For foundation-model training research, the key implication is that post-training (instruction tuning / preference optimization) may entangle competence with narrow stylistic/token-level templates, creating brittle policies that downshift content coverage when superficial constraints appear. This matters for (i) alignment data design (over-rewarding certain discourse markers, list formats, punctuation patterns), (ii) objective design (implicit length/effort regularization), and (iii) evaluation methodology: the paper argues that standard single-response LLM-as-judge scoring can dramatically under-detect such collapses compared to pairwise preference evaluation. The base-vs-instruct controls make the claim stronger: the collapse is not inherent to LMs, but emerges from instruction tuning.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The study combines behavioral evaluation with mechanism-oriented diagnostics.
(1) Constraint suite + prompt set: 40 prompts across four categories (education/explanation, how-to/advice, analysis/comparison, technical/detailed). Constraints are purely lexical/formatting but still free-form text: punctuation bans (comma/colon/semicolon), pattern bans (no bullets/numbered lists/dashes), word bans (no “the” or no discourse markers like however/therefore/etc.), plus two compositional constraints.
(2) Two-pass recovery to separate capability from planning: the model first produces an unconstrained answer; then it rewrites that answer to satisfy the constraint. High recovery of length/content indicates the model can produce compliant comprehensive text, but fails to plan for it when the constraint is presented upfront.
(3) Representation probing + base-model controls: linear probes on mid-layer prompt representations predict eventual response length before generation, with high R² (0.51–0.93) in instruction-tuned models and negative R² across layers in base models. This supports a mechanism where instruction tuning creates a prompt-level internal signal that triggers a low-budget generation mode under lexical constraints.
summary_en.experiments:
Models: three open-weight families with base vs instruct pairs (Llama-3.1-8B, Qwen-2.5-7B, Mistral-7B) plus a closed model (GPT-4o-mini).
Pairwise evaluation: 1,920 comparisons judged by GPT-4o-mini and GPT-4o. Lexical constraints cause 14–48% comprehensiveness loss across instruction-tuned models; the unconstrained baseline wins 77–100% of the time. Examples reported: for Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, banning commas reduces length by 57% and comprehensiveness by 27%; for Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct, the same constraint yields a 61% comprehensiveness drop. GPT-4o-mini shows a 31% comprehensiveness loss with a 99% baseline win rate.
Controls: base models show small/inconsistent effects (baseline win rates ~45–59%, near chance).
Two-pass rewrite: retains 59–96% of original length, supporting “planning failure.”
Evaluation gap: independent LLM-as-judge scoring detects only ~3.5% average drop where pairwise shows ~23% degradation (~6.7× underestimation).
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (~25–35 minutes):
- Read the intro carefully for the definition of “constraint-induced response collapse” and why this is not a structured-output issue.
- Skim the experimental setup to understand the constraint taxonomy and prompt categories (this bounds generality).
- Focus on the two key mechanism sections: (i) two-pass recovery (capability vs planning) and (ii) linear-probe R² results (collapse is encoded pre-generation and is instruction-tuning-specific).
- Don’t skip the evaluation-methodology section contrasting pairwise vs independent judging; it directly affects how you should evaluate alignment robustness.

recommendation.zh: 只看实验设定+评测对照：它把“指令化=更稳健”这个 prior 直接打碎，并提醒你立刻在自家 SFT/RLHF 流水线加词法约束回归测。
recommendation.en: Read the setup + eval controls: it breaks the “instruction-tuned = more robust” prior and should trigger an immediate lexical-constraint regression test in your SFT/RLHF pipeline.

paper.title: Analyzing the Effect of Noise in LLM Fine-tuning

summary.core_problem: 系统刻画不同噪声类型（标签噪声、拼写/typo噪声、语法噪声）在LLM微调过程中如何影响模型性能与内部学习动态：包括层级表示的漂移、任务信息的编码变化、以及注意力模式是否发生结构性改变。
summary.importance: 对“预训练/Scaling”是间接贡献，但对数据科学与后续持续学习/微调稳定性很有参考价值：1）把噪声影响从“最终指标下降”推进到“内部表征与注意力层面的可解释诊断”；2）给出一个相对通用的分析框架（attention KL + attention rank相关 + 表征变化/任务信息探测），可用于评估数据清洗、合成数据质量、以及持续学习中的噪声累积；3）经验结论（标签噪声最伤、噪声影响层级局部化、注意力排序相对稳定）对构建更鲁棒的微调/持续学习策略有启发。
summary.technical_approach:
核心是受控噪声注入+多视角诊断。
- 噪声设定：三类常见噪声——Label noise（标签翻转/错误标注）、Typographical noise（拼写扰动）、Grammatical noise（语法扰动）。在多个任务（SC/QA/MT）上对微调数据进行可控扰动，分别微调得到clean模型与noisy模型。
- 注意力分析：
  1）attention值分布差异：逐层计算clean与noisy注意力分布的KL散度，跨样本/头/位置平均，定位哪些层的attention数值被噪声显著改变。
  2）attention“关注对象排序”差异：对每个query位置取top-k注意力token，计算Spearman秩相关并逐层平均，用于区分“数值变化但排序不变”vs“排序重排”。
- 任务信息与表征变化：文中在3.2/3.3提出进一步估计任务相关信息是否仍被编码、以及fine-tune前后内部表示如何变化（具体探测器/度量在给定摘录中未完整展示，但总体思路是层级表征对比与信息保真评估）。
- 分层分析：Section 6把样本分为robust与vulnerable组，检查噪声导致的表征变化是否在样本层面均匀发生。
summary.experiments:
给定全文摘录未包含完整实验表格与具体数值，因此只能总结论文在引言中明确给出的总体发现：
- 标签噪声最有害：跨模型家族（GPT-2、Qwen2、Llama-2）与任务（SC/QA/MT）一致导致最大性能下降。
- 拼写/语法噪声有时不降反升：typo与grammatical噪声偶尔带来边际提升（文中Figure 1示例：typo噪声反而让答案更好）。
- 噪声影响层级局部化：更编码任务特定信息的高层更易被噪声扭曲。
- 注意力模式相对稳定：尽管性能变化，token attention ordering变化很小（即Spearman相关较高），暗示退化更多来自FFN/表示变换而非注意力“关注对象”重排。
缺失项：各噪声强度设置、不同噪声比例下的性能曲线、层级指标的具体数值（KL/ρk随层变化）、以及不同模型规模/参数量与训练超参。需要实验章节原文才能补齐“具体数字”。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约40–60分钟）：
- 先看Methodology Section 3：注意力KL与top-k Spearman这套诊断很通用，适合迁移到你自己的数据质量评估管线。
- 再看Results（Section 5）与分层分析（Section 6）：重点抓“哪些层最敏感”“注意力排序稳定但性能下降”的证据链，思考这对LoRA插层位置选择、冻结策略、或噪声鲁棒训练的启示。
- 如果你关心预训练数据科学：建议把他们的噪声类型映射到真实语料噪声（爬虫标签错配、模板化合成错误、OCR/ASR噪声），并评估这些诊断指标能否作为数据过滤/重加权的proxy信号。

summary_en.core_problem: To systematically understand how different noise types in fine-tuning data (label noise, typographical noise, grammatical noise) affect LLM fine-tuning outcomes and internal learning dynamics—layer-wise representation drift, task-information encoding, and attention-pattern changes—beyond just final task metrics.
summary_en.importance: Indirectly relevant to pretraining/scaling, but valuable for LLM data science and continual/fine-tuning stability: it provides a diagnostic lens to connect data noise to internal model changes. The reported patterns—label noise being most damaging, noise effects concentrating in task-specific upper layers, and attention ordering staying largely stable—can inform data curation, robust adaptation, and where/what to update in parameter-efficient tuning.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Controlled noise injection + multi-pronged analysis:
- Noise types: label noise, typo noise, grammatical noise applied to fine-tuning datasets across tasks (sentiment classification, QA, MT) and model families (GPT-2, Qwen2, Llama-2).
- Attention diagnostics:
  1) Layer-wise KL divergence between clean vs noisy attention distributions (averaged over samples/heads/positions) to quantify magnitude shifts.
  2) Top-k Spearman rank correlation of attention weights to measure whether the ordering of attended tokens changes (distinguishing value redistribution vs re-targeting).
- Representation/task-information analyses (Sections 3.2/3.3): compare hidden states between clean and noisy fine-tunes and estimate whether task-relevant information remains encoded (the excerpt does not include the full formalism, but the intent is layer-wise probing/representation comparison).
- Robust vs vulnerable stratification (Section 6): split evaluation samples to test whether representation changes are uniform or concentrated on failure cases.
summary_en.experiments:
The excerpt does not include full experimental tables/numbers, so only high-level findings explicitly stated in the text can be summarized:
- Label noise is consistently the most harmful across models and tasks.
- Typo/grammatical noise can sometimes yield marginal improvements (Figure 1 anecdote: typo noise improved an answer).
- Noise impact is localized: higher, more task-specific layers show larger distortions.
- Attention ordering is largely stable: despite performance changes, token attention rank changes only slightly, suggesting degradation is more about downstream transformations/representations than attention re-targeting.
Missing: exact noise rates, performance deltas, layer-wise KL/ρk curves, model sizes, and hyperparameters—requires the full results section for numeric reporting.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim (40–60 min):
- Start with Section 3 for the diagnostic toolkit (attention KL + top-k rank correlation); it’s reusable for data-quality evaluation.
- Then read Sections 5–6 to understand which layers are most sensitive and how robust/vulnerable samples differ.
- If your focus is data science for pretraining/post-training, map their synthetic noise to real-world pipeline noise (scraping artifacts, weak labels, OCR/ASR errors) and consider whether their metrics can serve as proxies for filtering/reweighting decisions.

recommendation.zh: 别纠结最终分数，直接抄它的 attention/表征漂移诊断流程；作为数据清洗与合成数据 QA 的“噪声体检”模板更值钱。
recommendation.en: Skip the end metrics and steal the attention/representation-drift diagnostics; it’s more valuable as a noise health-check template for data cleaning and synthetic-data QA.

paper.title: MIXAR: Scaling Autoregressive Pixel-based Language Models to Multiple Languages and Scripts

summary.core_problem: 如何将像素级（无tokenizer）自回归语言模型扩展到多语言多文字体系，并在跨脚本场景下获得稳健的泛化与鲁棒性。
summary.importance: 方法与经验贡献：在“token-free/像素LM”路线下首次系统性做多语言多脚本生成式训练与评测，直接触及tokenization在多语言/对抗扰动下的脆弱性问题，并给出可扩展到0.5B的实证结果。
summary.technical_approach: 提出MIXAR：像素输入的自回归语言模型，在8种语言/多脚本上进行生成式训练；围绕像素空间的跨语言感知差异进行建模与训练配方设计，并通过扩大模型规模提升生成能力与对未见语言、正字法攻击（orthographic attacks）等扰动的鲁棒性；与既有像素LM及tokenizer-based模型做对比评测。
summary.experiments: 规模扩展到0.5B参数；在多语言判别与生成任务上对比先前pixel-based模型与可比的tokenizer-based模型，报告“显著提升”；并评估对训练未见语言的鲁棒性与对输入扰动（正字法攻击）的稳健性；包含LAMBADA等生成基准上的能力提升（摘要未给出具体数值）。

summary_en.core_problem: How to scale tokenizer-free, pixel-level autoregressive language models to multilingual, multi-script settings while maintaining robust cross-script generalization and resilience to orthographic perturbations.
summary_en.importance: Provides one of the first systematic multilingual/multi-script training and evaluation studies for pixel-based (token-free) LMs, directly probing tokenizer fragility in multilingual and adversarial settings and demonstrating scalability up to mid-sized models.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces MIXAR, a pixel-input autoregressive LM trained generatively across eight languages/scripts, with training recipes aimed at handling cross-language perceptual variation in pixel space; scales model size to improve generation and robustness, and benchmarks against prior pixel LMs and comparable tokenizer-based LMs, including under unseen-language and orthographic-attack conditions.
summary_en.experiments: Scales to ~0.5B parameters; evaluates on multilingual discriminative and generative tasks (including LAMBADA-style generation), reporting substantial gains over earlier pixel-based models and competitive comparisons to tokenizer-based models; additionally tests robustness to unseen languages and to orthographic input attacks (abstract does not provide detailed numbers).

recommendation.zh: 会改变我对“tokenizer 是多语鲁棒性前提”的 prior；建议直接复现其跨脚本/扰动评测与训练配方，看看像素路线是否真能省掉分词工程债。
recommendation.en: This shifts my prior that tokenizer choice is a prerequisite for multilingual robustness; I’d replicate their cross-script/perturbation eval + recipe to see if pixel LMs genuinely remove tokenizer-induced fragility.

paper.title: When Meaning Isn't Literal: Exploring Idiomatic Meaning Across Languages and Modalities

summary.core_problem: 评测并改进模型对跨语言、跨模态的习语/隐喻等非字面意义理解能力，揭示LLM/VLM在比喻推理上的系统性盲点。
summary.importance: 提供多语言+多模态的习语数据集与基准评测，直接指向“表面线索依赖/字面化误解”等LLM鲁棒性与语义泛化问题；对多模态语义对齐与文化语用理解评测有价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Mediom语料：3533条印地语/孟加拉语/泰语习语，包含金标准解释、跨语言翻译、对齐的图文表示；对LLM进行文本推理评测、对VLM进行图文歧义消解评测；并提出HIDE（基于hinting的缓解策略，摘要未展开具体实现细节）。
summary.experiments: 数据规模3533；基准评测显示LLM/VLM在隐喻/习语理解上存在系统性失败；摘要未给出具体模型列表、指标与提升幅度（HIDE效果细节缺失）。

summary_en.core_problem: Evaluating and improving model understanding of non-literal meaning (idioms/metaphors) across languages and modalities, exposing systematic failures of LLMs/VLMs in figurative reasoning.
summary_en.importance: Contributes a multilingual, multimodal benchmark targeting robustness beyond surface-form cues and literalization, supporting evaluation of semantic generalization and culturally grounded pragmatic understanding in multimodal systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces the Mediom corpus with 3,533 idioms in Hindi, Bengali, and Thai, including gold explanations, cross-language translations, and aligned image–text representations. Uses it to evaluate LLMs on text-based figurative reasoning and VLMs on multimodal disambiguation, and proposes a hinting-based mitigation strategy (HIDE) described at a high level in the abstract.
summary_en.experiments: Reports that benchmark results reveal consistent failures of both LLMs and VLMs on idiomatic/figurative meaning; the abstract does not list evaluated models, metrics, or the quantitative effect of HIDE.

recommendation.zh: 作为鲁棒性基准备查即可：只扫错误类型统计，看看模型是否仍靠字面线索；不太会直接指导预训练配方。
recommendation.en: Keep as a robustness benchmark reference: skim the error taxonomy to see if models still overfit literal cues; unlikely to change pretraining recipes.

paper.title: Detecting Corporate AI-Washing via Cross-Modal Semantic Inconsistency Learning

summary.core_problem: 如何用跨模态“主张-证据”推理而非表面文本特征，检测企业在多渠道披露中的AI-washing（夸大/虚构AI能力）。
summary.importance: 贡献类型以Benchmark+任务定义为主：提出将AI-washing检测重定义为跨模态NLI式一致性/蕴含推理，并发布大规模三模态数据集AW-Bench；对多模态对齐、跨模态一致性检测与鲁棒评测有启发。
summary.technical_approach: AWASH框架：三模态编码器（年报文本/披露图片/电话会视频）+ 结构化NLI模块做claim-evidence entailment推理 + 跨模态不一致性检测网络（CMID）以提升对改写与跨渠道遮蔽的鲁棒性。
summary.experiments: 数据：AW-Bench含88,412个对齐三元组（文本-图片-视频），覆盖4,892家A股公司（2019Q1-2025Q2）。对比：相对单模态文本频次/相似度类方法（摘要所述）强调对抗改写与跨渠道混淆下更稳健；摘要未给出具体SOTA数值与提升幅度细节。

summary_en.core_problem: How to detect corporate AI-washing by reasoning over cross-channel claim–evidence consistency rather than relying on superficial textual cues, especially when firms paraphrase or distribute information across modalities.
summary_en.importance: Defines AI-washing detection as a cross-modal entailment/inconsistency problem and releases a large-scale tri-modal benchmark (AW-Bench), offering a more robust evaluation target for multimodal alignment and semantic consistency modeling.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces the AWASH framework: tri-modal encoders for annual-report text, disclosure images, and earnings-call video; a structured NLI-style module to infer claim–evidence entailment; and a Cross-Modal Inconsistency Detection (CMID) network to improve robustness to rewriting and cross-channel obfuscation.
summary_en.experiments: Releases AW-Bench with 88,412 aligned text–image–video triples from 4,892 A-share companies (2019Q1–2025Q2) and reports stronger robustness than text-only frequency/similarity baselines under paraphrasing and cross-channel confusion, though detailed SOTA numbers are not provided in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 任务定义有趣但易被数据伪线索污染：只看跨模态一致性/NLI 标注流程与反作弊实验，别花时间读完整模型细节。
recommendation.en: Interesting task framing but prone to spurious cues: only read the cross-modal NLI labeling pipeline and anti-cheating tests; skip most model details.

paper.title: On the Robustness of Watermarking for Autoregressive Image Generation

summary.core_problem: 评估并攻击自回归图像生成模型的水印方案，检验其在“去水印”和“伪造水印”场景下的鲁棒性与可用性。
summary.importance: 属于生成模型内容溯源/安全方向的重要负面结果与系统性评测：揭示现有AR图像水印在弱攻击假设下也可能失效，为多模态生成模型的可追责性、训练数据去污染（过滤合成数据）与安全治理提供关键警示与设计约束。
summary.technical_approach: 在既有AR水印与检测框架上，系统复现并对比多类攻击，同时提出三种新攻击：(i) 基于向量量化的“再生成”去水印；(ii) 基于对抗优化的去水印/伪造；(iii) 频域注入实现伪造或干扰检测。强调攻击者仅需单张带水印参考图、无需模型参数与水印密钥即可奏效。
summary.experiments: 对多种AR水印方案进行去除与伪造评测；在“仅单个水印参考图、无密钥/无参数访问”的威胁模型下，展示多种攻击可显著降低检测可靠性并实现伪造（摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据集与量化数值）。

summary_en.core_problem: Assessing and breaking watermarking schemes for autoregressive image generators, focusing on both watermark removal and watermark forgery under realistic attacker capabilities.
summary_en.importance: Provides a systematic robustness study with negative results, showing that existing AR image watermarking can fail even under weak threat models, with implications for provenance, accountability, and filtering of synthetic data in safety governance.
summary_en.technical_approach: Reproduces and compares multiple existing attack classes and introduces three new attacks: (i) vector-quantization-based “regeneration” for watermark removal, (ii) adversarial optimization for removal and forgery, and (iii) frequency-domain injection to forge or disrupt detection; emphasizes a low-access threat model requiring only a single watermarked reference image and no model parameters or watermark key.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluates watermark removal and forgery across several AR watermarking/detection pipelines, demonstrating substantial degradation of detection reliability and successful forgery under the single-reference, no-key/no-parameter-access setting; the abstract does not provide datasets, model specifics, or detailed quantitative results.

recommendation.zh: 作为水印“负面结果”备查即可：弱威胁模型下都能去/伪造，结论对治理有警示但不太指导预训练动作。
recommendation.en: Mostly a negative-result reference: shows watermark removal/forgery works even under weak attackers, useful for policy context but offers little actionable pretraining guidance.

paper.title: Critical-CoT: A Robust Defense Framework against Reasoning-Level Backdoor Attacks in Large Language Models

summary.core_problem: 防御针对LLM链式推理（CoT）的“推理级后门攻击”，在触发后模型会插入恶意推理步骤但答案表面合理，难以检测。
summary.importance: 对齐/安全方向的重要问题：从传统token-level后门扩展到reasoning-level后门，提出专门防御框架；对“如何训练出能自检推理异常的模型”有启发。
summary.technical_approach: Critical-CoT：两阶段微调以培养“critical thinking”行为，使模型在生成/审视CoT时能识别潜在恶意推理注入并进行抵抗；核心是通过专门构造的训练过程让模型学会对推理链进行批判性检查（而非仅对最终答案做分类/过滤）。
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露具体基座模型、参数规模、攻击设置（触发器形式/投毒比例）、对比防御基线（如过滤、再训练、激活聚类等）及提升幅度（ASR下降/干净性能保持）。

summary_en.core_problem: How to defend LLMs against reasoning-level (CoT-level) backdoor attacks where the trigger causes insertion of malicious reasoning steps while the final answer can appear plausible, making detection and mitigation difficult.
summary_en.importance: Shifts backdoor defense from token-level artifacts to reasoning-process integrity, proposing a defense that trains models to scrutinize and resist anomalous or adversarial reasoning chains—relevant for safety in systems that rely on explicit CoT.
summary_en.technical_approach: Critical-CoT uses a two-stage fine-tuning framework to instill ‘critical thinking’: the model is trained not only to produce answers but also to examine and challenge its own generated reasoning, enabling it to detect and reject injected malicious steps rather than relying on output filtering alone.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model/attack configurations, poisoning rates, defense baselines, or quantitative reductions in attack success versus clean accuracy retention.

recommendation.zh: 推理级后门是现实威胁但评测很容易被构造细节左右；只看攻击定义与检测指标，别被总体提升迷惑。
recommendation.en: Reasoning-level backdoors are real, but results can hinge on construction details; read the threat model and detection metrics, ignore headline gains.

paper.title: General365: Benchmarking General Reasoning in Large Language Models Across Diverse and Challenging Tasks

summary.core_problem: 如何系统评测LLM在“去专业知识依赖”的一般性推理（general reasoning）上的能力与泛化，而非仅在数学/物理等专门领域推理上表现。
summary.importance: Benchmark贡献：提出General365以K-12背景知识约束来解耦“知识量”与“推理能力”，覆盖复杂约束、嵌套逻辑分支、语义干扰等更贴近日常复杂推理的难点，并提供多模型横评揭示当前SOTA短板。
summary.technical_approach: 构建包含365个seed题与1095个变体题的数据集，划分8类任务；通过变体设计测试鲁棒性/泛化，并对26个主流LLM进行统一评测对比。
summary.experiments: 评测26个LLM；数据规模为365 seed + 1095 variants，8大类；摘要未给出具体最优模型名称与分数细节，仅指出最强模型表现仍有限。

summary_en.core_problem: How to systematically benchmark LLMs’ general reasoning ability—decoupled from specialized domain knowledge—and assess generalization and robustness on everyday-style challenging reasoning.
summary_en.importance: Introduces a benchmark that constrains required background knowledge to K–12 level to better isolate reasoning, and covers difficulty sources such as complex constraints, nested logical branching, and semantic distractions, revealing limitations of current leading models.
summary_en.technical_approach: Constructs General365 with 365 seed problems and 1095 controlled variants spanning 8 task categories; uses variants to probe robustness/generalization and evaluates a broad set of LLMs under a unified protocol.
summary_en.experiments: Benchmarks 26 popular LLMs on 365 seeds plus 1095 variants across 8 categories; reports that even the strongest models achieve limited performance, indicating substantial headroom in general reasoning.

recommendation.zh: 作为“去知识化推理”benchmark备查即可，能快速补齐你评测矩阵但不太指导训练；只看任务构成与leaderboard结论，别细读题库细节。
recommendation.en: Useful as a reference benchmark for ‘less-knowledge, more-reasoning’ evaluation to round out an eval suite, but it won’t guide training decisions much; skim the task breakdown and leaderboard takeaways.

paper.title: VeriSim: A Configurable Framework for Evaluating Medical AI Under Realistic Patient Noise

summary.core_problem: 现有医疗LLM评测过于“干净”，无法反映真实临床对话中患者噪声（记忆缺口、低健康素养、焦虑、隐瞒等）对模型诊断能力的影响。
summary.importance: Benchmark/评测框架贡献：提供可控、可验证的“真实患者噪声”注入与一致性校验机制，揭示模型在更真实交互分布下的系统性退化；对鲁棒对话、评测分布偏移与对齐目标设计有启发。
summary.technical_approach: VeriSim：truth-preserving patient simulation框架；基于医学沟通文献抽象6类噪声维度，对患者回答进行可控扰动；用UMLS+LLM的混合验证机制确保噪声注入后仍严格遵守医学ground truth（避免把错误事实当作“噪声”）。
summary.experiments: 在7个开源权重LLM上测试：在现实患者噪声下诊断准确率下降约15-25%，对话长度增加约34-55%；强调标准benchmark与真实交互之间的差距（摘要未给出具体模型列表与任务集细节）。

summary_en.core_problem: Standard medical LLM evaluations are overly “clean” and fail to capture how realistic patient noise (e.g., memory gaps, low health literacy, anxiety, concealment) degrades diagnostic dialogue performance.
summary_en.importance: Provides a configurable, verifiable framework for injecting realistic patient noise while preserving medical ground truth, exposing systematic performance drops under more realistic interaction distributions and informing robustness and evaluation design in clinical AI.
summary_en.technical_approach: Presents VeriSim, a truth-preserving patient simulation framework that operationalizes six noise dimensions from medical communication literature; applies controlled perturbations to patient responses and uses a hybrid UMLS+LLM verification pipeline to ensure injected noise does not alter underlying clinical facts.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluates seven open-weight LLMs and finds diagnostic accuracy drops by roughly 15–25% under patient noise while dialogue length increases by about 34–55%, underscoring the gap between standard benchmarks and realistic clinical conversations.

recommendation.zh: 告诉你干净评测有多乐观：噪声注入+一致性校验框架可直接搬进内部红队；正文只看噪声类型表和退化曲线。
recommendation.en: A reminder that clean evals are overly optimistic—the noise injection + consistency checks are easy to port into internal red-teaming; just read the noise taxonomy and the degradation plots.

paper.title: Sanity Checks for Agentic Data Science

summary.core_problem: 如何为“能自动做数据分析并给出统计结论”的Agentic Data Science(ADS)管线提供轻量、可操作的可靠性/可证伪性检查，避免模型给出看似自信但其实由噪声驱动的结论。
summary.importance: 贡献类型为方法与评测范式：把PCS(Predictability-Computability-Stability)框架引入ADS输出的“事后审计”，用扰动测试将ADS结论变成可证伪对象；对数据分析类Agent的可信度评估与部署风控有直接启发。
summary.technical_approach: 提出两类基于“合理扰动(perturbations)”的sanity checks：通过对输入数据/分析流程做受控扰动，观察ADS是否能稳定区分信号与噪声，并据此将输出归类为(1)稳定信号(2)噪声响应(3)对偶然因素敏感；整体是轻量外部验证层，而非改模型训练。
summary.experiments: 在可控信噪比的合成数据上验证：sanity checks的指标随信噪比变化而变化，能暴露“虚假乐观结论”；摘要未给出具体模型规模、真实数据集、与强基线系统化对比与量化提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: Provide lightweight, actionable reliability checks for agentic data science pipelines so that automatically generated statistical conclusions can be falsified and are less likely to be driven by noise.
summary_en.importance: Adapts the PCS (Predictability–Computability–Stability) perspective to post-hoc auditing of LLM-driven data analysis, offering a practical risk-control layer for deploying data-science agents.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes sanity checks based on controlled, ‘reasonable’ perturbations to the input data and/or analysis workflow; by measuring stability of conclusions under perturbations, outputs are categorized as stable signal, noise response, or sensitivity to incidental factors—without modifying model training.
summary_en.experiments: Demonstrated on synthetic datasets with controllable signal-to-noise ratios, where the proposed checks track SNR and expose overly optimistic false conclusions; the abstract does not specify models, real-world datasets, strong baselines, or quantitative gains.

recommendation.zh: 对做 agentic 分析管线的人很实用：PCS 式扰动把结论变成可证伪对象；只读 sanity check 清单与案例，能直接落地到上线风控。
recommendation.en: Practical for agentic analytics pipelines: PCS-style perturbations turn outputs into falsifiable claims; read the sanity-check checklist and examples—easy to port into deployment risk controls.

paper.title: Noise-Aware In-Context Learning for Hallucination Mitigation in ALLMs

summary.core_problem: 缓解听觉大模型(ALLMs)在音频理解/音频描述生成中的幻觉，并提供更细粒度的评测而非二分类。
summary.importance: 多模态(音频-语言)可靠性方向：提出无需微调的in-context缓解策略（更贴近部署），并建立音频caption幻觉benchmark，契合多模态对齐/鲁棒性研究。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Noise-Aware In-Context Learning(NAICL)：构建噪声先验库，检索与输入音频相关的噪声示例作为上下文先验，诱导模型在声学证据不足时更保守生成、减少臆测关联；同时提出面向生成任务的音频caption幻觉评测基准。
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露具体ALLM名称、参数规模、噪声库规模、benchmark规模与量化提升幅度；强调plug-and-play、无需fine-tuning，并在音频caption任务上评测幻觉缓解效果。

summary_en.core_problem: Mitigating hallucinations in audio-language large models during audio understanding and audio-caption generation, and enabling more fine-grained evaluation than binary hallucination judgments.
summary_en.importance: Targets reliability in audio-language generation with a deployment-friendly, no-finetuning in-context strategy and introduces an audio-caption hallucination benchmark, supporting research on multimodal robustness and alignment.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Noise-Aware In-Context Learning (NAICL): builds a noise-prior library and retrieves noise examples relevant to the input audio as contextual priors, encouraging conservative generation when acoustic evidence is weak; additionally defines a benchmark/protocol for evaluating hallucinations in audio captioning.
summary_en.experiments: Emphasizes plug-and-play evaluation on audio captioning with hallucination mitigation; the abstract omits the specific ALLMs used, library/benchmark sizes, and quantitative improvements.

recommendation.zh: 部署向的小技巧合集：只看in-context噪声建模提示法和benchmark定义，方法增量不大但能当ALLM幻觉评测的起点。
recommendation.en: A deployment-oriented bag of tricks: read the noise-aware prompting recipe + benchmark spec; small novelty, but a decent starting point for ALLM hallucination evals.

paper.title: PerMix-RLVR: Preserving Persona Expressivity under Verifiable-Reward Alignment

summary.core_problem: 论文研究“persona prompting（角色/人设提示）”带来的性能波动：同一模型在不同persona下任务表现差异巨大，最佳persona难以预测，导致需要昂贵的推理时prompt试错/搜索。作者进一步追问：这种persona敏感性是否与后训练（post-training）目标有关，能否在训练阶段让模型对persona变化更鲁棒，同时在需要时仍能保持角色表达力（fidelity/expressivity）。
summary.importance: 在真实产品中，persona常用于提升指令遵循与风格控制，但其“高上限+高风险”使得上线成本高、稳定性差。若能训练出对persona变化更稳定的模型，可减少推理时prompt工程与评测试错；同时，若对齐方法（如RLVR）会削弱角色扮演表达力，则需要新的训练策略在“任务稳定性”和“角色表现力”之间取得可控平衡。
summary.technical_approach: 核心发现与机制：作者观察到采用RLVR（reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards，可验证奖励强化学习）的模型在“可验证目标任务”（如数学推理）上对persona变化表现出系统性鲁棒；而SFT/蒸馏等非RLVR后训练配方更persona敏感。为量化鲁棒性，提出Persona Stability Score (PSS)：基于同一模型在多persona集合上的任务表现分布来度量“跨persona稳定性”（越接近1越稳定）。同时作者指出RLVR带来一个权衡：在目标可验证的任务上，RLVR倾向于压缩与persona相关的行为差异（更稳定），但在需要强角色扮演/风格表达的场景会削弱persona fidelity（不太“入戏”）。在此基础上提出PerMix-RLVR：一种训练策略，目标是在保留RLVR带来的“对有害persona变化的鲁棒性”的同时，在需要时恢复persona表达力。其思想可概括为：在RLVR对齐框架中引入“persona混合/分配”的训练设计，让模型既学会对任务目标保持稳定，又在特定persona条件下保留可控的风格/角色差异（论文声称在数学与role-playing任务上优于标准RLVR）。
summary.experiments: 宏观对比实验：作者基于公开后训练模型做跨家族观察（Qwen3、Llama3.1/3.2、Gemma3等），在MATH500与AIME2024上用固定的16个system personas（覆盖STEM专家、教育水平、性格特质、职业角色）评测，并用PSS衡量persona稳定性。观察到：包含RLVR的模型（如Qwen3-32B）相对更persona-stable；非RLVR管线模型更敏感。论文还声称在后续受控实验中验证该趋势，并展示“鲁棒性—fidelity”权衡，以及PerMix-RLVR在数学推理与角色扮演任务上的改进（相对标准RLVR）。
summary.reading_guide:
must_read（精读）：1) Introduction：明确问题设定、为何从推理时prompt搜索转向训练时鲁棒性；2) RLVR Alignment and Persona Robustness & Fidelity：重点看PSS定义、persona集合设计、以及“RLVR提升稳定性但削弱fidelity”的证据链；3) 关键图表：Figure 1（persona试错成本与波动直观展示）、以及展示不同模型家族在多persona下性能分布/方差或PSS对比的图；4) PerMix-RLVR方法段：精读其训练目标如何同时约束“可验证任务的稳定性”和“角色表达力恢复”，以及与标准RLVR的差异；5) Ablation/控制实验：关注是否控制了模型规模、数据、解码策略、persona模板等混杂因素。
skim（泛读）：1) 读Introduction + 贡献点列表把握主结论；2) 快速看PSS与公开模型对比结果（跨家族趋势）；3) 只看PerMix-RLVR的核心做法与主结果表（数学+role-play两类任务）。
summary.authors_note: 作者主张“persona敏感性不是随机现象，而与后训练对齐目标强相关”。RLVR在可验证目标任务上诱导出更稳定的persona鲁棒性，但会牺牲角色扮演表达力；因此需要像PerMix-RLVR这样的折中训练策略，在稳定性与表达力两个行为轴上做可控权衡。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies the volatility of persona prompting: the same LLM can perform very differently under different persona/system-role prompts, making the “best persona” hard to predict and forcing costly inference-time prompt trial-and-error. The authors ask whether persona sensitivity is driven by post-training objectives, and whether we can train models to be robust to persona variations while still preserving persona expressivity/fidelity when role-playing is desired.
summary_en.importance: Persona prompting is widely used for steering style and improving instruction performance, but its high variance creates real deployment costs and reliability risks. Training-time persona robustness could reduce prompt engineering and evaluation overhead. At the same time, if alignment methods like RLVR reduce persona expressivity, we need training strategies that explicitly balance task stability and controllable role-playing fidelity.
summary_en.technical_approach: Key finding and framing: models post-trained with RLVR (reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards) become systematically more robust to persona variations on verifiable-goal tasks (e.g., math), compared to non-RLVR recipes such as SFT or distillation. The paper introduces Persona Stability Score (PSS) to quantify how much task performance varies across a fixed persona set (higher is more stable). The authors further identify a robustness–fidelity trade-off: RLVR improves stability on goal-oriented/verifiable tasks but attenuates persona fidelity in role-playing settings. To address this, they propose PerMix-RLVR, a training strategy intended to retain RLVR’s robustness to harmful persona variation while recovering persona expressivity when needed, by incorporating persona-mixing/training design within the RLVR alignment framework (claimed to outperform standard RLVR on both math reasoning and role-playing tasks).
summary_en.experiments: Macro-level evaluation on publicly available post-trained models across families (Qwen3, Llama3.1/3.2, Gemma3) using MATH500 and AIME2024. They evaluate each model under 16 system personas spanning STEM experts, education levels, character traits, and job roles, and compute PSS to measure persona stability. Observations: RLVR-including pipelines (e.g., Qwen3-32B) show higher persona stability; non-RLVR pipelines are more persona-sensitive. The paper also reports controlled experiments validating the trend, demonstrating the robustness–fidelity trade-off, and showing PerMix-RLVR improvements over standard RLVR on math and role-playing benchmarks.
summary_en.reading_guide:
must_read: (1) Introduction for the motivation and the shift from inference-time persona search to training-time robustness; (2) “RLVR Alignment and Persona Robustness & Fidelity” for the PSS definition, persona set design, and the evidence for the robustness–fidelity trade-off; (3) Key figures: Figure 1 for the cost/volatility intuition, plus plots/tables comparing performance distributions or PSS across model families; (4) PerMix-RLVR section for the exact training objective/procedure and how it differs from vanilla RLVR; (5) Controlled experiments/ablations to check confounders (scale, data, decoding, persona templates).
skim: read Introduction + contributions, skim PSS and the public-model comparison, then jump to PerMix-RLVR’s main idea and headline results (math + role-play).
summary_en.authors_note: The authors argue persona sensitivity is not random but strongly tied to post-training alignment objectives. RLVR induces persona robustness on verifiable tasks but can reduce role-playing expressivity, motivating PerMix-RLVR to balance stability and persona fidelity as two distinct behavioral axes.

recommendation.zh: 把 persona 稳定性当成对齐副作用来处理很贴产品，但结论可能强依赖 reward/任务集；重点看消融与稳定性度量定义再决定跟进。
recommendation.en: Treating persona sensitivity as an alignment side-effect is product-relevant, but likely reward/task-set specific; focus on ablations and the stability metrics before investing further.

paper.title: $p1$: Better Prompt Optimization with Fewer Prompts

summary.core_problem: 论文研究“为什么系统提示词（system prompt）的自动优化在不同任务上效果极不稳定”。作者将提示词优化视为RL问题：策略生成候选system prompt，用冻结LLM在数据集上的准确率作奖励；核心问题是：何时存在足够清晰的优化信号、何时信号会被生成随机性与数据异质性淹没，从而导致“算力堆不出更好prompt”。
summary.importance: 系统提示词是当前LLM对齐/能力释放的关键接口，且无需改权重，成本低、可迁移。但实践中prompt优化常常“玄学”：有的任务一优化就涨，有的任务几乎不动。本文给出可解释的判据（奖励方差分解与信号强弱条件）以及一个反直觉结论（更多训练user prompts可能更差），并据此提出用更少样本反而更有效的过滤训练方法p1，对推理类异质数据尤其重要。
summary.technical_approach:
1) RL式prompt优化设定：冻结基础模型π，仅训练system prompt生成策略π'（meta-prompt s条件下生成x'），奖励r(x,y)为二值正确性；采用on-policy GRPO变体（无KL到参考策略、无std advantage归一化），用V^{π'_t}(s)=E_{x'~π'_t}[r(x')]作baseline。
2) 关键分析：将“不同system prompt下的奖励方差”分解为两部分——(a) response variance：同一system prompt下因采样/推理随机性导致的回报波动；(b) prompt variance：不同system prompt真实期望回报差异。结论：当prompt variance足够大（相对response variance占主导）时，RL能获得稳定梯度信号并成功；当response variance主导时，优化信号被噪声淹没，prompt优化难以推进（典型如复杂数学推理）。
3) 反直觉现象：扩大训练集（更多user prompts）会降低prompt variance。原因是不同user prompt对system prompt的偏好可能相互抵消；在异质任务（如数学推理）中，“对某题有帮助的prompt”可能对另一题有害，平均后候选prompt的期望回报趋同，导致统计上难区分。
4) 方法p1：用户提示过滤（user-prompt filtering）。不在全量训练集上优化，而是选取一小部分“能最大区分system prompt优劣”的user prompts——即在候选system prompts上表现出高奖励方差的样本子集。用该子集训练可显著增强优化信号；并且因为子集更“判别性”，所需训练样本更少但泛化更好。
summary.experiments:
论文在指令遵循与推理两类基准上对比标准prompt优化与p1过滤训练：
- 现象验证：在IFBench等较同质的instruction-following任务上，system prompt对奖励敏感，prompt variance较大，常规优化有效；在AIME等复杂推理上，response variance更大，常规优化即使算力增加也难提升。
- 规模效应验证：增加user prompts数量会削弱prompt variance并伤害优化，尤其在异质推理数据上更明显。
- p1效果：在推理数据上，过滤后显著提升；特别地，仅用AIME 24中“两个”user prompts训练得到的system prompt即可泛化到其他推理基准。
- 迁移与跨模型：在Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507上优化出的system prompt可迁移提升更大模型Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507，并能提升训练未见的额外推理基准（文中Fig.1展示）。
summary.reading_guide:
【skim（泛读）】
- 先读Introduction：抓住两条主线结论——(i) 奖励方差=响应噪声+prompt差异；(ii) 数据越大可能越难优化；以及p1“少样本更强”的动机。
- 再读Problem Setup：明确RL对象是谁（π'生成system prompt）、奖励如何定义、为何用GRPO变体。
- 重点扫Fig.1：看跨模型/跨基准迁移的核心证据。

【must_read（精读）】
- 精读“Prompt Learnability/方差分解与可学性判据”相关章节：理解prompt variance与response variance的定义、估计方式、以及它们如何决定RL梯度信噪比。
- 精读“更多user prompts为何更差”的分析与实验：这是本文最反直觉但最具指导意义的结论，直接影响你如何构造prompt优化数据集。
- 精读p1算法细节：过滤指标如何计算（基于候选system prompts的奖励方差）、过滤后训练流程如何与GRPO结合、为何能在极小样本下泛化。
- 对照关键图表：
  1) 展示两类方差占比随任务变化的图（用于建立“何时可优化”的直觉）；
  2) 数据规模vs prompt variance/性能曲线（用于理解“越多越差”）；
  3) p1在AIME/推理基准上的提升与迁移图（用于验证方法有效性与外推）。
summary.authors_note: 作者的核心观点是：prompt优化不是“总能work”的黑盒搜索，而是一个受统计信号支配的学习问题。成功的前提是system prompt之间存在可观的真实期望差异（prompt variance），且该差异不能被生成随机性（response variance）与跨样本偏好抵消所掩盖。p1的实用启示是：与其盲目扩大训练集，不如挑选最能区分prompt优劣的少量样本来放大优化信号，从而用更少prompt获得更好的prompt。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks why automatic system-prompt optimization (via RL over prompts with a frozen LLM) is highly inconsistent across tasks. It studies when there exists a learnable optimization signal versus when the signal is drowned by generation stochasticity and dataset heterogeneity, making prompt optimization stall even with large compute.
summary_en.importance: System prompts are a low-cost, weight-free control interface for LLMs and can yield large gains, yet prompt optimization often behaves unpredictably. This work provides an explanatory criterion (a variance decomposition that characterizes signal vs noise), reveals a counterintuitive scaling failure mode (more training user prompts can hurt), and proposes a simple fix (p1 filtering) that improves optimization while using fewer prompts—especially impactful for heterogeneous reasoning tasks.
summary_en.technical_approach:
1) RL formulation: keep the base model π frozen; train a prompt-generation policy π' that outputs a system prompt x' conditioned on a meta-prompt s. Reward is binary correctness r(x,y) on dataset examples x with sampled responses y~π(·|x',x). Training uses an on-policy GRPO variant (no KL-to-reference, no std-based advantage normalization) with a value baseline V^{π'_t}(s)=E_{x'~π'_t}[r(x')].
2) Key analysis: decompose reward variance across system prompts into (a) response variance—stochasticity of sampled responses under a fixed system prompt, and (b) prompt variance—true differences in expected reward between system prompts. Prompt optimization succeeds when prompt variance is sufficiently large relative to response variance; it fails when response variance dominates (typical in complex reasoning like AIME).
3) Counterintuitive scaling: increasing the number of user prompts in the training set can reduce prompt variance because different examples prefer different system prompts; averaging over a larger, heterogeneous set cancels these preferences, making candidate prompts statistically indistinguishable.
4) p1 method: user-prompt filtering. Instead of optimizing on the full dataset, select a small subset of user prompts that exhibit high reward variance across candidate system prompts (i.e., they best discriminate good vs bad prompts). Training on this subset amplifies the optimization signal and can generalize better with far fewer training examples.
summary_en.experiments:
The paper evaluates standard prompt optimization vs p1 on instruction-following and reasoning benchmarks:
- Validates the variance story: instruction-following (e.g., IFBench) shows high sensitivity to system prompts (large prompt variance), enabling effective optimization; complex reasoning (e.g., AIME) is dominated by response variance, causing optimization to stagnate.
- Demonstrates the scaling pitfall: adding more user prompts can dilute prompt variance and degrade optimization, especially on heterogeneous reasoning datasets.
- Shows p1 gains: filtering yields substantial improvements on reasoning; notably, training on only two prompts from AIME 24 produces a system prompt that generalizes to other reasoning benchmarks.
- Transfer: prompts optimized on Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 also improve a larger Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507 and boost additional unseen reasoning benchmarks (highlighted in Fig. 1).
summary_en.reading_guide:
【skim】
- Read Introduction for the two main takeaways (variance decomposition; more data can hurt) and the motivation for p1.
- Read Problem Setup to understand the RL object (π' over system prompts), reward definition, and the GRPO-style objective.
- Look at Fig. 1 for the headline transfer/generalization evidence.

【must_read】
- Carefully read the “prompt learnability / variance decomposition” section(s): definitions/estimation of prompt variance vs response variance and how they determine the effective learning signal (SNR) for RL.
- Study the analysis and experiments behind “more user prompts can hurt”: this is the key counterintuitive result that changes how you should build prompt-optimization datasets.
- Read p1 details: how the filtering score is computed (reward variance across candidate prompts), how it plugs into GRPO training, and why it can generalize from extremely small subsets.
- Cross-check the main figures/tables: (i) variance composition across tasks; (ii) dataset size vs prompt variance/performance; (iii) p1 improvements and transfer across models/benchmarks.
summary_en.authors_note: The central message is that prompt optimization is a statistical learning problem governed by signal (true expected differences among system prompts) versus noise (stochastic responses and heterogeneity-induced cancellation). When prompt variance is small, RL over prompts has little to learn. p1 operationalizes this insight by selecting a few highly discriminative user prompts to amplify the signal, often outperforming full-dataset training while using fewer prompts.

recommendation.zh: 把 prompt 优化失败归因到奖励信号强弱而非“玄学”，并给出“样本更少更好”的可操作过滤；只看信号分解推导和 p1 过滤策略。
recommendation.en: Explains prompt-optimization instability via reward-signal strength (not mysticism) and gives an actionable “fewer samples can win” filter; read the signal decomposition and the p1 filtering rule.

paper.title: Distributionally Robust Token Optimization in RLHF

summary.core_problem: 现有 RLHF（PPO/DPO 及其变体）在训练分布与部署分布存在轻微偏移（措辞、格式、符号、语言等）时，容易出现性能大幅波动，尤其在多步数学推理中表现为不稳定与鲁棒性不足。即便是 token-level 的对齐方法（如 RTO）改善了 credit assignment，也仍会受 reward 噪声与 minibatch 组成影响，导致更新不稳、对分布移位敏感。
summary.importance: 鲁棒性是 RLHF 走向真实部署的关键瓶颈：线上输入不可控且分布持续漂移，若对齐方法对“表面扰动”高度敏感，会造成一致性差、可靠性不足与潜在安全风险。该工作把 DRO 的最坏情形思想引入 on-policy、token-level 的 actor 更新，在几乎不增加训练成本的前提下提升跨分布一致性，属于“工程可落地 + 理论可解释”的改进方向。
summary.technical_approach:
方法：Distributionally Robust Token Optimization (DRTO)。以 RTO 为基座（PPO 风格 actor 更新 + 从偏好学习得到的 token-wise reward），在 actor loss 上引入基于 f-divergence 的分布鲁棒优化：对一个 loss minibatch 构造“歧义集”(ambiguity set)，在该集合内最大化（最坏情况）token/trajectory 级损失，从而得到更保守但更稳定的更新。

关键建模：不是对全数据分布做 DRO，而是对每个 minibatch 的经验分布做局部 DRO（minibatch-level ambiguity set），直接作用于 on-policy policy-gradient 更新，目标是“抑制 minibatch 偶然性 + 强化对高损样本/轨迹的关注”，以提升分布移位下的一致性。

两种实现（对应两类 f-divergence）：
1) KL-DRTO：使用 KL 散度定义歧义集，得到对高损轨迹进行指数倾斜（exponential tilting）的熵风险/对数和指数形式的鲁棒目标；直观上等价于在 minibatch 内对高 loss 样本赋予更大权重，但权重是平滑的、由温度/半径控制。
2) χ²-DRTO：使用 χ² 散度，得到可计算的方差敏感（variance-sensitive）代理目标，可写成 minibatch 均值 + 与标准差相关的惩罚/上界形式；直观上鼓励降低“平均损失”同时压低“损失波动”，从而稳定梯度。

与相关工作差异：不同于 DrDPO/χ²-PO 等主要面向 offline 偏好优化的鲁棒重加权，DRTO 直接鲁棒化 on-policy、token-level 的 actor loss；也不同于需要额外保守约束或显著算力开销的 robust PPO/DPO 变体，DRTO 复用 RTO 流水线，额外开销很小。
summary.experiments: 实验聚焦数学推理分布移位鲁棒性：在多套基准上评估语言/符号/表述变化下的一致性与准确率。论文报告 DRTO 在保持 in-domain 强性能的同时，显著提升 shift 场景表现：例如 GSM8K 提升约 9.17%，另一个基准提升约 2.49%；跨五个 benchmark 的相对准确率提升最高可达 +11.83%（相对标准 RTO）。同时通过消融验证：KL 与 χ² 两种实现均能带来更稳定更新，且训练管线与标准 RTO 基本一致、几乎不增加运行时/计算成本。
summary.reading_guide:
【skim（泛读）】
- 读 Introduction：抓住问题定义（prompt 轻微变化导致失败）与核心主张（把 DRO 引入 token-level RLHF）。
- 读贡献点列表：明确“minibatch-level DRO + 两种 f-divergence 实现 + 低开销”。
- 重点看 Figure 1（若文中给出）：快速确认在多基准 shift 下的总体收益幅度。
- 读方法部分中 KL-DRTO/χ²-DRTO 的最终可实现目标式：理解“指数倾斜加权”与“均值+标准差”两种直觉。

【must_read（精读）】
- 精读方法推导：
  1) minibatch 经验分布如何定义歧义集；
  2) f-divergence DRO 的对偶形式如何落到可训练的 actor loss；
  3) KL 与 χ² 两种 divergence 下目标的差异（平滑重加权 vs 方差敏感上界）。
- 精读与 RTO 的结合点：token-wise reward 如何进入 PPO-style 更新、DRTO 在 actor loss 哪一项替换/包裹，以及对梯度估计方差与稳定性的影响。
- 精读实验设置：分布移位的构造方式（语言/符号/格式扰动）、评测协议、与 PPO/DPO/RTO/robust baselines 的对比是否公平（同算力、同数据、同超参搜索范围）。
- 重点看消融：
  - 歧义集半径/温度等超参对鲁棒-性能权衡；
  - KL vs χ² 在不同 shift 类型下谁更稳；
  - 是否存在过度保守导致 in-domain 下降的边界条件。
- 创新点抓手：minibatch-level DRO 在 on-policy token-level RLHF 的首次系统化落地；两种 divergence 给出“可直接替换 actor loss”的工程实现。
summary.authors_note: 作者强调 DRTO 的定位是“在不牺牲 RTO 推理优势的前提下增强分布鲁棒性”：通过对 minibatch 内高损轨迹更稳健的重加权/风险上界，获得更稳定的更新与更强的 shift 一致性；同时保持与标准 RTO 相同训练管线、几乎无额外算力成本。

summary_en.core_problem: RLHF methods (PPO/DPO and variants) can be brittle under small distribution shifts between alignment data and deployment prompts (wording, formatting, symbols, language). This brittleness is especially severe for multi-step reasoning. Even token-level alignment (e.g., RTO) improves credit assignment but remains sensitive to reward noise and minibatch composition, leading to unstable updates and poor out-of-distribution consistency.
summary_en.importance: Robustness is a deployment-critical gap for RLHF: real prompts drift continuously and are not controllable. If alignment is overly sensitive to superficial perturbations, reliability and safety degrade. This work brings a theoretically grounded DRO perspective into on-policy, token-level RLHF with minimal extra compute, improving cross-shift consistency while retaining strong in-domain performance.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Distributionally Robust Token Optimization (DRTO) builds on Reinforced Token Optimization (RTO): a PPO-style actor update driven by a preference-learned token-wise reward. DRTO robustifies the actor loss via Distributionally Robust Optimization (DRO) by constructing an f-divergence ambiguity set over the empirical minibatch distribution and optimizing the worst-case (upper-bounded) token/trajectory-wise objective. The goal is to reduce sensitivity to minibatch randomness and reward perturbations, yielding more stable policy-gradient updates under distribution shift.

Key design choice: DRO is applied at the minibatch level (local ambiguity set per update) within an on-policy token-level RLHF pipeline.

Two practical instantiations:
1) KL-DRTO: KL-divergence ambiguity set leads to an entropic-risk / exponential-tilting objective, smoothly upweighting high-loss trajectories within the minibatch.
2) χ²-DRTO: χ²-divergence yields a tractable variance-sensitive surrogate, effectively combining minibatch mean loss with a standard-deviation-dependent term, encouraging both low average loss and low loss dispersion.

Compared to prior robust preference optimization (e.g., DrDPO, χ²-PO) that mainly targets offline preference learning, DRTO directly stabilizes on-policy token-level actor updates, while largely preserving RTO’s training pipeline and compute profile.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments focus on robustness to linguistic/symbolic/format shifts in mathematical reasoning benchmarks. DRTO improves shifted performance while maintaining strong in-domain accuracy. Reported gains include ~+9.17% on GSM8K and ~+2.49% on another benchmark; across five benchmarks, relative accuracy improvements reach up to +11.83% over standard RTO (as summarized in the paper’s main figure). Ablations support that both KL- and χ²-based realizations improve update stability with little to no additional runtime/compute cost.
summary_en.reading_guide:
【skim】
- Read the Introduction for the failure mode (small prompt shifts) and the main idea (DRO + token-level RLHF).
- Scan the contributions list to capture: minibatch-level DRO, two f-divergence realizations, low overhead.
- Check the main results figure (e.g., Figure 1) for the overall robustness gains under shifts.
- Skim the final forms of KL-DRTO and χ²-DRTO objectives to internalize the intuition: exponential tilting vs mean+std surrogate.

【must_read】
- Carefully read the DRO derivations:
  1) how the minibatch ambiguity set is defined;
  2) how f-divergence DRO duality yields trainable actor losses;
  3) how KL vs χ² changes the risk shape (smooth reweighting vs variance-sensitive bound).
- Study the integration with RTO: where DRTO modifies/wraps the PPO-style actor loss, and implications for gradient variance and stability.
- Scrutinize experimental protocols: how shifts are constructed, evaluation consistency, and fairness vs PPO/DPO/RTO/robust baselines (compute/data/hyperparameter budgets).
- Focus on ablations: ambiguity radius/temperature trade-offs, KL vs χ² by shift type, and conditions where robustness becomes overly conservative.
- Innovation checklist: first systematic minibatch-level DRO inside on-policy token-level RLHF; two drop-in actor-loss implementations with minimal overhead.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors position DRTO as a practical, theoretically motivated robustness upgrade to token-level RLHF: by worst-case minibatch reweighting / risk surrogates, DRTO stabilizes actor updates and improves shift invariance, while keeping the same RTO pipeline and incurring little to no extra compute.

recommendation.zh: 把 DRO 的最坏情形塞进 token-level RLHF 更新里，属于能直接落地的稳健性改动；建议只读目标函数/优化细节与分布移位实验，其他略。
recommendation.en: A deployable robustness tweak: injects DRO-style worst-case weighting into token-level RLHF updates; read the objective/optimization details and the distribution-shift results, skip the rest.

paper.title: GRM: Utility-Aware Jailbreak Attacks on Audio LLMs via Gradient-Ratio Masking

summary.core_problem: 在音频LLM(语音-文本交互)中实现“兼顾效用”的越狱攻击：在提高jailbreak成功率的同时尽量保持转写与问答等正常能力不被破坏。
summary.importance: 属于多模态/语音安全与对齐的攻防分析：强调攻击-效用权衡并提出频带选择性扰动策略，对评估ALLM鲁棒性与制定防御/对齐策略有参考价值，但更偏安全攻防而非基座训练范式创新。
summary.technical_approach: 系统分析频域扰动覆盖范围(部分频带到全频带)对越狱与效用的影响，发现更宽频覆盖不一定更强但会稳定损害效用；提出GRM(Gradient-Ratio Masking)：按Mel频带对“攻击贡献/效用损失”进行比值排序，选择性在高性价比频带注入扰动，实现utility-aware的频率选择越狱。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体ALLM基线、数据集、攻击成功率提升幅度、以及转写/QA效用指标的定量结果；需看正文确认是否对比现有音频越狱方法并报告权衡曲线。

summary_en.core_problem: How to perform jailbreak attacks on audio LLMs that maximize attack success while preserving utility (e.g., transcription and QA performance), rather than degrading normal capabilities via indiscriminate perturbations.
summary_en.importance: Highlights the attack–utility trade-off in multimodal/audio model security and proposes a frequency-selective adversarial method, offering a more realistic threat model and a tool for evaluating and improving robustness and defenses for audio LLMs.
summary_en.technical_approach: Studies how the frequency-band coverage of perturbations affects jailbreak success and utility, observing that broader coverage can reliably harm utility without necessarily improving attack strength; proposes Gradient-Ratio Masking (GRM), which ranks Mel-frequency bands by a ratio of attack contribution to utility loss and injects perturbations only into high-payoff bands to achieve utility-aware jailbreaks.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract indicates evaluations of jailbreak success versus utility under different frequency-band perturbation regimes and with GRM, but does not specify the audio LLMs, datasets, baselines, or quantitative trade-off curves.

recommendation.zh: 偏语音多模态攻防：强调越狱成功率与效用保持的权衡，能提醒你做 ALLM 评测别只看 ASR/WER；但不太指导基座训练，扫方法与结果图即可。
recommendation.en: Mostly audio multimodal security: highlights the jailbreak–utility tradeoff and why evals shouldn’t only track ASR/WER; not very actionable for pretraining—skim method and key plots.

paper.title: BERT-as-a-Judge: A Robust Alternative to Lexical Methods for Efficient Reference-Based LLM Evaluation

summary.core_problem: 参考答案（reference-based）的生成式LLM评测中，如何避免词面/格式匹配（lexical）导致的误判，同时又不引入LLM-as-a-Judge的高计算成本。
summary.importance: 贡献类型为评测方法改进+大规模实证：系统性证明词面评测与人工相关性差，并提出更便宜的encoder judge替代方案，有助于降低大规模评测成本、提升评测鲁棒性（对后训练/对齐迭代也间接重要）。
summary.technical_approach: 提出BERT-as-a-Judge：用编码器模型对“生成答案 vs 参考答案”的语义正确性进行判别/打分，作为对lexical规则抽取与LLM judge的折中；并通过跨模型跨任务的实证分析定位lexical评测的失败模式。
summary.experiments: 摘要给出覆盖36个模型与15个下游任务的大规模研究，结论是lexical方法与人工判断相关性较差；但未在摘要中披露BERT judge的具体架构/训练方式、成本对比、以及相对LLM judge/lexical的量化提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: Improve reference-based evaluation of generative LLM outputs by avoiding brittle lexical/format matching while also avoiding the high cost of LLM-as-a-judge approaches.
summary_en.importance: Argues via large-scale evidence that lexical metrics correlate poorly with human judgments and proposes an efficient encoder-based judge as a robust, lower-cost alternative, supporting scalable evaluation for post-training and alignment iteration.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces BERT-as-a-Judge, using an encoder model to score semantic correctness between a generated answer and a reference, positioned between rule-based lexical methods and expensive LLM judges; additionally analyzes failure modes of lexical evaluation across tasks and models.
summary_en.experiments: Reports a study spanning 36 models and 15 downstream tasks showing weak human correlation for lexical methods; the abstract does not detail the BERT-judge training/setup, compute cost comparisons, or exact quantitative improvements over lexical and LLM-judge baselines.

recommendation.zh: 想省评测算力可看：encoder当judge是个工程上干净的折中；结论主要靠大规模相关性实验，扫实验设置与主表就够。
recommendation.en: If you need cheaper eval loops, this is a clean engineering compromise: an encoder judge; the value is in the correlation study—skim setup and the main tables.
